question: भात शेतात युरियाचा कार्यक्षम वापर कसा करावा?
answer:
भात शेतात युरियाचा कार्यक्षम वापर करण्यासाठी पूर्ण नत्र मात्रा एकाच वेळी देण्याऐवजी हप्त्यांतून द्या आणि पाणी नियंत्रणासोबत खत सरींमध्ये मातीत मिसळून द्या.

**खत व्यवस्थापन:**
- नत्राची संपूर्ण मात्रा दोन किंवा त्याहून जास्त हप्त्यांत विभागून द्या; एकदम देऊ नका  
- पाण्याचे नियंत्रण ठेवून खते मातीच्या सरींमध्ये किंवा रोपांच्या आसपास द्या; खत थेट रोपाला लागू नये  
- खत ओलसर अवस्थेत असेल तर कोरड्या मातीत मिसळून दावा, म्हणजे प्रसारणे सोपी होते  
- भात पिकात नत्रासाठी युरियाचा वापर शिफारसीनुसार करा; भाताला नायट्रेट प्रकारचे खत वापरू नये

**मात्रा व वेळ (उदाहरण):**
- तांदूळासाठी प्रति एकर २ कप्पे युरिया + २ कप्पे सिंगल सुपर फॉस्फेट (२५ किग्रा) + १ कप्पा म्युरिएट ऑफ पोटॅश (३३ किग्रा) इतकी रासायनिक खतांची मात्रा दिलेली आहे  
- लवकर वाणासाठी: लागवडीच्या वेळी १ कप्पा युरिया + स्फुरद व पालाशाची पूर्ण मात्रा; लागवडीनंतर २५ ते ३० दिवसांनी उरलेली २ कप्पे युरिया  
- मध्यम व उशिरा वाणासाठी: लागवडीच्या वेळी १ कप्पा युरिया + स्फुरद व पालाशाची पूर्ण मात्रा; लागवडीनंतर २५ ते ३० दिवसांनी ०.५ कप्पा युरिया; आणि ५५ ते ६० दिवसांनी उरलेला ०.५ कप्पा युरिया

**स्रोत: एम.पी.के.व्ही. कृषी दर्शनी; कृषी दर्शनी डॉ. बा.स.कृषी विद्यापीठ, दापोली २०२५**

तुमचा भात लवकर, मध्यम की उशिरा वाणाचा आहे आणि लागवड झाल्यानंतर किती दिवस झाले आहेत?

**Emerging Trends in Livestock Nutrition for Health and Production**
```
NEWER TRACE ELEMENTS [सूक्ष्म अन्नद्रव्ये]

 There are few trace elements [सूक्ष्म अन्नद्रव्ये] which are present in very low concentrations and their beneficial functions have been studied. Chromium (Cr) is known to influence glucose utilization and is termed as glucose tolerance factor. Practical diets of livestock [पशुधन] appear to contain enough Cr to meet the requirement inspite of its low availability from feed stuffs. Supplementation of Cr as Cr-picolinate to ruminants has increased the feed efficiency [चारा कार्यक्षमता]. Boron [बोरॉन] (B) supplementation has shown to improve bone strength, increased Ca, Mg retention and semen [वीर्य] quality. Boron [बोरॉन] appears to have Vitamin D sparing action. Silicon (Si) is essential for growth [वाढ] and bone development in rats and chicks and believed to be associated with glycosamine and collagen synthesis. Induced Vanadium (V) deficiency in rats and chicks resulted in reduced feather growth [वाढ], iron [लोह] metabolism and impaired bone development. Further detailed research is required to confirm the essentiality and supplementary value of these newer trace elements [सूक्ष्म अन्नद्रव्ये].

CONCLUSIONS

 Minerals [खनिजे] play a significant role in production [उत्पादन] and reproduction either singly or in combination. Overcoming the deficiency or imbalance of the trace minerals [सूक्ष्म खनिज] improves the productive efficiency of livestock [पशुधन] to great extent. Hence minerals [खनिजे] are to be considered in tropical feeding [खाऊ घालणे] system not in isolation [अलग ठेवणे] but as a part of total nutrient management [अन्नद्रव्य व्यवस्थापन] system. In India, where land availability for grazing [चरणे] or fodder [चारा] cultivation is less and type of cultivar [वाण](grains [धान्ये], legumes, oil seeds) is designed mostly for human consumption, only the by-products are available to animals. Hence the emphasis should be on ways of mineral supplementation, cost-effectively based on prevailing livestock farming [पशुपालन] system and available resources. Three forms of mineral supplements can be practically adopted. 1. General purpose, productivity supporting, inorganic mineral compounds 2. Special purpose (high phosphorus [स्फुरद], high calcium [कॅल्शियम], high zinc [झिंक]), which are area specific formulated depending upon valid area survey results. 3. Organic [सेंद्रिय] ligand bound specific supplements (chelates, proteinates, amino acid complexes) for feeding [खाऊ घालणे] under stressful / deficient conditions. Research on nano and encapsulated minerals [खनिजे] is still in its initial stages.

question: नवीन पद्धत वापरण्याआधी धोका कमी करण्यासाठी प्रत्यक्ष उदाहरण दाखवतात का?
answer:
हो, नवीन पद्धत वापरण्याआधी धोका कमी करण्यासाठी प्रात्यक्षिक क्षेत्रातून आणि प्रदर्शन शेतीतून प्रत्यक्ष उदाहरण दाखवणे हे एक सामान्य व प्रभावी मार्ग आहे.

**प्रात्यक्षिक क्षेत्र/प्रदर्शन:**
- दस्तऐवजांनुसार, प्रात्यक्षिक क्षेत्रे ही नवीन पद्धतींचे परिणाम शेतकऱ्यांना पाहण्यासाठी उपयोगाची ठिकाणे आहेत; येथे शेतकरी नवीन तंत्रज्ञान लागू करून मिळालेली वाढ किंवा फरक थेट पाहू शकतात.
- रब्बी हंगामात ७२,८०७ अशा दर्शनांतून डाळ पिकांवर ३१,५१५.४६ हेक्टर क्षेत्रात नवीन तंत्रज्ञानाचे प्रत्यक्ष प्रात्यक्षिक दाखवले गेले असे आधुनिक अहवाल सांगतात.
- भात पिकाच्या शिफारस केलेल्या तंत्रज्ञानाचा स्वीकार वाढवण्यासाठी पद्धत दर्शन, निकष दर्शन आणि गट चर्चा अशा विस्तार पद्धती वापरल्या जाऊ शकतात असेही दस्तऐवजात दिले आहे.

Demonstration Projects and Pilot Programs

Demonstration farms and pilot programs are valuable for showcasing best practices and new technologies. These serve as proof-of-concept sites where farmers can see the results of implementing new methods. Examples of demonstration projects might include:

Integrated Pest Management [एकात्मिक कीड व्यवस्थापन]: A farm may demonstrate the use of biological control [जैविक नियंत्रण] methods instead of chemical pesticides [रासायनिक कीटकनाशके].

Climate-Smart Practices [हवामान सुसंगत पद्धती]: Demonstration farms may adopt drought [दुष्काळ]-tolerant crops or water-efficient irrigation techniques [पाणी-कार्यक्षम सिंचन तंत्र] to showcase how climate [हवामान]-resilient practices can boost farm productivity [शेती उत्पादकता].

3. Adoption of Farm Management [शेती व्यवस्थापन] Practices

Once extension strategies have been implemented, the next challenge is ensuring that farmers adopt and maintain these new practices. Key areas of farm management [शेती व्यवस्थापन] where adoption is crucial include:

Improved Crop [पीक] and Livestock Management [पशुधन व्यवस्थापन]

Efficient management [व्यवस्थापन] of crops and livestock [पशुधन] is essential for improving productivity. Key practices include:

Crop Rotation [पीक फेरपालट] and Intercropping [आंतरपीक]: These techniques help in maintaining soil health [मृदा आरोग्य], managing pests, and optimizing yields.

Livestock Health [पशुधन आरोग्य] and Genetics: Providing farmers with knowledge on animal husbandry [पशुसंवर्धन], disease prevention [रोग प्रतिबंध], and breeding [प्रजनन] techniques helps ensure healthy livestock [निरोगी जनावर].

Sustainable Soil [माती] and Water Management [पाण्याचे व्यवस्थापन]: Techniques like conservation tillage [संवर्धन मशागत], organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती], and rainwater harvesting [पावसाचे पाणी साठवणे] can help ensure long-term productivity.

question: सोयाबीनवरील पांढऱ्या माशीच्या नियंत्रणाचे उपाय सांगा.
answer:
सोयाबीनवरील पांढऱ्या माशीवर नियंत्रणासाठी शेतात सापळे लावा व कीड दिसताच शिफारस केलेल्या औषधाची फवारणी करा.

**कीड व रोग नियंत्रण:**
- सोयाबीनमध्ये पिवळा मोझॅक हा विषाणूजन्य रोग पांढऱ्या माश्याने पसरतो; त्यामुळे पांढरी माशी वेळच्यावेळी नियंत्रित करणे महत्त्वाचे आहे.
- प्रति हेक्टर १५ ते २० पिवळे चिकट सापळे लागवडीच्या सुरुवातीपासून शेतात लावा.
- फवारणी: डायफेन्थ्युरॉन ५०% डब्ल्यू.पी. १२ ग्रॅम प्रति १० ली. पाणी या प्रमाणात फवारणी करा.
- पर्याय (केरलीतील कृषी संदर्भात दिलेल्या तक्त्यानुसार): अ‍ॅसिटामिप्रिड २५% + बायफेन्थ्रिन २५% डब्ल्यू.जी. प्रति १० ली. पाणी या प्रमाणात फवारणी करण्याचा उल्लेख आहे.

**स्रोत: एम.पी.के.व्ही. कृषी दर्शनी, डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ, कृषी वि.एन.एम.ए.यू.**  

तुमच्या सोयाबीनमध्ये पाने पिवळी पडत आहेत का आणि पांढरी माशी खूप वाढली आहे का?

तुमच्या जवळचे गोदाम उपलब्ध आहेत, पण त्या गोदामात साठवलेल्या मालाचा विमा कोणत्या योजनेअंतर्गत उतरतो हे गोदाम माहितीमध्ये दिलेले नाही; मात्र पीकविम्यासाठी **प्रधानमंत्री फसल बीमा योजना (पीएमएफबीवाई)** ही केंद्र योजना आहे जी अधिसूचित क्षेत्रातील अधिसूचित पिकांवर विमा संरक्षण देते.

**गोदाम (तुमच्या जवळ):**
- लोहा गोदाम  
  पत्ता: एमएसडब्ल्यूसी, एपीएमसी बाजारयार्ड, शिवजी चौक, लोहा  
  संपर्क: गोदाम व्यवस्थापक  
  फोन: ९०२८५२१३३२  
  अंतर: १३.३७ कि.मी.

- नांदेड, मिडसी गोदाम  
  पत्ता: एमएसडब्ल्यूसी, प्लॉट क्रमांक बी-१४, मिडसी परिसर, नांदेड  
  संपर्क: गोदाम व्यवस्थापक  
  फोन: ०२४६२-२२६५०७, ९१५८००१३३५  
  अंतर: १७.२० कि.मी.

- पुर्णा गोदाम  
  पत्ता: एमएसडब्ल्यूसी, नांदेड रोड, पुर्णा  
  संपर्क: गोदाम व्यवस्थापक  
  फोन: ०२४५२-२५५२१५, ९५४५०११६९३  
  अंतर: १८.७८ कि.मी.

**पीकविमा (पीएमएफबीवाई):**
**पात्रता:**
- अधिसूचित क्षेत्रात अधिसूचित पिके घेणारे सर्व शेतकरी (भाडेकरू/ऊतीसारखे देखील)
- कर्जदार व बिगरकर्जदार दोघांसाठी इच्छेनुसार

**अर्ज कसा करावा:**
- नियमित अटींना जुळून ऑनलाईन पद्धतीने संबंधित पोर्टलवर अर्ज करायचा असतो (परत प्रीमियमची काही तरतूद नमूद आहे).

**स्रोत: कृषी सेवा माहिती; शासकीय योजना माहिती**

तुम्हाला विमा उतरायचा तो माल कोणत्या पिकाचा आहे आणि तो बागायत/डाळे/कांदा यापैकी कोणत्या प्रकारात येतो?

*Id*:

*Scheme Code*:
mahadbt-pmfby

*Sponsor*:
Central

*Scheme Provider*:
Maha-DBT

*Scheme Name*:
Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojna (PMFBY)

*Main Component*:
Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojna (PMFBY)

*Sub Component*:
Risk covered -  Crop cutting base average yield reduction in comparison to threshhold yield for that insurance unit( Revenue circle)

*Introduction*:
1. The scheme is applicable for notified crops in a notified area (revenue circle). All farmers including share-croppers, tenant farmers growing notified crops in the notified area.
2. The scheme is optional for both loanee as well as non-loanee  farmers.
3. Under this scheme, the indemnity level is  fixed as 70 % for all notified crops.
4. Threshold yield  is determined by taking into account the average average yield  of the  best five years from past 7 years multiplied by  indemnity level
5. The scheme is implemented on beed pattern (80:110) where Insurance companies claim liability is up to 110 %  of the gross premium  or 110% of the burn cost whichever is higher for the given cluster in given season .  The claims above 110 % will be paid by state govt. and in case of profit, Insurance company will keep 20% of the gross premium and return the balance premium amount to state if any .

*Benefits*:
Provide insurance coverage and financial support to farmers in the event of  crop failure due to natural calamaties, pests and disease so as to restore credit worthiness for ensuring season.

*Eligibility*:
1. All the farmers  growing notified crops in the notified area are eligible.
2. The scheme is  optional for Loanee & Non-loanee farmers.

Sum insured per hector: Sum insured per hectare is decided as per scale of finance for that crop

Insurance Companies: The scheme is being implemented through selected  crop insurance companies  through tendering process.

*Required Documents*:
1. Agristack number
2. Aadhar card
3. Bank account details
4. Land details and crop details
5. Digital crop survey ( E pik Pahani)

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on www.pmfby.gov.in portal within the given date

question: माझ्या शेतात नवीन ड्रिप प्रणाली बसवण्यासाठी अर्ज कसा करावा?
answer:
तुम्ही बोर्डी (मालेगाव, वाशिम) गावातील शेतकरी असून तुमचे गाव पोक्रा-नियुक्त नाही, म्हणून **नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प** अंतर्गत ठिबक सिंचनाचा पर्याय तुमच्यासाठी लागू होत नाही; पण तुमच्यासाठी **पीएम-आर.के.व्हाय.-पर ड्रॉप मोअर क्रॉप** ही केंद्रीय योजना ठिबक प्रणाली बसवण्यासाठी उपलब्ध आहे?

**पीएम-आर.के.व्हाय.-पर ड्रॉप मोअर क्रॉप** ही केंद्र योजना आहे जी ठिबक व तुषार सूट बसवण्यासाठी अनुदान देते आणि रक्कम थेट बँक खात्यात डीबीटीने जमा होते.

**लाभ:**
- लघु व अल्पभूधारक शेतकऱ्यांना ५५% मदत
- इतर शेतकऱ्यांना ४५% मदत
- कमाल ५ हेक्टर क्षेत्रापर्यंत

**पात्रता:**
- ७/१२ आणि ८ अ धारक शेतकरी
- सिंचनाचा स्रोत असणे आवश्यक

**अर्ज कसा करावा:**
- महाडीबीटी पोर्टलवर नोंदणी करून ऑनलाईन अर्ज करावा लागतो?

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**?

तुमच्या शेतात सध्या कोणत्या प्रकारचा सिंचन स्रोत आहे—विहीर, बांधावर विहीर की किण्वित पाणी/?

कंद्याची काढणी झाल्यानंतर झड्यांमुळे नुकसान कमी करण्यासाठी उपलब्ध दस्तऐवजांतले मुख्य उपाय हे साठवण आणि वाळवण्याच्या योग्य पद्धतींवर लक्ष देणे हा आहे, कारण चांगली हवा लागणारी साठवणूक केली तर वजन कमी होणे, फुटकी येणे आणि कुज कमी होते.

**काढणीपूर्व/काढणीनंतर:** कांद्याच्या बेणांसाठी कापणीपूर्वी पाणी १० ते १५ दिवस बंद ठेवण्याचा सल्ला दिला आहे; तसेच कापणीपूर्वी कार्बेन्डाझिम १० ग्रॅम + स्टिकर १० मि.ली./१० ली. पाणी १० दिवसांनी फवारणी, आणि कापणीनंतर मँकोझेब किंवा कॉपर ऑक्सीक्लोराईड २५ ग्रॅम/१० ली. पाणी फवारणी केल्यास साठवण नुकसान टाळायला मदत होते असे नमूद आहे.

**वाळवणी (शेड क्योरिंग):** काढलेल्या कांद्याची बेणे रोपांसह शेडमध्ये १० दिवस वाळवण्याचा सल्ला आहे.

**साठवण:** कांद्याची बेणे गटात बांधून हवेशीर साठवणीत ठेवण्याचे सांगितले आहे; तसेच डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठाने विकसित केलेल्या हवेशीर कांदा साठवणी रचनेत जाली कडीचे फ्रेम, भूमिपातळीपासून साधारण ३० से.मी. उंच ठेवणे, मध्यभागी गरम हवा वर निघून जाण्यासाठी छत्राशी जोडलेले एक्झॉस्ट प्रणाली, आणि पोकळ पीव्हीसी पाइप्स द्वारे हवेची आदळ राखणे या गोष्टींची माहिती दिली आहे — यामुळे साठवणीतील नासडी कमी होते असे दिलेले आहे.

**अतिरिक्त सूचना:** काढणी पूर्वी अशा फवारणीचा सल्ला कांद्याच्या बेणांसाठी आहे; तुम्हाला कोणत्या पिकाचा कांदा/कंद आहे आणि तुमचे गाव-तालुका कोणता आहे ते सांगा, म्हणजे पुढील दोन दिवसांचे हवामान पाहून काढणीचा सुरक्षित वेळ ठरवण्यात मी मदत करू शकतो?

**स्रोत: भाजीपाला (एम.पी.के.व्ही., राहुरी)**

तुमचा कांदा बेणांसारखा आहे की मोठा मार्केट कांदा, आणि काढणी कधी करणार आहात?

1. Losses by shattering [दाणे गळणे]:

The loss due to shattering [दाणे गळणे] of leaves are more especially in the case of legumes. The leaves are much richer in digestible nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] than the stem and hence losses by shattering [दाणे गळणे] decrease the nutritive value of hay. To avoid these losses, hay should never be over dried or handled during warm periods of the day. Handling of hay while field [शेत] curing is preferably done in the morning hours of the day.

2. Losses of vitamins [जीवनसत्त्वे] due to oxidation:

 In the process of drying [वाळवणे], much of the green coloring matter containing carotene is bleached. Exposure of the green plants to Sun rays decreases vitamin A content of the hay. Sun cured hays are rich in vitamin D2.

3. Losses due to fermentation:

After the crop [पीक] is harvested the plant enzymes act on the soluble carbohydrates forming thereby CO2 and water. Therefore, some of the nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] are lost. This loss results in the higher crude fibre content of dry matter [सुका घटक] of hay as compared to the green fodder [हिरवा चारा]. In addition to carbohydrates, protein [प्रथिने] is affected. Proteins are hydrolysed to amino acids [अमिनो आम्ल] which will be lost if there is rain on the hay due to leaching [झिरपण प्रक्रिया]. In normal curing there is a loss, about 5-9% of dry matter [सुका घटक].

*2.5 Risk Management [व्यवस्थापन] and Sustainability*

Livestock farming [पशुपालन] is inherently risky, with uncertainties related to disease [रोग] outbreaks, weather [वातावरण] conditions, and market fluctuations. Effective risk management [व्यवस्थापन] strategies should be incorporated into the project plan.

- Insurance: Consider purchasing insurance policies for livestock [पशुधन], farm buildings, and equipment. Crop [पीक] or weather [वातावरण] insurance may also be beneficial if grazing [चरणे] or feed crops are part of the farm.
- Diversification: To minimize risks, consider diversifying farm operations. For example, a farm focused on dairy [दुग्धव्यवसाय] production [उत्पादन] may diversify by raising meat [मांस] animals or growing feed crops.
- Sustainable Practices [शाश्वत पद्धती]: Implement sustainable farming practices [शाश्वत शेती पद्धती] such as rotational grazing [चरणे], manure management [खत व्यवस्थापन], and water conservation [पाण्याचे संवर्धन]. These practices not only reduce the environmental footprint but can also reduce costs and improve farm productivity [शेती उत्पादकता].

*2.6 Monitoring, Evaluation [मूल्यांकन], and Adjustments*

Once the project is up and running, continuous monitoring and evaluation [मूल्यांकन] are crucial to ensure the farm operates efficiently and remains profitable.

- Performance Tracking: Regularly assess key performance indicators (KPIs) such as animal health [पशु आरोग्य], productivity, feed efficiency [चारा कार्यक्षमता], and financial performance.
- Adjustments: Based on the monitoring data, make adjustments to management [व्यवस्थापन] practices, breeding [प्रजनन] programs, and operational procedures to optimize efficiency and profitability [फायदेशीरता].

3. Conclusion [निष्कर्ष]: Achieving Success in Livestock Farming [पशुपालन]

Formulating a successful livestock farming [पशुपालन] project requires comprehensive planning, strategic investment [गुंतवणूक], and ongoing management [व्यवस्थापन]. By understanding the economics of livestock farming [पशुपालन], conducting thorough market research, and creating a detailed business plan [व्यवसाय योजना], farmers can mitigate risks, optimize production [उत्पादन], and maximize profitability [फायदेशीरता]. Effective project formulation encompasses capital [भांडवल] investment [गुंतवणूक], operational planning, financial management [आर्थिक व्यवस्थापन], and risk strategies, all of which contribute to the long-term sustainability and success of the livestock [पशुधन] farm. With careful planning, strong financial oversight, and a commitment to best practices, livestock farming [पशुपालन] can be a rewarding and profitable venture.

**Natural Farming Training Toolkit & Best Practices Guide**
```
9.3 Carbon Credits [कार्बन क्रेडिट्स] Generation in Natural Farming [नैसर्गिक शेती]

In natural farming [नैसर्गिक शेती], the accumulation of stable carbon in the soil [माती] is driven by the constant addition of biomass [वनस्पती झाडे पीके व शैवाल यापासुन निर्माण होणारा सेंद्रीय पदार्थ] through mulching [आच्छादन] and the enhanced activity of microorganisms [सूक्ष्मजीव]. This system converts agricultural lands into carbon sinks, which mitigates climate change [हवामान बदल] and improves the water-holding capacity [पाणी धारण क्षमता] of the soil [माती]. This enhancement increases resilience to drought [दुष्काळ] and rainfall variability. While precise large-scale quantification is an ongoing area of research, the foundational principles align directly with the objectives of carbon farming [कार्बन शेती]. Natural farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] employs multiple regenerative practices that either remove carbon from the atmosphere or prevent its release:

9.3.1 Increased Organic Matter Addition [सेंद्रिय पदार्थांची भर]

(i) Regular application of farmyard manure [शेणखत] (FYM), compost [कंपोस्ट], crop [पीक] residues, and green manures builds soil organic carbon [मातीतील सेंद्रिय कार्बन].

9.3.2 Agroforestry [कृषिवनशास्त्र] and Tree Integration

(i) Incorporating trees, hedges, and perennials enhances aboveground and belowground biomass [वनस्पती झाडे पीके व शैवाल यापासुन निर्माण होणारा सेंद्रीय पदार्थ] carbon.

9.3.3 Mulching [आच्छादन] and Cover Cropping [आच्छादन पीक लागवड]

(i) Maintains continuous soil [माती] cover, prevents erosion, and adds biomass [वनस्पती झाडे पीके व शैवाल यापासुन निर्माण होणारा सेंद्रीय पदार्थ].

9.3.4 Reduced Tillage [जमिनीची मशागत] and Soil [माती] Disturbance

(i) Helps preserve existing carbon stocks by minimizing oxidation.

9.3.5 Elimination of Synthetic Inputs

(i) Avoids nitrous oxide emissions from chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते] and reduces energy footprint.

9.4 Steps to Generate Carbon Credits [कार्बन क्रेडिट्स] in Natural Farming [नैसर्गिक शेती]

The stepwise flow for carbon credits [कार्बन क्रेडिट्स] estimation and trading in natural farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] can be learnt from Fig [अंजीर]. 9.1.

Conclusion [निष्कर्ष]

Carbon credits [कार्बन क्रेडिट्स] in natural farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] represent a winwin solution: they reward farmers for climatepositive practices, reduce national GHG emissions, and attract new forms of green finance into rural areas. While challenges remain, especially related to certification costs and awareness, India's large-scale initiatives like NMNF provide the ideal framework for rolling out carbon credit programs. With proper support, a farmer [शेतकरी] practicing natural farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] can not only restore soil [माती] and ecosystem health [आरोग्य] but also earn while healing the planet.
```

question: माझ्या जवळची माती परीक्षण प्रयोगशाळा कोठे आहे?
answer:
तुमच्या दिडगाव (तालुका सिल्लोड, जिल्हा छ.संभाजीनगर) परिसरासाठी खालील माती परीक्षण प्रयोगशाळा उपलब्ध दिसतात:

**माती तपासणी प्रयोगशाळा, छत्रपती संभाजीनगर**  
पत्ता: जिल्हा माती सर्वेक्षण व माती तपासणी अधिकारी कार्यालय, शहानूर मिया दरगाज जवळ, औरंगाबाद ४३१००१  
संपर्क: श्रीमती तेजस्वी तीरभवक सालुंके  
फोन: ९५११६५९२७५  
अंतर: ५७ कि.मी.

**माती तपासणी प्रयोगशाळा, जालना**  
पत्ता: जिल्हा माती सर्वेक्षण आणि माती तपासणी कार्यालय, फलोत्पादन विभाग परिसर, जालना  
संपर्क: श्री व्ही. जे. राठोड  
फोन: ८३२९९४८८०४  
अंतर: ६७ कि.मी.

**माती तपासणी प्रयोगशाळा, बुलढाणा**  
पत्ता: जिल्हा माती सर्वेक्षण व माती तपासणी अधिकारी, रामकृष्ण आश्रम जवळ, जिल्हा अधिकाऱ्यांच्या निवासाजवळ रस्ता, बुलढाणा  
संपर्क: श्री व्ही. एच. विश्वे  
फोन: ९४२०६११९५८  
अंतर: ७१ कि.मी.

**माती तपासणी प्रयोगशाळा, जळगाव**  
पत्ता: जिल्हा माती सर्वेक्षण व माती तपासणी अधिकारी, कृषी-पोलिक्लिनिक, मामुराबाद सर्व्हे नंबर १११४, तालुका/जिल्हा जळगाव  
संपर्क: श्री भरत वामन वाळे  
फोन: ९४२२६२५५७४  
अंतर: ७९ कि.मी.

**माती तपासणी प्रयोगशाळा, धुळे**  
पत्ता: जिल्हा माती तपासणी प्रयोगशाळा, तालुका फळ बागेच्या चव्या, पोस्ट पिंपरी फार्म, पिंपरी, धुळे ४२४००१  
संपर्क: श्रीमती पी. जी. सोनawane  
फोन: ९४२०८७१०६३  
अंतर: ९६ कि.मी.

question: मी कोणत्या योजनेसाठी पात्र आहे?
answer:
तुमच्या प्रोफाइलनुसार तुम्ही कुंभारी गाव, रेणापूर तालुका, लातूर जिल्ह्यात आहात आणि पोक्रा-नियुक्त गावात नाही; तुमची एकूण जमीनधारणा १४.०२ हेक्टर आहे, त्यामुळे पोक्रा अंतर्गत ठिबक/तुषार/शेततळे/अंतरंग शेळीपालन इ. योजना या सिस्टममध्ये तुमच्यासाठी लागू पडत नाहीत.

**उपलब्ध पर्याय:**
- **प्रधानमंत्री किसान सन्मान निधी योजना** (पीएम-किसान) ही केंद्र शासनाची योजना असून पात्र शेतकऱ्यांना वार्षिक तीन हप्ते मिळतात?
- **बाबासाहेब आंबेडकर कृषी स्वावलंबन योजना** ही महाराष्ट्र राज्याची योजना आहे?
- **मुख्यमंत्री शाश्वत कृषी सिंचन वैयक्तिक शेततळे योजना** ही राज्य योजना आहे?
- **गोपीनाथ मुंडे शेतकरी अपघात सुरक्षा अनुदान योजना** ही राज्य योजना आहे?

यापैकी नेमकी कोणत्या योजनेसाठी पात्रता ठरवायची आहे ते समजण्यासाठी मला थोडी माहिती हवी आहे:
- पीएम-किसानचा स्वतंत्र आधार जोडलेला बँक खाता आहे का?
- शेततळे करायचे आहे की मशागत/यांत्रिकीकरणसाठी अनुदान पाहिजे आहे?

The negative effect of heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण] on milk production [दूध उत्पादन] is due to the decreased nutrient [पोषक घटक] intake and decreased nutrient uptake [अन्नद्रव्य सेवन] by the portal drained viscera of the buffalo [म्हैस]. Blood [रक्त] flow shifted to peripheral tissues for cooling purposes alters nutrient [पोषक घटक] metabolism and contribute to lower milk yield [दुधाचे उत्पादन] during hot weather [वातावरण]. Hormonal alterations also occur with heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण] such as plasma [प्लाझ्मा] somatotropin and thyroxine concentration tend to decline with heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण]. Reduced concentrations of these key metabolic hormones with heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण] shows the animal attempt to reduce metabolic heat and milk production [दूध उत्पादन]. Heat stressed buffaloes generally exhibit altered blood [रक्त] acid-base chemistry as a result of the shift in cooling from conductive, convective, and radiation to evaporative cooling. Heat-stressed animals have elevated rectal temperature [तापमान] and respiratory rate accompanied with a diurnal variation [दिवसातील तापमान बदल] in blood [रक्त] pH and blood [रक्त] bicarbonate levels. Their acid-base chemistry exhibits wide swings from alkalosis to a compensated acidosis resulting in a metabolic acidosis during the cooler evening hours. Reduced concentrations of blood [रक्त] bicarbonate compromise the buffering capability associated with the bicarbonate system, which may be critical during summer. During hot seasons the dry matter [सुका घटक] intake of buffaloes is decreased moreover the ratio [प्रमाण] of forage [चारा] to concentrates [दाणेदार खाद्य] intake is also decreased. In other words, the decline in milk yield [दुधाचे उत्पादन] at higher temperature [तापमान] is more marked in buffaloes that produce more milk [दूध]. There is a significant relationship between the level of milk yield [दुधाचे उत्पादन] and the decline in milk yield [दुधाचे उत्पादन] with each increase in daily mean environment temperature [तापमान].

कोबीतील काळा कुज (काळा कूजु) हा जीवाणूजन्य रोग आहे; पानांच्या कडांवर वाय-आकाराचे डाग येतात आणि पुढे कोबीची डोब सडून दुर्गंधी येते, म्हणून यासाठी वेळेत फवारणी व बियाणावर उपचार हे व्यवस्थापनात महत्त्वाचे आहेत.

**लक्षणे:**  
- पानांच्या कडांवर वाय-आकाराचे डाग दिसणे  
- झाडाच्या खोडात जाऊन पुढे कोबीच्या डोबात रोग प्रवेश करणे  
- डोबांचे सडणे व दुर्गंधी येणे  

**पीक संरक्षण (फवारणी):**  
डोब तयार होण्याच्या अवस्थेत पाण्यात प्रति लीटर १ मि.ली. मॅलाथिऑन ५०% + २.५ ग्रॅम कॉपर ऑक्सीक्लोराइड किंवा २.५ ग्रॅम झिनेब अशी फवारणी करावी; ही फवारणी २ ते ३ वेळा, १० ते १२ दिवसांच्या अंतराने करावी.

**बियाणावर रोग नियंत्रण (गरम पाण्याचा उपचार):**  
पत्ता कोबी कुटुंबातील काळा कुजसाठी बियाणे ५०°C तापमानावर २० ते ३० मिनिटे गरम पाण्यात ठेवावे.

**स्रोत: कृषी दर्शनी डॉ. बाळासाहेब सावंत कोकण कृषी विद्यापीठ, दापोली (२०२५); क्रुशी व्ही.एन.एम.ए.यू.**

जमिनीच्या आरोग्यासाठी कडुलिंबाचा पेंढ (निंबोळी पेंडी) हा मातीत मिसळून दिल्यास सेंद्रिय कर्ब वाढतो आणि कीड/सूत्रकृमी यांच्या नियंत्रणात मदत होऊ शकते.

**माती:**
- पुनर्लागवडीपूर्वी किंवा लागवडीपूर्वी ओल्या मातीमध्ये पेंढ मिसळावा, म्हणजे तो चांगला वितरित होतो?

**मात्रा व वेळ:**
- मिरीची पुनर्लागवड: कडुलिंबाचा पेंढ २.५ क्विंटल प्रति हेक्टर मातीत मिसळावा?
- सूत्रकृमीचा प्रादुर्भाव असलेली भाजीपाला/फळबागेची पिके: लागवडीच्या १५ दिवस आधी कडुलिंबाचा पेंढ १८०० ते २००० किग्रा प्रति हेक्टर मातीत मिसळावा?
- काही फळबागांमध्ये: प्रति एकर एकदा लावणीवेळी आणि त्यानंतर एक महिन्याने अशा दोन वेळा कडुलिंबाचा पेंढ १०० किग्रा प्रति एकर द्यावा?
- ट्रायकोडर्मासारखे जैव बुरशीनाशके वापरत असाल तर पेरणी/लागवडीच्या १५ ते २० दिवस आधी ओल्या मातीत पेंड/सेंद्रिय खतांसह एकत्र मिसळून देणे फायदेशीर ठरते?

**स्रोत: डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ; कृषी दर्शनी (डॉ. बाळासाहेब सावंत कोल्हापूर कृषी विद्यापीठ); कृषी व्ही.एन.एम.ए.यू.; कृषी विज्ञान केंद्र व्ही.एन.एम.ए.यू.**

तुम्हाला हा पेंढ कोणत्या पिकासाठी (उदा. भेंडी, टोमॅटो, डाळिंब, संत्री) आणि किती क्षेत्रावर (एकर/हेक्टर) वापरायचा आहे??

## **Method of Preparing 5% Neem Oil [कडुलिंबाचे तेल] Extract**

1. Collect neem [कडूलिंब] seeds in summer (at the beginning of the rainy season) when they are available. Dry [कोरडे] them well, clean them, and store them.
2. Grind the required amount of neem [कडूलिंब] seeds finely the day before spraying [फवारणी].
3. Soak five kg of neem [कडूलिंब] seed [बियाणे] powder in nine liters of water (in the evening before spraying [फवारणी]). Also, soak 200 grams of soap powder separately in one liter of water.
4. The next morning, filter the neem extract [निंबोळी अर्क] well through a cloth. Add the soap solution prepared in one liter of water to this extract. Add enough water to make the total volume of the extract 10 liters.

## **Neem [कडूलिंब]**

1. Soil [माती]

The scientific name of this tree is Azadirachta indica. The Neem [कडूलिंब] tree grows in hilly slopes, rocky, barren, light [प्रकाश], medium heavy soil [माती]. Waterlogged soils that do not drain are unsuitable for Neem [कडूलिंब] cultivation. In many places, the Neem [कडूलिंब] tree asserts its existence in adverse conditions where other trees cannot survive.

1. Climate [हवामान]

Very high temperatures, severe cold, and fog are not tolerated by the tree. An area with 450 to 1125 mm of rainfall is considered suitable for the good growth [वाढ] of Neem [कडूलिंब]. Satisfactory growth [वाढ] is also found in areas with a minimum of 250 mm of rainfall. The rate of growth [वाढ] is higher in hot and dry [कोरडे] climates.

1. Seed [बियाणे] Collection and Planting Method

The seed germination [बियाणे अंकुरण] period is only 50 days from the time the seed [बियाणे] is collected from the tree. For large-scale cultivation in remote areas, sowing [पेरणी] seeds before the rainy season is more profitable and cost-effective. For this, collect the ripe fresh fruits. They should be from straight and vigorously growing trees. Separate the seeds from the pulp in the fruit, wash them with clean water [स्वच्छ पाणी], and sow [मादी डुक्कर] them immediately to get more germination [अंकुरण] capacity.

## **Care of Betel Vine**

Betel vine is a cash crop [नगदी पीक] in Vidarbha and betel vine orchards are mostly found in Akola, Amravati, Buldhana, and Yavatmal districts. The following integrated disease management [एकात्मिक रोग व्यवस्थापन] package is recommended for the management [व्यवस्थापन] of wilt disease [मररोग] of the Kapoori variety of betel vine and for better growth [वाढ] of the vines [वेली]:

**Integrated Disease Management [एकात्मिक रोग व्यवस्थापन] Package**

**Package - 1:**

a) **Trichoderma [ट्रायकोडर्मा] (Seed Treatment [बीज प्रक्रिया] + Soil [माती] Application):**

1. Mix 1 kg of Trichoderma [ट्रायकोडर्मा] with 09 liters of water and dip the seedlings in this solution before planting.
2. Mix 1 kg of Trichoderma [ट्रायकोडर्मा] powder with 09 kg of well-decomposed manure [खत] and apply 100 grams of this mixture per square meter to the soil [माती] near the roots of the vines [वेली] at monthly intervals (from June to January).

b) **Neem Cake [कडुलिंबाचा पेंढ]:** Apply 20 quintals of neem cake [कडुलिंबाचा पेंढ] per hectare in the soil [माती], divided into two applications in June and December.

c) **Salicylic Acid:** Spray 10 ppm salicylic acid on the vines [वेली] twice a year (in June and December).

d) **Chemical Fertilizers [रासायनिक खते]:** Apply Nitrogen [नत्र], Phosphorus [स्फुरद], and Potash in the ratio [प्रमाण] of 100:50:50. e) **Irrigation Management [सिंचन व्यवस्थापन]:** Use drip irrigation [ठिबक सिंचन] for irrigation management [सिंचन व्यवस्थापन].

a) Mix 10 kg of Trichoderma [ट्रायकोडर्मा] harzianum in 20 quintals/ha of Neem cake [कडुलिंबाचा पेंढ] and apply it in June and December in two parts.

जळगाव जिल्ह्यातील उपलब्ध माहितीनुसार **पोलिहाऊस प्रदर्शन युनिट** (शो-युनिट) आहे का याची नोंद मला मिळाली नाही; पण जिल्ह्यात खालील कृषी विज्ञान केंद्रांची माहिती उपलब्ध आहे.

> अंतर: ५३ कि.मी.

> अंतर: ५३ कि.मी.  

> **कृषी विज्ञान केंद्र, धुळे**

question: काल दुपारी सुटलेल्या वाऱ्यामुळे संत्रा बागेत फळगळ झाली असेल का?
answer:
कालच्या वाऱ्यामुळे संत्रा बागेत फळगळ झाली की नाही हे निश्चितपणे सांगता येत नाही, कारण उपलब्ध हवामान इतिहासात कालचा कमाल वाराही तुलनेने कमी दिसतो.

**हवामान:** अक्कलकुवा (स्टेशन आठपन्नास-सात) परिसरासाठी पंधरा मार्च २०२६ रोजी पाऊस शून्य मिमी होता, किमान तापमान तेरे डिग्री सेल्सिअस, कमाल तापमान चौरस-आठ डिग्री सेल्सिअस, आणि कमाल वारा सात-पाच कि.मी./तास नोंदला आहे.

**फळगळ कमी करण्यासाठी उपाय:**
- उन्हाळ्यात मुळाभोवती गवताची पंच सेंटीमीटर जाडीची आच्छादन ठेवावी; यामुळे मातीतील ओल टिकते व फळगळ कमी होते.
- भाहारानुसार विरळणी करणे: वाटाणा आकाराच्या फळांनंतर प्रति झाड सातशे ते नऊशे फळे ठेवण्याची शिफारस आहे; यासाठी हाताने काढणी करावी किंवा एथेफॉन साठशे पीपीएम (प्रति लीटर पाणी सहाशे मिग्रॅ) अशी फवारणी करावी.
- **काढणी:** जोरदार पावसात किंवा थेट तणजारीत धूपेत काढणी टाळावी; फळे बागेत ठेवू नयेत आणि थेट प्लास्टिक क्रेटमध्ये नेऊन सावलीत ठेवावेत.

**स्रोत: हवामान इतिहास (स्कायमेट), डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ (संत्रा फळगळ व्यवस्थापन)**

तुमची संत्रा बाग कोणत्या भाहरात आहे (मृग/अंबिया) आणि फळे वाटाणा आकाराची आहेत का??

question: माझ्या गावात काही पीक सुधारणा योजनेची नोंदणी कशी करावी?
answer:
तुमच्या कुंभारी (रेणापूर, लातूर) गावासाठी पीक सुधारणेची नोंदणी थेट पोक्रा/नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्पांतर्गत करता येणार नाही, कारण तुमचे गाव पोक्रा-नियुक्त नाही; पण महाडीबीटीवरून आणि अधिकृत बियाणे वितरकांकडून काही पीक सुधारणा घटकांची अर्ज/नोंदणी करता येते.

**पीक सुधारणेसाठी पर्याय:**
- **राष्ट्रीय अन्न आणि पोषण सुरक्षा अभियान (प्रमाणित बियाणे वितरण)**: बियाणे खरेदी करताना महाडीबीटीवरून अर्ज करून अनुदान मिळू शकते; अनुदान प्रति क्विंटल किमान **₹१०००** ते कमाल **₹५०००** (पीकानुसार) इतके असू शकते आणि प्रति शेतकरी कमाल १ हेक्टर मर्यादा आहे.
- **परदेशी अनुदान आधारित कृषी यांत्रिकीकरण (शेती यंत्रसामग्री)**: ट्रॅक्टर, पॉवर टिलर, अवजारे/उपकरणे खरेदीसाठी महाडीबीटीवरून अर्ज करता येतो; साधारणपणे खर्चाच्या ४०% ते ५०% इतके अनुदान (किंवा सरकारने ठरलेली कमाल मर्यादा) इतके असू शकते.
- **डॉ. बाबासाहेब आंबेडकर कृषी स्वावलंबन योजना**: ही योजना फक्त अनुसूचित जाती/नवबौद्ध शेतकऱ्यांसाठी आहे; तुमचा जात गटाची माहिती सामान्य दिसते म्हणून या योजनेत तुम्ही पात्र नाही.

**अर्ज कसा करावा:**
- महाडीबीटी पोर्टलवर संबंधित घटक निवडून अर्ज सादर करा; लाभार्थी निवड प्राधान्याने आधी आलेला अर्ज (एफसीएफएस) या पद्धतीने होते.
- उदाहरणार्थ शेती यंत्रसामग्री घटकात पूर्वमंजुरीनंतर खुल्या बाजारपेठेतून खरेदी करता येते; भुखरेदीचं पेमेंट तुमच्या बँक खात्यातून चेक/डीडी/ऑनलाईन करायचं असतं आणि अनुदान अनुशीलित बँक खात्यात डीबीटीने जमा होतं.
- बियाणे वितरणासाठी अधिकृत वितरकाकडून तुमच्या जमीन क्रमांकाच्या आधारे (सात-बारा) बियाणे घेताना महाडीबीटीवरून नोंदणी/अर्ज केला जातो.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

*Scheme Code*:
mahadbt-baksy

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
Maha-DBT

*Scheme Name*:
Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar Krushi Swavalamban Yojana (BAKSY)

*Main Component*:
Providing Irrigation Fscilities to the eligible beneficiaries of Scheduled Cast (SC) category

*Sub Component*:
1. New Irrigation Well
2. Old Well Repair
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds
4. Inwell Boring
5. Electricity Connection
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)
7. Solar pump (instead of electrical connection Charges and pump set)
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)
9. Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) AND
     Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements)
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden

*Introduction*:
The Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan (Special Component Scheme(scp)) was being implemented from the year 1982-83 to increase the income of Scheduled Caste / New-Buddhist farmers and improve their standard of living. Since the said scheme has been implemented for a long period of time, the GOVERNMENT OF MAHARASHTRA has decided to implement the Special Component Scheme for Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist farmers since 1982-83 and the recommendations of the Agriculture Commissionerate dated 27/04/2016 on the report dated 19/04/2016 and special component scheme the announced by the Hon'ble Minister (Finance). Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana is not being implemented separately, but the current special component scheme, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana, is being implemented from 2016-17 as per the changed criteria, taking into account the needs of the changed situation and maintaining soil moisture.
Also, the government has approved the amendment in the financial criteria and inclusion of new components under the said scheme as per the government decision dated 01 October, 2024.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    beneficiary Selection criteria are as follows
1.  Scheme is only for Scheduled Caste/ Nav Baudha farmers.
2.  Scheme is implemented in all districts of Maharashtra (Except Mumbai districts).
3. At field level  scheme is under Implementation by department of Agriculture, Zilha Parishad.
4. Funds are released from Social Justice Department to concerned  District Collector and then made available to concern Zilha Parishad.
5. Application ,Selection of beneficiaries upto payment of subsidy all process are done through MAHADBT Portal through online system.                                                                  "

*Benefits*:
Benefit provided on subsidy basis as per the norms of components, through online system. The said scheme shall be implemented in the financial year 2025-26 as follows. In the said scheme, grants shall be admissible for the following components in the year 2025-26 up to the maximum limit of the amount mentioned below.
1. For New Irrigation- Well Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Rs.4,00,000/ - is admissible.
2. For Old Well Repair - Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 1,00,000/- is admissible
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds-Grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the amount calculated as per the prevailing financial parameters of the National Horticulture Mission Guideline and the size of the farm pond or actual cost or Rs. 2,00,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
4.Inwell Boring- Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 40,000/- is admissible
5. Electricity Connection-Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Amount 20,000/- or actual paid amount whichever is less is admissible.
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)(Diesel Engine - New Item) For pump sets up to 10 HP capacity, grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial parameters or actual cost or Rs. 40,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
7. Grant Solar pump (instead of electrical connection and pump set)- Maximum subsidy will be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial criteria or actual expenditure incurred or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)- Under the Food and Nutrition Security Scheme - Food Crops Scheme, subsidy of 100% of the prevailing economic standard or actual cost incurred per meter or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less will be admissible.
9.1 For Micro irrigation system Under Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) 9.1.1) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and9.1.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 47,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy. (Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
9.2 For Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant 9.2.1 ) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and 9.2.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 97,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy.(Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements) (New item)maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden (New Item) maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible .

*Eligibility*:
1. Scheme is only for Scheduled Tribe farmers. Caste  certificate is essential.
2. Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to  6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential)
3.1 It will be mandatory for the beneficiary to be a farmer belonging to the Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist category.
3.2 The farmer must have a caste certificate issued by the competent authority.
3.3 Farmers residing the Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika is necessary to have 7/12 certificate and 8A extract of land tenure in the name of the farmer. ( Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika area (Reference Government Letter No. Sankirna- 2017/Pr.No.142/3A, dated 24 April 2018))
3.4 The beneficiaries must have their own Aadhaar link active bank account .
3.5 The beneficiaries below the poverty line will be given  first priority.
3.6 The beneficiary farmer must have a minimum of 0.40 hectares and a maximum of 6 hectares of agricultural land. If the beneficiary's land is in a remote and fragmented area and two or more beneficiaries with less than 0.40 hectares of land come together and their combined land is at least 0.40 hectares, then if they sign an agreement, they will be eligible for the benefit of the scheme. Similarly, the condition of maximum 6.0 hectares of land will not be applicable to the beneficiaries below the poverty line.
3.7 Once the full benefit of the relevant scheme is taken, the benefit of this scheme will not be payable to the same beneficiary or family for the next five years. The beneficiary who has taken the benefit of the new well component will be eligible for the benefit of the old well repair component after 20 years.
If the benefit has been given under the Special Component Scheme for similar agricultural development schemes and the scheme implemented from the funds made available under the SCA of the Central Government and Article 275 (A) of the Constitution, the benefit provided under this scheme will not be admissible.

*Required Documents*:
1. Caste Certificate of SC category issued by compitant authority
2. current 7/12 report having Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to 6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential) within the period of
3 months 3.GSDA Certificates
4. There is no income limit for this scheme

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on Mahadbt portal as follows
1. Applications from farmers are being invited for the said scheme on the Maha-DBT portal website mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/farmer/login /login and the applications received within the limit of lakhs received by the concerned talukas / blocks will be selected online on a first come, first served basis (fcfs). After selection, all the proceedings up to the payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done online. In this regard, proceedings from acceptance of application to payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done as mentioned in the referenced government decision dated 04/11/2020.
2. The Agricultural Officer (Agriculture), P.S., should conduct a site inspection of the area of the beneficiary selected for the new well and old well repair on a first come, first served basis and check the technical feasibility. After the inspection, if the location of the beneficiary's new well and the proposal for repair of the old well of the beneficiary is technically suitable, the Agricultural Development Officer should approve the budget for this matter and give prior approval to the proposals of the concerned beneficiary within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents. Similarly, the selection of the beneficiaries whose proposals are found to be technically unsuitable during the site inspection should be cancelled.
3. Beneficiaries selected for other matters other than new well and old well repair under the scheme should be given prior approval within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents and they should be given the benefit of the scheme in the current financial year 2025-26 itself.
4. The prior approval of the beneficiaries who do not implement the matters under the scheme within the prescribed period should be cancelled.
5. While selecting individual beneficiary, priority will be given to women and disabled beneficiaries. Out of the total sanctioned funds, 5 percent of the funds should be given priority to be spent on disabled beneficiaries and 30 percent of the funds should be spent on women beneficiaries.
6. As per the demand of the final selected beneficiaries as per the target of the taluka & district, a draft plan of the district should be prepared within 7 days as per Appendix No. 1, component-wise and beneficiary-wise. The responsibility of preparing the draft plan will be the responsibility of the Agricultural Development Officer.

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
DDA MECHANIZATION

*Scheme Name*:
State Sponsored Agriculture Mechanization

*Main Component*:
Benefit for Farm Machinery and Equipments.

*Sub Component*:
Tractors, power tillers, automated machinery, tractor-operated implements, tractor-operated crop protection implements, and post-harvest primary processing implements.

*Introduction*:
The declining number of livestock and the shortage of labor for agricultural work necessitate mechanization in agriculture. Mechanization allows work to be completed within a specified time frame, saves inputs, and saves production costs.
Objective:-
        Resolve labour issues in agriculture.
        Promote Farm Mechanization.
        Enable farmers to take up farm operations in time.
        Promote custom hiring services for farm mechanization.
        Create rural employment.
        Help to Increase agriculture production.

*Benefits*:
1. Financial assistance to farmers for procurement of farm machinery and implements
2. Generally, the subsidy is given at a rate of 40 % for SC, ST & small farmers, Womens & 50% for other farmers percent of the cost or the maximum subsidy limit declared by the Central Government, whichever is lower.

*Eligibility*:
Individual Farmer.

*Required Documents*:
1. Quotation of Implement to be purchase.
2. Test report of the Implement.
3. RC of tractor for tractor driven implements.

*Application Process*:
Applications from Interested farmers are invited on https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/ this portal. For transparency in beneficiary selection, presanction is being given by determining seniority through FCFS method. All the processes from beneficiary selection to grant payment are being implemented online.
After presanction, farmers are being allowed to purchase from the open market as per their choice. At the time of purchase, farmers are required to make payment through cheque/DD/online from their own bank account. The subsidy amount is being transferred to the Aadhaar-linked bank account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) method.

जळगाव बाजारात हरभऱ्याचे (हरभरा) सध्याचे बाजारभाव खालीलप्रमाणे आहेत:

- हरभरा (चafa): किमान **₹४५००**, कमाल **₹५२१०**, सरासरी **₹४९००** प्रति क्विंटल

जर तुमचा हरभरा स्वच्छ असेल आणि ओलावा साधारण असेल तर बेनिंगनंतर विक्री केली तर सरासरी भाव मिळण्याची शक्यता जास्त असते; साठवण करायची असेल तर वेल्डिंग व घाण नसलेले कोरडे गोदाम निवडा.

**Measures for Vegetable Crops in Drought [दुष्काळ] Conditions**

In drought [दुष्काळ] conditions, good market prices are obtained for vegetable crops and farmers get good benefits as vegetable cultivation is very limited due to adverse climate [हवामान] (high temperature [तापमान] and dry [कोरडे] hot air) and water scarcity [पाण्याची कमतरता]. For this, it is important to select the right vegetable crop [पीक] and get quality production [उत्पादन] from it. It is difficult to grow vegetable crops in drought [दुष्काळ] conditions, but some measures can be taken to use less water, e.g. to cultivate some vegetables by using drip and sprinkler irrigation [तुषार सिंचन]. Some important measures for this are as follows.

1. Selecting vegetable crops that require less water e.g. drumstick, hadga, guar and leafy vegetables.
2. Use of soil [माती] cover.
3. Onion [कांदा] Nursery [रोपवाटिका] Management [व्यवस्थापन].

- Onion [कांदा] crop [पीक] nursery [रोपवाटिका] should be prepared on raised beds [उंच केलेले वाफे].
- Seed treatment [बीज प्रक्रिया] should be done before sowing [पेरणी] onion [कांदा] seeds.
- Do not use too much chemical fertilizer [रासायनिक खत] on raised beds [उंच केलेले वाफे].
- Water the nursery [रोपवाटिका] before sowing [पेरणी] the seeds and sow [मादी डुक्कर] the seeds.
- Sow [मादी डुक्कर] the seeds thinly and then use a sprinkler [तुषार सिंचन] or rain gun.
- Use shed [निवारा] net on the nursery [रोपवाटिका] if possible.

1. To protect against dry [कोरडे] and hot winds, drumstick crop [पीक] or dense planting of maize [मका] should be done on all four sides of the field [शेत] or around the wind [वारा].
2. Water management [पाण्याचे व्यवस्थापन] through micro irrigation [सूक्ष्म सिंचन] methods (drip or sprinkler [तुषार सिंचन]).
3. Proper balance of chemical and organic fertilizers [सेंद्रिय खते].
4. Selecting varieties with more leaves and protecting flowers and fruits from heat through them.
5. Use of growth [वाढ] regulators (NAA 20 PPM and Boron [बोरॉन] 20 PPM) in flowering and use of transpiration [बाष्पोत्सर्जन] inhibitors on leaves.
6. Integrated management [व्यवस्थापन] of biological and chemical drugs for the protection of diseases and pests from nursery [रोपवाटिका] to fruiting.
7. To reduce the intensity of heat, use a porous plastic mesh (shed [निवारा] net).
8. Proper use of available water - especially ensure even water supply during flowering to fruit harvesting [कापणी] period and that too in the morning, morning or evening and at night (avoid watering in the hot sun).
9. Harvest [कापणी] the fruits preferably in the evening and transport the goods (in the morning) after grading [गटवारी] packaging [पॅकेजिंग].

```
Technological properties of non-bovine milk [दूध]

One of the major problems associated with non-bovine milks is the development of dairy products [दुग्धजन्य उत्पादने] that can compete with bovine dairy products [दुग्धजन्य उत्पादने]. Among the milk [दूध] of non-bovine species [प्रजाती], sheep [मेंढी] milk [दूध] is better for cheese making because of its high protein [प्रथिने], fat and calcium [कॅल्शियम] per casein unit. The milk [दूध] of other non-bovine

species [प्रजाती] is good for direct consumption; hence some technological interventions are needed to develop dairy products [दुग्धजन्य उत्पादने] conventionally made from bovine milk [दूध] (Barlowska et al., 2011). It has been stated that a considerable diversity exists in the analyzed parameters and traits of milk [दूध], which results in various directions of milk [दूध] utilization. Sheep [मेंढी] milk [दूध] with high protein [प्रथिने], including casein, and fat, make it a very good raw material for processing [प्रक्रिया], especially cheesemaking. The composition of goat [शेळी] milk [दूध] allows using it as the raw material for dairy processing [दुग्ध प्रक्रिया] and also to some extent as a therapeutical product (low content or lack of s1casein). Milk [दूध] from equine species [प्रजाती] (donkeys) have the most comparable protein [प्रथिने] composition to human milk [दूध] (low content of casein, lack of s1casein fraction and lactoglobulin, and high content of lysozyme) and additionally, characterized by a fatty acid profile distinctive from milk [दूध] of other analyzed animal species [प्रजाती]. In the nineteenth century, French scientist Louis Pasteur discovered the process of pasteurization [पाश्चुरीकरण]. According to this process, if raw milk [कच्चे दूध] is heated to a high temperature [तापमान] for a specific period and then cooled before packaging [पॅकेजिंग], its shelf life [टिकाऊपणा] increases.

- In the pasteurization [पाश्चुरीकरण] process, every particle of milk [दूध] is heated to a minimum of 63 degrees Celsius for 30 minutes or 72 degrees Celsius for 15 seconds, and then the milk [दूध] is immediately cooled down to 5 degrees Celsius.

question: पारंपरिक आणि सुधारित पद्धतीत उत्पादनाचा फरक कुठे दिसून येतो?
answer:
पारंपरिक आणि सुधारित (नैसर्गिक/सेंद्रिय) पद्धतीत उत्पादनाचा फरक प्रामुख्याने शेतात काढणीला मिळालेल्या एकूण उत्पादन, खर्च कमी झाला की वाढला, आणि नफा या तिन्ही गोष्टींमध्ये स्पष्ट दिसून येतो.

**उत्पादन:** उपलब्ध ठिकाणांच्या तुलनेत सोयाबीनसाठी पूर्ण सुधारित पॅकेज वापरल्यावर पारंपरिक जाती व पद्धतीपेक्षा साधारण २०–२५% उत्पादनवाढ निरीक्षण करण्यात आली आहे; काळे सोयाबीनसाठी ही वाढ ३५–४०% इतकी असल्याचेही नमूद आहे.

**खर्च व नफा:** एका ताकलेल्या शेतकऱ्याच्या नैसर्गिक शेती-उदाहरणात केळीची उत्पादन १ हे. क्षेत्रात १०० क्विंटल तर पारंपरिक पद्धतीत ७० क्विंटल, आणि नफा अनुक्रमे **₹३,६०,०००** व **₹२,०५,०००** असा फरक दाखवला आहे.

**गुणवत्ता व माती:** सुधारित पद्धतीत भाजीपाला, फळे यांची चव व गुणवत्ता चांगली राहिली आणि मातीची गुणवत्ता सुधारली असे उल्लेख आहेत; तसेच प्राकृतिक आपत्तीवेळी नैसर्गिक पद्धतीतील भातशेताची मुळे व गोडवे जड घट्ट राहिल्याने नुकसान कमी दिसल्याचेही निरीक्षण दिले आहे.

**स्रोत: आयसीएआर वार्षिक अहवाल २०२३–२४; नैसर्गिक शेती प्रशिक्षण टूलकिट व सर्वोत्तम पद्धती मार्गदर्शक?**

तुम्हाला कोणत्या पिकासाठी (भात/गहू/सोयाबीन/भुईमुग/केळी) हा फरक तुलनेने पाहायचा आहे??

1.6 Conventional Farming [पारंपरिक शेती] v/s Organic Farming [सेंद्रिय शेती] v/s Natural Farming [नैसर्गिक शेती]

Both natural and organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती] represent sustainable agricultural models, but they differ significantly. Organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती] allows the use of certain organic fertilizers [सेंद्रिय खते] and bio-pesticides [जैविक कीटकनाशके] produced outside, whereas natural farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] completely avoids external inputs, relying instead on natural biological products. By emphasizing self-sustaining ecosystems, natural farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] eliminates the dependency on external fertilizers and pesticides, making it a cost-effective and environmentally friendly alternative to conventional and organic farming practices [सेंद्रिय शेती पद्धती]. The differences between conventional farming [पारंपरिक शेती], organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती] and natural farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] are given in Table 1.1.

|-------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Focus | Input intensive system [शून्य चराई], focusing on increasing production [उत्पादन] with less attention on biodiversity conservation [जैवविविधता संवर्धन] | Usage of organic inputs [सेंद्रिय निविष्ठा] to produce crops and improve soil health [मृदा आरोग्य], maintain biodiversity [जैवविविधता] and sustainability | Using organic inputs [सेंद्रिय निविष्ठा] prepared locally at the farm level, and improving soil health [मृदा आरोग्य], biodiversity conservation [जैवविविधता संवर्धन] and sustainability |
| Use of Chemicals | Heavy use of synthetic fertilizers [रासायनिक खत], pesticides, herbicides [तणनाशके] | Uses organic [सेंद्रिय] bio-pesticides [जैविक कीटकनाशके] & organic fertilizers [सेंद्रिय खते] | Use of farm-made bio stimulants and natural farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] inputs |

- 1.8.7 Utilisation of Indigenous and Locally Adapted Seeds: The use of locally sourced and traditional seeds is mandated. This practice ensures that crop varieties [पिकांच्या जाती] are well-suited to local climate [हवामान] and soil [माती] conditions, thereby contributing to the preservation of agricultural biodiversity [कृषी जैवविविधता]. Reliance on commercially produced hybrid or genetically modified seeds [आनुवंशिकदृष्ट्या सुधारित बियाणे] is to be avoided.
- 1.8.8 Role of Biodiversity [जैवविविधता] in Natural Farming [नैसर्गिक शेती]: Natural Farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] systems that integrate legumes, crop [पीक] mixtures, and biological inputs significantly enhance rhizosphere [मूलक्षेत्र] biodiversity [जैवविविधता], microbial activity [सूक्ष्मजैविक क्रिया], and nutrient uptake [अन्नद्रव्य सेवन] efficiency, while reducing reliance on synthetic fertilisers, e.g., legume [शिंबीवर्गीय वनस्पती] intercropping [आंतरपीक] in strawberries (BMC Plant Biology, 2025). Intercropping [आंतरपीक] with legumes has been demonstrated to improve crop productivity [पीक उत्पादकता], reduce input costs, and enhance soil fertility [मृदा सुपीकता] (Frontiers in Sustainable Food Systems, 2022). Additionally, practices in Southeast India, characterised by the use of on-farm biomass [वनस्पती झाडे पीके व शैवाल यापासुन निर्माण होणारा सेंद्रीय पदार्थ] and mulching [आच्छादन], improve soil quality [मृदा गुणवत्ता] and crop [पीक] outcomes compared to both conventional and organic [सेंद्रिय] systems (Agronomy [कृषीशास्त्र] for Sustainable Development, 2023). Such biodiversity [जैवविविधता]-rich systems promote long-term agroecosystem [कृषी परिसंस्था] resilience, foster sustainable nutrient cycling [पोषण चक्र], and reduce dependency on synthetic inputs.
- 1.8.9 Integration of Livestock [पशुधन], Agroforestry [कृषिवनशास्त्र], and Beekeeping [मधमाशी पालन]: Integrative farm systems that combine livestock [पशुधन], trees, crops, and beekeeping [मधमाशी पालन] offer multiple ecological and economic benefits essential to natural farming [नैसर्गिक शेती]. Livestock [पशुधन] provide manure [खत] and urine [मूत्र], which feed soil [माती] micro-organisms, enhance organic matter [सेंद्रिय पदार्थ], and aid in bio-input production [उत्पादन]. In the case of mango [आंबा] (Kesar variety), natural farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] gave 175 quintals of production [उत्पादन] and a profit [नफा] of 5,25,000, with a benefit-cost ratio [लाभ-खर्च गुणोत्तर] of 6.25, compared to conventional farming [पारंपरिक शेती] which gave 150 quintals, a profit [नफा] of 3,37,500, and a ratio [प्रमाण] of 3.07. For dragon fruit [ड्रैगन फ्रूट] (red variety), natural farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] resulted in 125 quintals of production [उत्पादन] and a net profit [नफा] of 19,38,750, with a benefit-cost ratio [लाभ-खर्च गुणोत्तर] of 7.23, while conventional farming [पारंपरिक शेती] produced 100 quintals with a profit [नफा] of 13,50,000 and a ratio [प्रमाण] of 4.64.

Both natural and organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती] represent sustainable agricultural models, but they differ significantly. Organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती] allows the use of certain organic fertilizers [सेंद्रिय खते] and bio-pesticides [जैविक कीटकनाशके] produced outside, whereas natural farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] completely avoids external inputs, relying instead on natural biological products. By emphasizing self-sustaining ecosystems, natural farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] eliminates the dependency on external fertilizers and pesticides, making it a cost-effective and environmentally friendly alternative to conventional and organic farming practices [सेंद्रिय शेती पद्धती]. The differences between conventional farming [पारंपरिक शेती], organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती] and natural farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] are given in Table 1.1.

question: आल्यावरील कंदकुज व्याधीचे व्यवस्थापन कसे करावे?

आल्यावर कंदकुज/मुळकुज आला तर पाणी साचणे कमी करून रोगट आले वेगळे करून नष्ट करा, आणि लागवडीपूर्वी कंदांना मेटालेक्सिल द्रावणात बुडवण्याचा उपाय केल्यास नियंत्रण मिळते.

**माती व पाणी व्यवस्थापन:**
- जमिनीत पाणी साचणार असेल तर निचरा योग्य ठेवा; पाऊस जास्त झाला तरी शेतातील ओल धरून राहू देऊ नका.

**लागवड सामग्री:**
- मुळकुज रोग असलेल्या शेतातील कंद लागवडीसाठी घेत नाहीत.
- रोगमुक्त साठवणुकीतून स्वस्थ कंद वापरूनच लागवड करा.

**कंद प्रक्रिया (मुळकुज नियंत्रण):**
- कंद ५ मिनिटांनी मेटालेक्सिल ०.३% + मॅन्कोझेब या द्रावणात बुडवा.

**प्रतिबंधक उपाय (कंदमाशीमुळे कंदकुज वाढू नये म्हणून):**
- हंगाम संपल्यानंतर शेतातील बाकीचे कंद व पिकाचे अवशेष गोळा करून नष्ट करा; संक्रमित कंद साठवणुकीत ठेवू नका.

The maggot is yellowish-white, legless, and tapers towards the head. The maggot bores into the ginger [आले] rhizome [कंद]. Its entry allows fungal diseases like Pythium and Fusarium to thrive, causing the rhizomes to soften and rot. Leaves turn yellow, and the entire plant dries up.
(कंदमाशी मुंगळ्याच्या आकाराची काळसर रंगाची असून तिचे पाय शरिरापेक्षा लांब असतात. कंदमाशीचे पंख पारदर्शक असून त्यावर राखाडी रंगाचे ठिपके असतात. या किडीची अंडी लहान, पांढरी व आकाराने लांबट असतात. अळी पिवळसर पांढरी, पाय नसलेली व डोक्याकडे निमुळती होत गेलेली असते. अळी अद्रकाचे कंद पोखरून आत शिरते. अळ्या कंदामध्ये शिरकाव केल्यामुळे पिथीयम, फ्युज्यरियम या बुरशीजन्य रोगाची वाढ होते. त्यामुळे कंद मऊ पडून कुजु लागतात. तसेच पाने पिवळी पडून संपूर्ण झाड वाळून जाते.)

**MPKV Krishi Darshani**
```
Intercrops: Ginger [आले] crop [पीक] grows well in 25% shade, so this crop [पीक] should be grown in coconut [नारळ], betel nut, coffee [कॉफी] gardens. Intercrops like coriander [कोथिंबीर], marigold [झेंडू], tur, guar, chili etc. should be grown.  
Weed Control [तण नियंत्रण]: Spray Antrazine pre-emergence [उगवण] weedicide [तणनाशक] 50 gm in 10 liters of water on the second to third day after ginger [आले] planting when the soil [माती] is moist [ओले]. Do not spray any weedicide [तणनाशक] after ginger [आले] germination [अंकुरण]. Weed 2 to 3 times as per the intensity of weeds [तण].  
Interculture: Weeding [तण काढणे] should be done 2.5 to 3 months after ginger [आले] planting. In this, the soil [माती] is loosened with a long-handled hoe [डवरा]. This breaks the roots and new fibrous roots sprout [अंकुर] at that place.  
Water Management [पाण्याचे व्यवस्थापन]: Give water at intervals of 8 to 10 days as per the soil texture [जमीनीचा पोत]. Yield [उत्पादन] increases if drip or sprinkler [तुषार सिंचन] micro irrigation [सूक्ष्म सिंचन] method is used.  
Harvesting [कापणी]: 8 to 10 months after planting, when the leaves turn yellow or dry [कोरडे], harvest [कापणी] by digging with a spade [फावडा].  
Yield [उत्पादन]: 15 to 20 tons / hectare.  
Crop Protection [पीक संरक्षण]: Larvae enter the open rhizomes and subsist on the rhizomes. Subsequently, pathogenic fungi and nematodes enter such rhizomes. Due to this, the stem and rhizomes become soft and water is released from them and they rot.  
Rhizome [कंद] Fly Control: Earthing up [भर देणे] should be done in time. Use 6 soil [माती] or plastic spreading containers per hectare and take 200 gm of crushed castor [एरंड] seeds + 1.5 liters of water in each container. After 8 to 10 days, when the smell starts coming out of this mixture, the rhizome [कंद] fly gets attracted and dies. Since this measure is very effective, low cost and easy to do, it can play an important role in organic [सेंद्रिय] ginger [आले] production [उत्पादन]. Also, since the rhizome [कंद] flies [माशी] die before damaging the rhizome [कंद] by the larvae, it is particularly effective.  
Leaf Spots (Blight [करपा]): Oval elongated tan-colored ovoid spots appear on the leaves. The diseased part dries up and looks reddish brown.  
Control: Use disease [रोग] free seed [बियाणे] for planting.
```

While doing ultra-dense planting, some things need to be taken care of, such as planting should be done in a rectangular pattern instead of a square pattern, i.e. keep very little distance on one side and keep the normal distance on the other side if the rows are south-north, the trees can make very good use of the sunlight throughout the day.

**Krishi Darshani Dr BSKKV, Dapoli 2025**
```
Propagation [प्रजनन]: Ginger [आले] is planted from swollen eye rhizomes. Approximately 2530-gram [हरभरा] rhizomes (pieces) are used for planting, taken from disease [रोग]-free storage [साठवण]. It should have 1-2 juicy eyes [डोळे]. 1,500 to 1,800 kg of seed [बियाणे] is required per hectare.

Season and Planting Method: The land should be ploughed to a depth of 15 to 20 cm with a plough [नांगर], and the clods should be broken to make it loose. While preparing the land, give 25 to 30 tons of farmyard manure [शेणखत] or compost [कंपोस्ट] per hectare. Ginger [आले] is planted on flat beds, in a broad bed method, or a furrow [सरी] method. Planting in the first week of May increases the yield [उत्पादन]. If the soil [माती] is light [प्रकाश], make flat beds of 3 X 2 meters. In medium and heavy soils, prepare ridge and furrow [सरी व वरंबा]; while doing this, keep the distance between the two ridges 60 cm. Make raised beds [उंच केलेले वाफे] 20 cm high, 3 meters long, and 1 meter wide.

Fertilizer [खत] and Water Management [पाण्याचे व्यवस्थापन]: For higher production [उत्पादन], give 25-30 tons of decomposed farmyard manure [शेणखत] per hectare before planting. 75 kg of nitrogen [नत्र], 50 kg of phosphorus [स्फुरद], and 25 kg of potash per hectare should be given to the ginger [आले] crop [पीक] in the form of chemical fertilizer [रासायनिक खत]. While planting ginger [आले], mix half of the nitrogen [नत्र] dose [मात्रा], i.e., 37.5 kg, 50 kg of phosphorus [स्फुरद], and 25 kg of potash into the soil [माती]. After 40 days of planting, give half of the nitrogen [नत्र], i.e., 37.5 kg per hectare. It is necessary to control weeds [तण] 30 days after this nitrogen [नत्र] dose [मात्रा]. Water management [पाण्याचे व्यवस्थापन] is essential after planting ginger [आले]. For this, water should be given 6 to 8 days after the monsoon [पावसाळा] ends.
```

**Objectives of Watershed Development Program**

1. To reduce soil erosion [जमीनीची धुप] caused by the flow of water over the land.
2. To percolate the rainwater that falls in the watershed area into the soil [माती].
3. To store the rainwater flowing from the land in the watershed at appropriate places.
4. To increase the groundwater storage [साठवण] in the watershed, to plant trees by digging ditches on sloping and barren lands.
5. To make efficient use of the water stored in the watershed.
6. To improve the degraded land in the watershed.
7. To maintain the balance of the environment in the watershed.
8. To improve the economic development of the people in the watershed and raise their living standards.

In order to achieve the various objectives of the watershed development program, the following measures of soil [माती] and water conservation [पाण्याचे संवर्धन] should be adopted according to the need, taking into account the land, crops, cropping systems, geology, streams, drains, etc. in the watershed.

1. Contour bunding [समोच्च बंधारे].
2. Graded bunding.
3. Terracing in highly sloping hilly areas.
4. Planting trees by digging ditches on sloping and barren lands.
5. Carrying out temporary or permanent treatments for gully control.
6. Creating farm ponds, village ponds, percolation [पाझरण] tanks, etc. for water storage [साठवण].
7. Nala straightening and nala bunding.
8. Building subsurface barriers.

Along with these protective and developmental measures of soil [माती] and water conservation [पाण्याचे संवर्धन], the following improved technology-related aspects should be adopted at the farm level.

1. Planting crops according to the classification of land.
2. Contour cultivation as well as biological bunding.
3. Adopting strip cropping [पट्टा शेती] method.
4. Conserved tillage [जमिनीची मशागत].
5. Agroforestry [कृषिवनशास्त्र], horticulture [उद्यानविद्या], and pasture [कुरण क्षेत्र] development.
6. Proper crop rotation [पीक फेरपालट].
7. Using high-quality seeds, fertilizers, and crop protection [पीक संरक्षण] measures.
8. Using protected irrigation [सिंचन] for dryland crops.

**In Maharashtra, approximately 75 types of nematodes have been found to infest various crops. Among these, root-knot nematodes, cyst nematodes [गाठी निर्माण करणारे सुत्र कृमी], nematodes affecting leguminous crops [शेंगायुक्त पीक], Radopholus, and Dagger nematodes are the important species [प्रजाती].**

**Nematode Control [सूत्रकृमी नियंत्रण] Measures**

**Since the use of nematicides is very expensive and difficult, preventive measures are beneficial.**

1. **Before planting the crop [पीक], plough [नांगर] the soil [माती] deeply and allow it to heat up well. This kills the nematode [सूत्रकृमी] stages in the soil [माती] due to the heat of the sun.**
2. **Crop rotation [पीक फेरपालट] should be practiced. It has been found that taking monocot crops after dicot crops is beneficial. Where crop rotation [पीक फेरपालट] is not possible, e.g., with fruit trees, intercrops like African or French marigold [झेंडू] should be grown. Marigold [झेंडू] roots contain chemicals with nematicidal properties, which control nematodes.**
3. **Do not raise seedlings or grafts in nematode [सूत्रकृमी]-infested soil [माती].**
4. **"Phule Tricoderma Plus" produced by Biological Pest Control [जैविक कीड नियंत्रण] Laboratory, Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri should be mixed with 1000 liters of water at the rate of 20 kg/ha and applied to each fruit tree in equal quantity or mixing at least 100 kg of well-decomposed farmyard manure [शेणखत] per hectare in the soil [माती] in equal amount to fruit trees is very effective against root rot [मुळ कुज] and nematode infestation [सूत्रकृमींचा प्रादुर्भाव].**
5. **While raising seedlings or grafts for nematode control [सूत्रकृमी नियंत्रण], and also while sowing [पेरणी] vegetables and pulses, mix Carbofuran [कार्बोफ्युरान] 3% granules [कण] in the soil [माती] at a rate of 65 kg/ha and water. In fruit trees, give double the dose [मात्रा] of these nematicides at the time of bud break [कळी फूट] or pruning [फांद्या छाटणी] and water lightly.**

3.6 Intercropping [आंतरपीक]

Intercropping [आंतरपीक] involves cultivating two or more crops simultaneously in the same field [शेत] with a definite or alternate row pattern (Fig [अंजीर]. 3.4). The benefits of intercropping [आंतरपीक] are better soil [माती] coverage (thus, reducing direct impact of raindrops), erosion control [धुपनियंत्रण] and nutrient management [अन्नद्रव्य व्यवस्थापन] (crops with different rooting patterns help in efficient nutrient [पोषक घटक] use and prevent nutrient [पोषक घटक] competition). The key considerations to be considered in intercropping [आंतरपीक] are:

- Time and Spatial Dimensions: Intercropping [आंतरपीक] involves both time-based and spatial planning.
- Erosion Permitting and Resisting Crops: Should be intercropped to optimise soil [माती] protection.
- Rooting Patterns: The crops should have different rooting patterns to maximise soil [माती] and nutrient [पोषक घटक] benefits.

Fig [अंजीर]. 3.4: Intercropping [आंतरपीक] Practice

The different types of intercropping [आंतरपीक] techniques are discussed below. Fig [अंजीर]. 3.5 shows an example of intercropping [आंतरपीक].

- Row Intercropping [आंतरपीक]: Crops are grown in specific rows.
- Strip Intercropping [पट्ट्या पद्धतीची आंतरपीक लागवड]: Crops are grown in strips.
- Relay Intercropping [आंतरपीक]: Different crops are sown at different times to overlap their growing periods.

(vi) Intercrops

- Papaya [पपई] is an intercrop of mango [आंबा], guava [पेरू], orange [संत्री], sweet lime [मोसंबी], chikoo, and litchi [लीची].
- Along with these, drumstick, pigeon pea [तूर], colocasia/taro [अळू], chili, ginger [आले], turmeric [हळद], cowpea [चवळी], onion [कांदा], marigold [झेंडू], tomato [टोमॅटो], brinjal [वांगे], black gram [उडीद], cluster beans, and cucurbitaceous vegetables can be taken.
- Plant drumstick between two rows and sow [मादी डुक्कर] pigeon pea [तूर] in furrows at 8 feet distance.
- Sow [मादी डुक्कर] drumstick in one line and pigeon pea [तूर] in another line alternately.
- In the second and fourth rows, plant cowpea [चवळी], chili, and marigold [झेंडू].
- In the third row, sow [मादी डुक्कर] cucurbitaceous vegetables.
- In this way intercrops can be planted throughout the field [शेत].

(vii) Mulching [आच्छादन]

- Do mulching [आच्छादन] on both sides of furrows between two rows of papaya [पपई].
- Intercrops help in weed control [तण नियंत्रण]. If weeds [तण] appear, uproot and leave them there itself.
- After the intercrop duration is over, dry [कोरडे] leaves and plants will act as dry [कोरडे] mulching [आच्छादन].
- According to the season, sow [मादी डुक्कर] new intercrops to obtain live mulching [आच्छादन].

3.7 Strip Cropping [पट्टा शेती]

Cultivating various cropsin alternating strips across a field [शेत] is called strip cropping [पट्टा शेती]. It involves growing erosion-resistant crops with deep root systems and high canopy [पर्णछाया] density. These crops protect soil [माती] from raindrop impact, reduce runoff [वाहून जाणारे पाणी] velocity, and increase concentration time, resulting in higher soil moisture [मातीचा ओलावा] and crop [पीक] production [उत्पादन]. The benefits of strip cropping [पट्टा शेती] are primarily for runoff [वाहून जाणारे पाणी] and erosion control [धुपनियंत्रण], as it reduces runoff [वाहून जाणारे पाणी] velocity and checks erosion

processes. This way, even nutrient [पोषक घटक] loss from the field [शेत] can be minimised, and soil fertility [मृदा सुपीकता] is maintained. Strip cropping [पट्टा शेती] is exemplified in the five-layer [अंडी देणारी कोंबडी] model in natural farming [नैसर्गिक शेती], which promotes diverse and resilient cropping systems (Fig [अंजीर]. 3.6.).

The different types of strip cropping [पट्टा शेती] are discussed below.

3.7.1 Contour Strip Cropping [पट्टा शेती]

This method involves planting alternating strips of crops that either allow or resist erosion along the natural contours of a slope. The advantages [फायदे] of this technique are that it reduces the force of raindrops hitting the soil [माती], preventing erosion. Additionally, it shortens the slope length and slows water movement, thereby decreasing soil [माती] loss and managing runoff [वाहून जाणारे पाणी]. It enhances rainwater absorption into the soil profile [मृदा छेदिका], improving soil moisture [मातीचा ओलावा] levels.

question: तेलबिया पिकांना स्फुरद (Phosphorus) कसे द्यावे?
answer:
तेलबिया पिकांना स्फुरद देण्यासाठी पूर्णपणे विद्राव्य स्फुरदयुक्त खत निवडा आणि शक्य असेल तर स्फुरद विरघळविणारे जिवाणू (पी.एस.बी.) वापरून स्फुरदाची उपलब्धता वाढवा.

**खत निवड:**
- स्फुरद उपलब्ध होण्यासाठी पूर्णपणे विद्राव्य खते निवडा: सिंगल सुपर फॉस्फेट, डायअमोनियम फॉस्फेट  
- तेलबिया पिकांसाठी गंधकाची गरज असल्याने गंधकायुक्त स्फुरदयुक्त पर्याय उपयोगी ठरतात: सिंगल सुपर फॉस्फेट, अमोनियम फॉस्फेट इ.

**उत्तम परिणामासाठी जिवाणू (पी.एस.बी.):**
- बीज प्रक्रिया: २५ मि.ली./किग्रा बियाणे  
- रोपे भरपूर/म्होडी करताना: ५०० मि.ली./१० ली. पाणी प्रति एकर  
- मातीमध्ये देताना: २ ली. द्रव पी.एस.बी. ५० किग्रा शेणखतात मिसळून शेतात एकसमान देणे

**शेतकरी काळजी:**
- जीवाणू कवंशी रोगनाशके/कीटकनाशके किंवा रासायनिक खतांबरोबर मिसळू नका  
- वापरताना माती ओलसर असणे आवश्यक आहे

**स्रोत: एम.पी.के.व्ही. कृषी दर्शनी; कृषी व्हीएनएम.ए.यू. (एकात्मिक पोषण व्यवस्थापन)**

तुमचे कोणते तेलबिया पीक आहे (करडई, सूर्यफुल, ज्वारीसारखे नसलेले), आणि पेरणी आधी की नंतर स्फुरद देऊ इच्छिता?

**Integrated Nutrient Management [एकात्मिक पोषण व्यवस्थापन] (INM):**

The method of using organic fertilizers [सेंद्रिय खते], green manures, bacterial fertilizers, and organic [सेंद्रिय] liquids in appropriate proportions as complementary fertilizers along with chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते] is called Integrated Nutrient Management [एकात्मिक पोषण व्यवस्थापन].

In this method, a balance is maintained between chemical, organic [सेंद्रिय], and biological fertilizers [जैविक खत]. Also, by including leguminous crops [शेंगायुक्त पीक] in crop rotation [पीक फेरपालट], soil fertility [मृदा सुपीकता] is maintained. In this method, along with bumper crop [पीक] production [उत्पादन], the quality of food grains [धान्ये] and soil [माती] is also improved. By saving expensive chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते], soil productivity [मृदा उत्पादकता] is continuously improved year after year. In this method, generally half of the total requirement of nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] is supplied through chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते], and the remaining half is supplied through organic fertilizers [सेंद्रिय खते]. It is recommended to take green manure crops [हिरवळीची खतपिके] and bury them in the soil [माती] once every three years. All crop [पीक] residues like sugarcane [ऊस] trash, sorghum [ज्वारी] stalks, wheat [गहू] and paddy stubble [खुंट], sunflower [सुर्यफुल] stalks, and all residues of pulse [डाळ] crops, etc., are buried in the soil [माती] to increase the amount of organic matter [सेंद्रिय पदार्थ]. Along with this, it is necessary to use bacterial fertilizers and vermicompost [गांडूळखत].

**The following points should be considered while selecting chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते]:**

1. For long-term crops, compound fertilizers should be used (Nitrophosphate 15:15:15) (Ammo. Phosphate 28:28:0).
2. To facilitate the availability of phosphorus [स्फुरद], completely soluble fertilizers should be selected. E.g., Single Super Phosphate, Diammonium Phosphate.
3. Sulfur-containing fertilizers should be included for pulses and oilseeds. E.g., Ammonium Sulfate, Single Super Phosphate, Ammo. Phosphate, Sulfate.
4. To increase the efficiency of phosphorus [स्फुरद], phosphorus [स्फुरद]-solubilizing bacteria [जीवाणू] (PSB) fertilizers should be used.
5. To increase the efficiency of nitrogenous fertilizers, coated urea [यूरिया] should be used. (Neem [कडूलिंब] Coated Urea [यूरिया], Sulfur Coated Urea [यूरिया].)
6. Glyricidia or young branches of Subabul [सुबाभळ] should be used as green manures.
7. Sugarcane [ऊस] molasses [मोलासेस] from sugar factories, bacterial fertilizers (Bio Earth Compost [कंपोस्ट]) should be used.

answer:
वांग्यावर शेंडा व फळी पोकळणारी अळी (फळ पोखरणारी अळी) नियंत्रणासाठी कामगंध सापळा हा मुख्यतः निगराणी आणि मोठ्या संख्येने गोंडस पकडून पुढील प्रजनन कमी करण्यासाठी वापरतात, म्हणून तो एकटाच पूर्ण नियंत्रण मानला जात नाही.

- पेरा/लागवडीनंतर साधारण २० दिवसांच्या आधीपासून कामगंध सापळे शेतात लावा
- सापळा पीक पर्णसंभार उंचीवरच ठेवा

**आमिष बदल:**
- आमिष २ ते ३ आठवड्यांनी बदला

- आठवड्याला एकदा शेंडे व फळे अवशेष काढून टाका (किंवा खोल खाचेत गाडा)

**Insects release a mixture of chemicals with a specific odor from their bodies to communicate with members of their own species [प्रजाती]. These chemicals create a specific reaction in them and perform the function of communication, and are called pheromones. Currently, artificially produced pheromones of some insects are available in the market for sale.**

**Pheromones are widely used to find efficient mates for mating. Insects of the opposite sex are attracted to each other for mating by its smell. We can use it for the following reasons.**

1. **To monitor pests through traps [सापळे].**
2. **To destroy the pests by catching moths in large numbers in the trap.**
3. **To prevent reproduction by creating obstacles in the mating of insects.**

**Pheromone traps [फेरोमोन सापळे] are mainly used to initiate pest control [कीड नियंत्रण] operations in various crops. For monitoring, 5 traps [सापळे] are sufficient in one hectare of area. A number is fixed as to how many moths should be trapped in the trap to start crop protection [पीक संरक्षण] measures. For example, if an average of 8 to 10 moths of pod borer [शेंगा पोखरणारी अळी] are found continuously for 2-3 days in each trap, then it is necessary to immediately implement pest control [कीड नियंत्रण] measures.**

**Pheromone traps [फेरोमोन सापळे] can be used to catch moths when the number of pests is very low. For this, 10 to 12 pheromone traps [फेरोमोन सापळे] are installed in one hectare of area and moths are caught in large numbers, which helps in reducing further reproduction. To create obstacles in the mating of insects, the subtle odor of sex pheromone [फेरोमोन] chemical spreads in the atmosphere through the trap. Due to this, the insects are deceived while searching for a mate for mating. As a result, there is no reproduction because they do not mate. Therefore, a decrease in the number of insects in the next generation is observed. Currently, pheromone traps [फेरोमोन सापळे] for pod borer [शेंगा पोखरणारी अळी], Spodoptera larva on soybean [सोयाबीन], larvae on eggplant, okra [भेंडी], cabbage [पत्ता कोबी], sugarcane [ऊस], cotton [कापूस], and fruit fly [फळमाशी] are available in the market. Their price is Rs. 50 to 125 per trap. Pheromones are changed every 2 to 3 weeks. Their price is Rs. 10 to 50 per lure [आमिष].**

Afterwards, well-decomposed farmyard manure [शेणखत] or compost [कंपोस्ट] manure [खत] should be applied at a rate of 20 tons per hectare.

**Selection of Variety:** Many varieties of mulberry [तुती] have been released by the Central Sericultural Research and Training [प्रशिक्षण] Institute (CSRTI), Mysore, Karnataka. As the successful production [उत्पादन] of sericulture [रेशीमकीटक पालन] depends 38.2% on the availability of nutritious mulberry leaves [तुतीचे पाने], selecting the right variety for cultivation is crucial. Today, M-1635, Kanva, S-13, and S-54 varieties are well-growing and yield [उत्पादन] high leaf production [उत्पादन] in the state. Improved varieties such as V1, G2, and G4 have been developed in Mysore, and these varieties can yield [उत्पादन] up to 20-25 thousand kg of leaves per acre. These varieties are highly beneficial for cultivation with increased fertilizer application [खत देणे] and in good quality soils.
