**Storage [साठवण]:** Gooseberry fruits can be stored for one week in an uncontrolled environment and up to 3 weeks in a controlled environment.

**Pests and Diseases:** Gooseberry is damaged by aphids [मापकीड], caterpillars, and red spider mites [अळ्या]. Leaf spots, root rot [मुळ कुज], dieback [शेंडे मर], and rust [गंज रोग] are the diseases that can occur.

## **Avocado [नाशपती]**

**Climate [हवामान]:** The avocado [नाशपती] fruit crop [पीक] is grown in tropical regions. This crop [पीक] requires a temperature [तापमान] of 12 to 28 degrees Celsius and an average annual rainfall of 650 to 1500 millimeters.

**Soil [माती]:** These fruit trees grow well in well-drained fertile soil [माती]. The pH of the soil [माती] should be 5 to 7 and the proportion of fine soil [माती] particles should be 20 to 40%. This fruit crop [पीक] falls into the highly sensitive group in terms of salt tolerance [क्षार सहनशीलता], so the salinity [खारटपणा] (EC) of the soil [माती] and irrigation water [सिंचन पाणी] must be low.

**Varieties:** There are mainly three types of this crop [पीक]: West Indian, Guatemalan, and Mexican. Among these, West Indian varieties grow well in humid and tropical climates. For planting in our region, use grafts of Arka Supreme, Arka Coog, TKD, Pinkerton, Haas, Lula etc. varieties.

**Planting:** For planting this crop [पीक], dig pits of one cubic meter size at a distance of 10 x 10 meters or 5 x 5 meters in summer, and fill these pits with a mixture of well-decomposed farmyard manure [शेणखत], compost [कंपोस्ट], soil [माती], and one to one and a half kg of single superphosphate fertilizer [खत], and planting should be done at the beginning of the rainy season.

## **Greenhouse Technology [हरितगृह तंत्रज्ञान]**

**Greenhouse [हरितगृह] Construction:** Greenhouses are mainly used for growing seasonal and off-seasonal crops [हंगामी पीके], for producing high-quality flowers, and for growing tissue-cultured plants and preparing nurseries.

**Types of Greenhouses**

a) Climate [हवामान]-Controlled Greenhouse [हरितगृह]: In this type of greenhouse [हरितगृह], temperature [तापमान] and humidity [आर्द्रता] are controlled using various technologies. Foggers are used in this to control the climate [हवामान] according to the needs of the crops. Air ventilation [हवेची आदळ] fans and cellulose pads are required for this type of greenhouse [हरितगृह]. Electricity is required for fans, pads, and micro-irrigation [सूक्ष्म सिंचन]. Similarly, electrical pumps and pipe connections are required for supplying water to the pads.

b) Natural Ventilation [हवेची आदळ] Greenhouse [हरितगृह]: This type of greenhouse [हरितगृह] is based on natural ventilation [हवेची आदळ], and based on this, the temperature [तापमान], humidity [आर्द्रता], and carbon dioxide levels can be maintained as per the requirements of the crops. Plastic netting (insect net [कीटक जाळी]) is used to prevent the entry of insects and bacteria [जीवाणू].

The elevated vent provided for greenhouse [हरितगृह] ventilation [हवेची आदळ] should open towards the north or east, which helps in keeping the greenhouse [हरितगृह] temperature [तापमान] low. For ventilation [हवेची आदळ] in the greenhouse [हरितगृह], there should be a provision to keep 30% of the total area open to allow cool air to enter and warm air to exit. To control the temperature [तापमान] in the greenhouse [हरितगृह], it is necessary to have an ultra-fine spray unit, fogging system. A 50% white UV-stabilized shade net [सावलीच्या जाळीचे कवच] should be used on the roof and a 35% shade net [सावलीच्या जाळीचे कवच] on the sides, as per the needs of the crops.

**Site Selection [ठिकाण निवड] for Greenhouse [हरितगृह]**

If the soil [माती] is black and does not have good drainage, a two-inch thick layer [अंडी देणारी कोंबडी] of sand should be applied and beds should be prepared on it, and a trench of 1.5 x 1.5 feet size should be dug around the greenhouse [हरितगृह] so that the water is properly drained. Select a site where the greenhouse [हरितगृह] can get plenty of sunlight. If the land in the field [शेत] is uneven, the selected site should be leveled. Waterlogged areas should not be used for greenhouses. Do not select a site in the shade of large trees or in the shade of buildings or in the shelter [आश्रयस्थान] of buildings. Water supply facilities should be nearby. The pH of the water should be between 6.0 and 7.5, and the salinity [खारटपणा] should be at most 0.1 to 0.5 m.l. Mohs/cm. Electricity supply is required.

**Emerging Trends in Livestock Nutrition for Health and Production**
```
SOIL [माती]-PLANT-MINERAL-ANIMAL RELATIONSHIP

Several factors regulate the transfer of minerals [खनिजे] from soils to plants and from plants to animals. Soil [माती] characteristics (pH, moisture), the type of plant (green fodder [हिरवा चारा], legume [शिंबीवर्गीय वनस्पती] and mature straws etc.), the physiological status [शारीरिक स्थिती] of the animal (growing, pregnant, lactating) and the accompanying feed, all of these individually and/or collectively contribute to the mineral uptake and utilization. The availability of minerals [खनिजे] in soil [माती] depends upon their effective concentration in soil [माती] solution and is also influenced by soil acidity [मृदा आम्लता], moisture, temperature [तापमान], plant variety, fertilization [निषेचन], organic matter [सेंद्रिय पदार्थ] and microbial activity [सूक्ष्मजैविक क्रिया] of soil [माती]. With the passage of green revolution [हरित क्रांती], deficiency of micronutrients [सुक्ष्म अन्नद्रव्ये] was observed widely in several Indian soils and crops. While soilplant-animal relationship may point towards area problem of specific mineral deficiency [खनिजाची कमतरता], the relationship is not linear in many situations. However, there is a good response to zinc application [झिंक वापर] to Zn deficient soils in terms of increase in Zn content in green fodder [हिरवा चारा] and plasma [प्लाझ्मा] Zn level in sheep [मेंढी] fed such green fodder [हिरवा चारा].

Plant varieties growing on the same soil [माती] under the same environmental conditions show marked differences in mineral uptake. Legumes are superior in Ca and Mg uptake from soil [माती] compared to the grasses. In contrast, grasses tend to be higher in Mn and Mo than legumes when grown on the same soil [माती]. Most of the trace mineral concentration was higher in pasture [कुरण क्षेत्र] legume [शिंबीवर्गीय वनस्पती] species [प्रजाती] than other grasses. Some of the crop [पीक] residues contain excess of silica, oxalate and tannins which will interfere in the utilization of other minerals [खनिजे] / nutrients [पोषक तत्वे]. Plant requirement for certain minerals [खनिजे] (Mn, Zn, K) exceed the animal requirements and certain minerals [खनिजे] are required at higher levels by animals like Sodium (Na), Chloride (Cl), Iodine [आयोडिन] (I) and Selenium (Se). Similarly, the concentration of trace elements [सूक्ष्म अन्नद्रव्ये] such as Cu, Co and Mo in forage crops [चारापिक] is usually lower than the requirements for ruminants and pigs and hence, these elements are added as mineral salts.
```

question: मी PM-KISAN साठी पात्र आहे का
answer:
**प्रधानमंड्री किसान सम्मान निधी योजना (पीएम-किसान)** ही केंद्र शासनाची योजना आहे जी कुटुंबासाठी **₹६०००** प्रति वर्ष लाभ देते, तो तीन समान हप्त्यांमध्ये प्रत्येकी **₹२०००** असा मिळतो.

**पात्रता:**
- शेतजमीनधारक असलेल्या आर्थिकदृष्ट्या दुर्बल शेतकरी कुटुंबे आणि लागवडीयोग्य जमीन धारणा
- शेतकरी म्हणून नोंदणी ७/१२ उतारावर दिसणे
- जमीन आधारशी जोडलेली असणे, आधारशी जोडलेली असणे आणि ई-केवायसी पूर्ण असणे

**कागदपत्रे:**
- ७/१२ उतारा
- आधार-जोडणी व जमीन-आधार जोडणीची माहिती
- ई-केवायसी

**अर्ज कसा करावा:**
- पीएम-किसान पोर्टलवर ऑनलाईन अर्ज करता येतो

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

question: गव्हाच्या शेतातील उंदरांचा बंदोबस्त करण्याचा सर्वोत्तम मार्ग कोणता?
answer:
गव्हाच्या शेतात उंदरांचा बंदोबस्त करण्यासाठी सर्वात प्रभावी मार्ग म्हणजे उंदरांचे डोंगर (गड्डे) नष्ट करणे, सापळे वापरणे आणि सुरक्षितपणे विषारी खाद्य देणे; शक्य असेल तर धुरीकरणाचे औषध देखील उपयोगी पडते.

**उंदर नियंत्रण:**
- उंदरांचे गड्डे/डोंगर शोधून ते पूर्णपणे बुजवा व मातीने नीट बंदा करा.
- सापळे लावा: आधी अवैरी/सहज खाद्य ठेवून उंदरांना खाण्याची सवय बघा, मग विषारी खाद्यासाठी पुढे जा.
- विषारी खाद्य कसे द्यावे: पहिले नविषारी खाद्य ठेवा; जर उंदर खात असतील तर एक भाग झिंक फॉस्फाइड, ४९ भाग कोणत्याही धान्याचा पीठ, आणि पुरेशी गोडीची तेल अशी मिश्रण करून कागदी पिशवीत चमचाभर खाद्य भरून बांबू काठीने उंदराच्या गड्ड्यात खोल टाका आणि गड्डा गवत व मातीने नीट बंदा करा.
- धुरीकरण: एका गड्ड्यात अॅल्युमिनियम फॉस्फाइडची एक टॅबलेट टाकून गड्ड्याचा मुखा भाग गाळ्याने बंदा करा.

**महत्त्वाची सूचना:**
- अॅल्युमिनियम फॉस्फाइड हे मर्यादित वापर योजनेत येणारे औषध आहे; त्यामुळे वापर अत्यंत काळजीपूर्वक व परवानगीनुसारच करा.

**स्रोत: कृषी व्हेंमायू कीड व्यवस्थापन माहिती; डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ धुरीकरण व सुरक्षा माहिती**  

तुमच्या शेतात उंदरांचे गड्डे किती आहेत आणि गहू परिपक्वतेच्या काळात (कापणीच्या आधी) हा त्रास जास्त होतो का?

Rainy Season Management [पावसाळा काळातील व्यवस्थापन]:

Wet and muddy conditions increase risk of foot diseases, parasitic infections, and shelter [आश्रयस्थान] dampness. Overcrowding near water and shelter [आश्रयस्थान] can cause stress and injury. Shelter [आश्रयस्थान] & Drainage: Provide leak-proof, well-ventilated shelters with raised floors to avoid water logging. Ensure good drainage around shelters to keep areas dry [कोरडे]. Bedding [गादी]: Use absorbent bedding [गादी] materials and replace wet bedding [गादी] regularly to prevent fungal infections and foot rot [फूट रॉट]. Hygiene [स्वच्छता]: Maintain strict sanitation by cleaning [साफसफाई] shelters daily, removing manure [खत] and wet bedding [गादी], and using footbaths with antiseptics to control infections. Nutrition [पोषण]: Supplement pasture [कुरण क्षेत्र] with dry fodder [कोरडा चारा] and proteinrich feed to compensate for poor-quality wet forage [चारा]. Provide mineral blocks to support immunity [रोगप्रतिकारशक्ती]. Water Supply: Keep water clean and containers free from algae and contamination. Provide enough water points to avoid overcrowding. Parasite Control [परजीवी नियंत्रण]: Deworm animals before and during the rainy season and vaccinate against common diseases. Control flies [माशी], rodents, and other pests attracted by moisture.

**Crop Protection [पीक संरक्षण]**

The pod borer [शेंगा पोखरणारी अळी] is the main pest [कीड] on chickpea [हरभरा]. Small larvae start appearing when the crop [पीक] is about 3 weeks old. White spots are seen on the leaves and the shoots appear to be eaten. The integrated pest management [एकात्मिक कीड व्यवस्थापन] method is good for controlling this pest [कीड]. For this, mix 200 grams of sorghum [ज्वारी] with chickpea [हरभरा] per hectare while sowing [पेरणी]. To allow birds to sit, install 50 bird perches at intervals of 15-20 meters. Birds like crows, sparrows, and starlings come to them and pick up the larvae. Install 5 pheromone traps [फेरोमोन सापळे] per hectare for pest [कीड] surveillance. For pest control [कीड नियंत्रण], spray 5% neem oil [कडुलिंबाचे तेल] emulsion as soon as the crop [पीक] starts flowering. After the first spray, spray Helio Kill, a viral bio-insecticide [कीटकनाशक], at the rate of 10 ml in 10 liters of water after 10 to 15 days. If necessary, spray Emamectin benzoate 5% SG at 4 grams per 10 liters of water or Quinalphos 20 ml per 10 liters of water as the third spray. Harvesting [कापणी] Chickpea [हरभरा] crop [पीक] matures in 110 to 120 days. Do not harvest [कापणी] the crop [पीक] when it is moist [ओले]. After the pods are completely dry [कोरडे], harvest [कापणी] and thresh the chickpea [हरभरा]. After this, give the grains [धान्ये] strong sunlight for 5-6 days. Store chickpea [हरभरा] in a granary [धान्य कोठार]. Add neem [कडूलिंब] leaves (5%) to it. This prevents infestation during storage [साठवण].

The pods of P.K.M. 1 are 45 cm long, while the pods of P.K.M. 2 are 1.5 meters long.

Planting: Planting should be done in June-July in low rainfall areas and August-September in high rainfall areas. While planting, the distance between two trees and two rows should be kept at 4 to 5 meters. Planting can be done by preparing seedlings from 1.5- to 2-meter-long cuttings [कापणी टप्पे] or from seeds.

Fertilizers: Every year, 10 kg of farmyard manure [शेणखत], 75 grams of nitrogen [नत्र], 50 grams of phosphorus [स्फुरद], and 75 grams of potash should be given to each tree at the beginning of the monsoon [पावसाळा] season.

The first pruning [फांद्या छाटणी] should be done one meter above the ground. The branches that come out during the second pruning [फांद्या छाटणी] should be pruned. गडचिरोली परिसरात खालील कस्टम हायरिंग सेंटर (सी.एच.सी.) उपलब्ध दिसतात, पण या माहितीमध्ये नेमके कोणते केंद्र हाताने चालवायचे पेरणी यंत्र देते का हे स्पष्ट दिलेले नाही — फोनवरून उपलब्ध यंत्रांची यादी विचारून तुम्ही खात्री करू शकता.

**जवळची कस्टम हायरिंग सेंटर:**
- **सी.एच.सी. गेवरा बक., सावली**  
  पत्ता: गेवरा फार्मर प्रोड्यूसर कंपनी लिमिटेड, गेवरा  
  संपर्क: दिლიप कावदुजी फुलबंदहे  
  फोन: ९४०४५२३१३७  
  अंतर: ८ कि.मी.

- **सी.एच.सी. नागरी, गडचिरोली**  
  पत्ता: जैजै सेंद्रिय पुरूष बचत गट, नागरी  
  संपर्क: अनिल जगन्नाथ म्हासाखेत्री  
  फोन: ९६०४४०४४१२  
  अंतर: १२ कि.मी.

- **सी.एच.सी. सकोली (सीटी), सकोली**  
  पत्ता: बिजान्कुर शेतकरी स्वयंसाहयता गट, सकोली  
  संपर्क: पवन इश्वरदास लान्जे  
  फोन: ८००७६७१३५०  
  अंतर: १२ कि.मी.

- **सी.एच.सी. सिंडोला, सावली**  
  पत्ता: स्वाभिमानि बालिराजा पुरूष बचत गट सिंडोला  
  संपर्क: निलेश वीठोबा बंबोदे  
  फोन: ९९२३८२८८१८  
  अंतर: २४ कि.मी.

**स्रोत: कृषी सेवा माहिती**

तुम्हाला कोणत्या गावाजवळचे (तालुका/गावाचे नाव) सी.एच.सी. हवे आहे??

question: Andi denarya kombdyansathi santulit aahar kasa tayar karava?
answer:
शेळीच्या कोम्बडीस (छोट्या शेळ्या) संतुलित आहार तयार करताना रोज हिरवा चारा, कोरडा चारा आणि दाणेदार खाद्य हे योग्य प्रमाणात द्या.

**आहार मात्रा:**
- वाढत्या कोम्बडीस दररोज साधारण १२५ ते १५० ग्रॅम हिरवा चारा, २५० ग्रॅम कोरडा चारा, आणि १२५ ते १५० ग्रॅम दाणेदार खाद्य द्या  
- कोम्बडीची उगवण चांगली व्हावी म्हणून ल्युसेर्न, चवळी किंवा कोवळी झाडूनिशी यांचा प्राधान्यने समावेश करा  

**विशेष टिप:**
- तीन महिन्यांच्यानंतर कोम्बडीचे दुध/दूधावर अवलंबित्व हळूहळू कमी करा आणि हिरवा चारा व खाद्याचे प्रमाण हळूहळू वाढवा  
- आहारात जीवनसत्त्वे व खनिजे यांचाही समावेश ठेवा  

**स्रोत: कृषी विज्ञान व तंत्रज्ञान पाठ्यक्रम (वी.एन.एम.ए.यू.) — शेळीचा आहार माहिती**

तुमच्या कोम्बडीचा अंदाजे वजन किती आहे आणि ती सध्या किती महिन्यांची आहे?

**Animal Science and Technology Standard XII**
```
Symptoms [लक्षणे]

- 1. Loss of body weight [शरीराचे वजन].
- 2. Dry [कोरडे] and rough hair [रफ केस] coat
- 3. Poor growth [वाढ] rate
- 4. Pot-belly
- 5. Diarrhoea [अतिसार]
- 6. Anaemia [रक्तहीनता]
- 7. Pica or depraved appetite [भूक] eating of soil [माती] and clothes, chewing of stones etc.

Fig [अंजीर]. 8.16 : Poor body condition due to worm load in calf [वासरू]

Fig [अंजीर]. 8.17 : Worm load in goat [शेळी]

Control

- 1. Isolation [अलग ठेवणे] and treatment [उपचार] of affected animals.
- 2. Maintain cleanliness of animal shed [निवारा].
- 3. Avoid contamination of feed and water with dung [शेण].
- 4. Keep young and old animals separately.
- 5. Avoid overcrowding.
- 6. Rotational grazing [चरणे] has to be encouraged
- 7. Carry out deworming [कृमिनाशक देणे] twice a year i.e. before and after monsoon [पावसाळा] and once in a month up to 3 months in case of calves.
- 8. Provide balanced ration.
- 9. Screening of faecal samples of the animals at regular interval.
- 10. Spray intsecticide to control the orbatid mites [अळ्या].
- 11. Control of snails.
- 12. Avoid grazing [चरणे] in low lying or marshy areas like banks of river, ponds etc.

(2) Ectoparasites

Remember...

Ectoparasites are those parasites which live on the outside of animal body.

The ectoparasites found in animals are as follows.

1. Lice [ऊवा] 2. Ticks 3. Fleas 4. Mites [अळ्या] 5. Flies [माशी]

Symptoms [लक्षणे]

- 1. Irritation/itching
- 2. Loss of hair i.e. alopecia [केस गळणे]
- 3. Restlessness [बेचैनी]
- 4. Anaemia [रक्तहीनता]
- 5. Loss of body weight [शरीराचे वजन]
- 6. Decreased milk [दूध] and meat production [मांस उत्पादन]
- 7. Decreased growth [वाढ] rate
- 8. Some flies [माशी] produce maggoted wound [जखम]
```


----

**Sustainable Poultry Production**
```
Feed formula is the details of ingredient and chemical constitution of a balanced ration obtained after a series of calculations. Feed formulation [पशुखाद्य सूत्रीकरण] is an art but practical low cost feed formulation [पशुखाद्य सूत्रीकरण] requires skill and good knowledge in poultry [कुक्कुट] nutrition [पोषण]. Abalanced ration is one that supplies all the nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] in proper quantity and proportion that are needed to support optimum growth [वाढ], egg production [अंडे उत्पादन] and health [आरोग्य]. A least/low cost balanced ration is formulated at low cost with out affecting nutrietive quality. The components of a balanced ration are carbohydrates, proteins and amino acids [अमिनो आम्ल], fat, vitamins [जीवनसत्त्वे] and minerals [खनिजे]. The energy present in the feed is the effect of carbohydrates and fats. The optional components are feed additives like antibiotics, antioxidants, anti-stressors, drugs, etc.

Carbohydrates (starch, sugars and non-starch polysaccharides) are the largest component of the ration. The cereal [तृणधान्य] grains [धान्ये] and cereal [तृणधान्य] by-products are major sources of carbohydrates followed by pulse [डाळ] and pulse [डाळ] byproducts, and vegetable protein [प्रथिने] meals/oilcakes. The protein [प्रथिने] sources are divided into two categories:

1) Vegetable protein [प्रथिने] supplements like soybean [सोयाबीन] meal [जेवण], ground nut oil cake, mustard [मोहरी]/ rapeseed [मोहरी] meal [जेवण], sesame [तीळ] meal [जेवण], sunflower [सुर्यफुल] meal [जेवण], safflower [करडई] meal [जेवण], cottonseed meal [जेवण], cluster bean [गवार] meal [जेवण], roasted cluster bean [गवार] meal [जेवण], rice [बासमती तांदूळ] gluten meal [जेवण], maize [मका] gluten meal [जेवण], dried distillery grains [धान्ये] with soluble, etc. and

2) Animal protein [प्रथिने] supplements like fish [मासे] meal [जेवण], meat [मांस] meal [जेवण], meat [मांस]-cum-bone meal [हाडांची भुकटी], blood [रक्त] meal [जेवण], liver meal [जेवण], feather meal [जेवण], etc.

The feed that is to be formulated should have at least 3% oil to meet the requirement of essential fatty acids and for absorption of fat soluble vitamins [जीवनसत्त्वे]. Moreover, preparation of high-energy diet requires supplementation of fat or oil. The feed intake is decreased with increased energy concentration in diets and thus better feed efficiency [चारा कार्यक्षमता] is obtained when fat is added. Fat also reduces heat increment especially in

summer, reduces the toxicity of aflatoxins and tannins, fat has extra- calorific value [उष्मांक मूल्य], increases palatability of diet and facilities operation of feed meal [जेवण] and in pellet making. However, the cost of feed is increased as fats and oils are costlier.
```

**Handbook of Good Dairy Husbandry Practices**
```
E. MANAGING HEAT STRESS [उष्णतेचा ताण]
- Ensure adequate water availability to animals. A healthy normal cow [गाय] needs about 100 liters of water to manage heat.
- Drinking water [पाणी पिणे] should be provided under shade to ensure cooling by evaporation.
- Ensure shade over the animals. If trees are not available thatched roof of a minimum height of 9 feet should be constructed. Agri-nets with 20% perforation could also be useful. In desert like situations, community shades could be introduced.
- Misting of water over the body of animals at least thrice in an hour is useful. Auto sprinklers with mini pumps and cyclic timers should be preferred.
- Air circulation in covered sheds should be increased. Ensure one ventilator of 3 x 1 feet per cow [गाय]. Use ceiling fans or blowers wherever power is available.
- Create barriers against hot wind [वारा]. Thatched wall should be preferred. Wet gunny cloth is another option.
- Feed the animals during morning, evening & night time.
- Prefer grazing [चरणे] during early morning & evening hours.
- Shave the hair coat (remove hair).
- Ration to be changed so as to provide same nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] at reduced dry matter [सुका घटक] intake.
- Potassium [पालाश] rich mineral mixture [खनिज मिश्रण] should be preferred.

*Managing heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण] can save your animal during summers*

PART III

INFORMATION NETWORK FOR BETTER PRODUCTIVITY

The important facets of animal health [पशु आरोग्य], breeding [प्रजनन] and nutrition [पोषण] mentioned in the previous sections should be supported by an information system for recording the activities in the field [शेत] so that a rich database is created which would be beneficial both to the farmers and policy makers.

NDDB has created such a system called the Information Network for Animal Productivity and Health [आरोग्य] (INAPH) which is being presently used in the field [शेत] for recording various interventions in animal health [पशु आरोग्य], breeding [प्रजनन] and nutrition [पोषण]. A brief description of the information system and the benefits to the farmers are mentioned in the following sections:

Section I. Animal Identification

Section II. Animal Health [पशु आरोग्य]

Section III. Animal Breeding [पशु प्रजनन]

Section IV. Animal Nutrition [पशु पोषण] (Ration Balancing [आहार संतुलन] Programme)

SECTION I
```

**Recent Advances in Dairy farming, processing and marketing stratergies**
```
Characteristics of a balanced ration:

- The ration should be properly balanced and more purposeful and beneficial
- The ration must be palatable
- The ration should have variety of feeds which make it more palatable
- The ration should contain enough of mineral matter
- The ration should be fairly laxative
- The ration should be fairly bulky
- The ration should contain sufficient green fodder [हिरवा चारा]
- Avoid sudden changes in the ration
- Maintain regularity in feeding [खाऊ घालणे]
- The ration should be economical

Impact of feeding [खाऊ घालणे] balanced ration:

- Increases the milk production [दूध उत्पादन] and net daily income
- Increases the milk production [दूध उत्पादन] efficiency
- Increases the rumen [रुमेन] microbial protein [प्रथिने] synthesis
- Increases the immune status of animals
- Decreases the parasitic infestations in animals
- Decreases the enteric methane emission
- Increases the efficiency of feed nitrogen [नत्र] use in milk [दूध]

Prerequisites of formulating a ration:

- Determine the nutrient [पोषक घटक] requirements of the animals
- List the locally available feed resources
- Mention the nutrient [पोषक घटक] composition of the feed resources
- List the inclusion levels of the feedstuffs
- List the cost of the feed resources

Methods of formulation especially for concentrate mixture or grain [धान्य] mixture: Mechanics of feed formulation [पशुखाद्य सूत्रीकरण]:

Ration formulation [आहार संमिश्रण] is matching of the nutrient [पोषक घटक] requirements of the animal with the nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] present in the feedstuffs of the ration. When rations are formulated by hand, generally they are first formulated for one nutrient [पोषक घटक].

Then the other nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] are checked to determine whether the feedstuffs used will meet the requirements or whether alternative feed resources need to be included in the diet. One method

is to balance for protein [प्रथिने] first and then to check energy levels to see if they are met. Next, the ration can be checked for the other nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] such as calcium [कॅल्शियम] and phosphorus [स्फुरद].

When the number of nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] specified is small, diet formulation can be adequately carried out through simple calculations. The calculations involved in this type of formulation are simple and few. However, as the number of nutrient [पोषक घटक] specifications and the number of feedstuffs available increases, the mathematics get quite involved and confusing. In such cases, it is appropriate to use computer spread sheets or specialized programs.
```

**Animal Science and Technology Standard XII**
```
Fig [अंजीर]. 3.9 : Foggers and fan arrangement in cattle [गाय वर्ग] shed [निवारा]

Feeding [खाऊ घालणे] management [व्यवस्थापन]

- 1. Provide adequate green fodder [हिरवा चारा]
- 2. Feed during cooler times of the day
- 3. Increase the frequency of feedings
- 4. Keep feed fresh as much as possible
- 5. Provide high-quality forage [चारा] and balanced ration.
- 6. Provide adequate fibre
- 7. Use of bypass proteins can enhance the milk yield [दुधाचे उत्पादन] and protein content [प्रथिन प्रमाण].
- 8. Provision of sufficient cool and fresh water.

Providing natural or artificial shade area

 Plantation of trees around the farm will help in alleviating heat load from the animals.

Selection of heat tolerant animals

 Genetic Selection of animals based on specific molecular genetic markers for heat tolerance [उष्णता सहनशीलता] will definitely be a boon to alleviate heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण] in cattle [गाय वर्ग] and buffaloes by identifying the heat tolerant animals.
```

**Krushi VNMAU**
```
3. **Diet of Goats:  
    **a) Diet of Large Goats: It is very important to get a balanced and complete diet for the all-round physical [शारीरिक तपासणी] development of goats, for fetal growth [वाढ], for milk production [दूध उत्पादन], and for body nourishment. A goat [शेळी] should be given four percent dry fodder [कोरडा चारा] of its weight. Goats can eat any kind of tree leaves, they like to eat the leaves of small shrubs very much. They eat tender leaves of trees, tender branches, and pods with pleasure. A mature goat [शेळी] should be given about two and a half to three kilos of green fodder [हिरवा चारा], 400-500 grams of dry fodder [कोरडा चारा], and 250-300 grams of feed per day to meet the protein [प्रथिने] needs. The diet of goats should include vitamins [जीवनसत्त्वे] and minerals [खनिजे]. Goats can be given fodder [चारा] like shevri [शेवरी], hadga, dhawda, tamarind [चिंच], jamun [जांभूळ], peepal [पिंपळ], ber [बोरफळ], banyan, anjan, sandalwood [चंदन], apta, subabhul, dasharath, as well as maize [मका], lucerne [ल्युसेर्न], berseem [बर्सीम], etc. 350 to 400 grams of extra feed should be given per liter of milk production [दूध उत्पादन].  
    b) Diet of Kids: The higher the growth [वाढ] rate of the kids, the more financially beneficial it is for the goat [शेळी] keepers. Male kids are ready for sale when they weigh 20-25 kg. After the kids are three months old, the milk [दूध] intake should be gradually reduced and the amount of green fodder [हिरवा चारा] and feed should be increased. Growing kids should be given about 125 to 150 grams of green fodder [हिरवा चारा], 250 grams of dry fodder [कोरडा चारा], and 125 to 150 grams of feed. The diet of the kids should mainly include lucerne [ल्युसेर्न], cowpea [चवळी], or tender vegetation.  
    c) Diet of Bucks: The buck [शेळीचा नर] used for reproduction should be given an additional 300-400 grams of feed in addition to its daily balanced diet [संतुलित आहार], so that its ability to fertilize the goats is maintained and the number of spermatozoa in its semen [वीर्य] does not decrease.
```

**Reproductive diseases**
```
General Preventive Measures [सामान्य प्रतिबंधक उपाय] for Farmers:

- i. Maintain clean, dry sheds [स्वच्छ व कोरडे शेड] to reduce infections.
- ii. Provide balanced feed with adequate green fodder [हिरवा चारा], concentrates [दाणेदार खाद्य], and mineral mixtures.
- iii. Practice heat detection [ऊष्मा तपासणी] twice daily (early morning and late evening).
- iv. Vaccinate against brucellosis [ब्रुसॅलोसिस], leptospirosis [लेप्टोस्पायरोसिस], and IBR where recommended.
- v. Ensure hygienic calving [व्याने] and post-partum care to avoid uterine infections.

vi. Seek veterinary help early for abnormal discharges, delayed heat, abortions, or prolapse.

Conclusion [निष्कर्ष]

Reproductive diseases reduce fertility [प्रजननक्षमता], delay calving [व्याने], and lower farm income. Most problems arise from poor nutrition [पोषण], unhygienic practices, or neglect of timely veterinary care [पशुवैद्यकीय काळजी]. By maintaining proper feeding [खाऊ घालणे], good housing [निवास व्यवस्था] conditions, regular health [आरोग्य] monitoring, and vaccinations, farmers can prevent many reproductive disorders. Healthy breeding [प्रजनन] animals ensure steady milk production [दूध उत्पादन] and farm profitability [फायदेशीरता]. Early diagnosis [निदान] and veterinary treatment [उपचार] are key to protecting livestock [पशुधन] fertility [प्रजननक्षमता] and sustaining rural livelihoods.
```


----

**Methane Emission reduction in Dairy Animals**
```
Feeding [खाऊ घालणे] balanced ration for reducing methane emission

In India, most of the farmers follow traditional methods of feeding [खाऊ घालणे] which is generally imbalanced in terms of energy, protein [प्रथिने] and minerals [खनिजे]. Animals fed on imbalanced ration produce more methane per unit of milk [दूध] due to lower microbial protein [प्रथिने] synthesis and higher acetate production [उत्पादन].

In view of this, NDDB has initiated studies on measurement of methane emission reduction through ration balancing [आहार संतुलन] in different agro-climatic regions, where farmers are advised by the village based trained local resource persons (LRP) to balance the ration of animals with locally available feed resources, using computer software developed by NDDB.

Balanced diet [संतुलित आहार] alters rumen [रुमेन] fermentation pattern towards lower acetate, butyrate and higher propionate production [उत्पादन]. This results in higher microbial protein [प्रथिने] yield [उत्पादन] and reduced methane production [उत्पादन]. High propionate and microbial protein [प्रथिने] synthesis provides energy and protein [प्रथिने] for milk production [दूध उत्पादन] in lactating ruminants.

question: भेंडीवरील मावा किडीसाठी सेंद्रिय कीटकनाशके सुचवा.
answer:
भेंडीवरील मावा (मापकीड) कीड नियंत्रणासाठी सेंद्रिय उपायांपैकी निंबोळी अर्काची फवारणी आणि उपयोगी प्राणिजाती/सापळा पिके हे शिफारस केलेले पर्याय आहेत.

**सेंद्रिय कीटकनाशके व फवारणी:**
- निंबोळी अर्क १० मि.ली. प्रति १० ली. पाणी अशा प्रमाणात फवारणी करावी; ही फवारणी १५ दिवसांच्या अंतराने पुनरावृत्ती करणे गरजेचे आहे
- जर किड कमी असल्यावरही आपण आधीच सेंद्रिय संरक्षण ठेवू इच्छित असाल, तर झेंडू हे सापळा पीक मुख्य पिकाच्या बाजूला लावल्याने मावा व इतर कीड दूर राहण्यास मदत होते

**उपयोगी प्राणिजाती:**
- धुंदीवाशी (लेडीबर्ड बीटल) या उपयोगी कीटकाचा वापर केल्याने मावा प्रादुर्भाव कमी होतो

**टोमॅटोसारख्या रोगांसाठी वेगळे:**
- टोमॅटोतील काही बुरशीजन्य रोगांसाठी ट्रायकोडर्मा विरिडे जैविक घटक उपलब्ध दस्तऐवजात नमूद आहे; पण मावा नियंत्रणासाठी तो या स्रोतात स्पष्टपणे दिलेला नाही

question: जसवंदावरील पुंड्यां ढेणकून चे नैसर्गिक शत्रू कोणते आहेत?
answer:
जास्वंदावरील रसशोषक कीडांसाठी (मावा, पांढरी माशी, पिठ्या ढेकूण) नैसर्गिक शत्रू म्हणून खालील उपयुक्त कीटक बागेत टिकून ठेवणे महत्त्वाचे आहे:

**नैसर्गिक शत्रू (यादी):**
- क्रायसोपा  
- शील्ड बग  
- मॅलॅडा  
- एन्कार्शिया  
- जाऊरव्हिया बीटल  
- काटीन  
- लियोक्रिनस  

**पिठ्या ढेकूणावर विशेष:**
- स्पाल्जीस इप्यूस या उपयुक्त कीटकाची अळी पिठ्या ढेकूणाच्या विविध अवस्था खाते; ती तुती वर मोठ्या प्रमाणात सापडते आणि गरजेनुसार एकत्र करून पीक/बागेत सोडता येते  
- अॅसेरोफेगस पॅपायाए हा परजीवी प्राणिजिवही या कीड नियंत्रित करतो  

**नैसर्गिक शत्रू टिकावेत म्हणून:**
- कीटकनाशके किमान ठेवा आणि फुलोऱ्याचा डोंगराळपणा वाढवा (बांधावर फुलझाडे/फ्लॉवर स्ट्रिप्स)  
- त्यामुळे नैसर्गिक शत्रूंना पोषक द्रव्य मिळते आणि ते जिवंत राहतात  

**स्रोत: कृषी दर्शनी डॉ. बी. एस. के. के. व्ही., दापोली २०२५; एम.पी.के.व्ही. कृषी दर्शनी; नॅचरल फार्मिंग ट्रेनिंग टूलकिट अँड बेस्ट प्रॅक्टिसेस गाइड**?

5.5 Curative Methods

This section outlines strategies to conserve natural pest [कीड] enemies by minimizing pesticide [कीटकनाशक] use, diversifying crops, and creating supportive habitats like hedges, beetle banks, and flower strips to attract beneficial organisms. Some methods to biologically control natural enemies [नैसर्गिक शत्रू] of pests are as follows:

- Minimise Natural Pesticides [नैसर्गिक कीटकनाशके]: Reduce the use of natural pesticides [नैसर्गिक कीटकनाशके] to avoid harming beneficial organisms that prey on pests.
- Allow Some Pests: Permit certain pests to remain in the field [शेत] as they serve as food or hosts for natural enemies [नैसर्गिक शत्रू].
- Diverse Cropping Systems: Implement mixed cropping [मिश्र पीक पद्धती] systems to create a more diverse ecosystem that supports beneficial insect [उपयुक्त कीटक] life and reduces pest [कीड] pressure.
- Host Plants for Natural Enemies [नैसर्गिक शत्रू]: Include plants that provide food or shelter [आश्रयस्थान] for natural enemies [नैसर्गिक शत्रू], such as flowers that beneficial insects feed on.
- Enhance Floral Diversity: Increase floral diversity within and along the boundaries of crop [पीक] fields to support a broader range of beneficial organisms. There are many possibilitiesto enhance floral diversity within and along the boundaries of crop [पीक] fields.

For habitat enhancement of the natural pest [कीड] predators, the following techniques are employed-

- Hedges Use indigenous shrubs known to attract pest [कीड] predators and parasitoids by offering nectar, pollen [पराग], alternative hosts and/ or prey. Most flowering shrub species [प्रजाती] have this property. However, care should be taken not to use plant species [प्रजाती] that are alternative hosts of pests or diseases.
- Beetle banks Strips of grass in the neighbourhood of crop [पीक] fields harbour different natural pest [कीड] enemy groups like carabids, staphylinid beetles and spiders. To lower the risk of weeds [तण] and plants known as host plants of crop [पीक] pests and diseases, one to three native grass species [प्रजाती] can be sown in strips of 1 to 3 m.
- Flower strips Three to five native flowering plant species [प्रजाती] can be sown in wellprepared seed [बियाणे] beds, arranged in strips of 1 to 3 m on the boundary of the crop [पीक] field [शेत]. After flowering, seeds can be collected to renew the strip or create new ones.

question: धुळे मंडीत मका साठवावा की विकावा?
answer:
धुळे बाजारात सध्या मका (पिवळा) किमान ₹११५०, कमाल ₹१४७१, सरासरी ₹१४०० प्रति क्विंटल भावाने नोंदला आहे; त्यामुळे आत्ता विक्री करायची की साठवायची हे तुमच्या मक्याचा ओलावा, साठवणूक जागा आणि खर्च पाहून ठरवा.

**बाजारभाव:**
- मका (पिवळा): किमान ₹११५०, कमाल ₹१४७१, सरासरी ₹१४०० प्रति क्विंटल

- मका पूर्ण कोरडा (ओलावा कमी) असल्यास आणि गोदाम/घरगुती साठवण जागा उपलब्ध असेल तर काही दिवस साठवू शकता
- ओलावा जास्त असेल तर छिडका/कुजणे होऊ शकते; त्यासाठी उशिर करू नका आणि शक्य तितकी लवकर विक्री करा

question: या आठवड्यात पाऊस नसल्यामुळे सिंचन वाढवावे का?

**Fortnightly Care/Maintenance (After 120 to 125 hours of work):**

- Replace the oil in the fuel and lubrication system.
- Replace the diesel filter and oil filter.
- Clean the crankcase breather.
- Add oil to the dynamo and starter motor bearings.
- Clean the air cleaner.
- Make proper adjustments to the clutch and brakes.

**Care/Maintenance After 200 to 250 Hours of Operation:**

- Lubricate the throttle control system.
- Inspect the toe-in of the front wheels.
- Inspect the front wheel bearings properly and lubricate them.
- Drain all the oil from the oil sump, clean it, and then fill it to the specified mark.

**Care/Maintenance After 500 Hours of Operation:**

- Clean the cooling system and add rust [गंज रोग] inhibitor.
- Reverse the front two wheels and refit them on opposite sides.
- Clean the fuel tank.
- Clean the self-starter and dynamo, and replace worn parts.
- Inspect the injectors and adjust them.
- Add grease to the wheel bearings.
- If the battery is discharged, recharge it.

**Care/Maintenance After 1000 Hours of Operation:**

- Replace the oil in the gearbox, final drive, differential, hydraulic system, and steering system.
- Clean the brake linings and adjust them properly. Replace brake liners if they are worn.
- Clean the entire fuel system and replace the filter.
- Open the cylinder head completely and clean off the carbon.

**Precautions to be Taken While Assembling the Engine:**

- Fit the piston into the cylinder.

- Fill diesel and water to the appropriate levels.

5. In the evening, after completing the day's work, fill the fuel tank completely with diesel.
6. Clean the radiator thoroughly, and fill the radiator tank completely with clean water [स्वच्छ पाणी].
7. Check the tension of the fan belt.
8. Ensure that the fuel pipe, oil pipe, water pipe, and drain plug are properly tightened.
9. Check the air pressure in the front and rear tires. If low, inflate to the appropriate level.
10. Apply grease to the points specified by the manufacturers.
11. Check the distilled water level in the battery and fill it to the specified mark.
12. Start the engine and check that the dynamo is functioning correctly.

- Open and clean the lubrication system and oil filter.
- Tighten the fan bolts properly.
- Inspect the oil in the air cleaner and replace the oil.

- Check the tractor [ट्रॅक्टर] brakes and ensure they are functioning correctly.
- If the engine is air-cooled, clean its fins properly.
- If the transmission oil level is low, fill it completely to the correct level.
- Tighten any loose nuts and bolts.
- Clean the battery terminals with hot water, apply grease, and then tighten them back in place.

```
Care and management [व्यवस्थापन] of farrowing [डुक्कर जन्म देणे] sow [मादी डुक्कर]

The sow [मादी डुक्कर] may be transferred to farrowing [डुक्कर जन्म देणे] pen at least 8-10 days before the expected date of farrowing [डुक्कर जन्म देणे] to accustom her in the new environment. The sow [मादी डुक्कर] should be cleaned and washed properly just before transferring to farrowing [डुक्कर जन्म देणे] pen. The farrowing [डुक्कर जन्म देणे] pen should have non-slippery floor and provided with guard rails to protect the piglets. Thorough cleaning [साफसफाई] and disinfection of farrowing [डुक्कर जन्म देणे] pen should be done one day before the transfer to ensure dry [कोरडे] surface when the animal is brought in. Batch farrowing [डुक्कर जन्म देणे] is always recommended where all-in-all-out strategy is adopted. Batch farrowing [डुक्कर जन्म देणे] facilitates better newborn care round the clock and hence ensure better piglet [पिल्लू डुक्कर] crop [पीक].

The following points should be noted around the farrowing [डुक्कर जन्म देणे].

*BETTER LIVELIHOODS THROUGH SCIENTIFIC PIG [वराह] HUSBNDRY*

- The sow [मादी डुक्कर] should be provided bulky ration and it should be reduced to 1/3 on the days before farrowing [डुक्कर जन्म देणे] and withdraw 12 hours before farrowing [डुक्कर जन्म देणे].
- Every farrowing [डुक्कर जन्म देणे], irrespective of the time of farrowing [डुक्कर जन्म देणे], should be attended by trained attendants. This is more important during night when the ambient temperatures are low.
- Some gilts and sows may attempt savaging the piglets when they approach the dam [मादी जनावर माता] for suckling. This is attributed to pain [वेदना] experience during the farrowing [डुक्कर जन्म देणे]. Attendants should be trained to massage the udder [कास] to facilitate milk [दूध] letdown and reduce the pain [वेदना].
- Don't wash the animal on the Day1. If necessary clean hind portion of sow [मादी डुक्कर] with Luke warm water. Cleaning [साफसफाई] with normal water should be avoided at any cost as washing the farrowing [डुक्कर जन्म देणे] pen may also make the animal and piglets wet. The piglets have limited mechanisms to maintain homeothermy, hence splashing of water can lead to mortality.
- Sow [मादी डुक्कर] should be provided free access to clean and fresh water for drinking. Provide adequate balance nutritional ration to the lactating sow [मादी डुक्कर] for sufficient milk production [दूध उत्पादन] for piglets
- Prevent sow [मादी डुक्कर] from eating placenta [झार] and dispose off safely.
- Load noise and dog barks which irritate the sow [मादी डुक्कर] may hinder the farrowing [डुक्कर जन्म देणे] process. Calm and silent area is preferred for farrowing [डुक्कर जन्म देणे].

**Time of Sowing [पेरणी]:** Rabi sorghum [ज्वारी] sowing [पेरणी] should be generally completed from 25th September to 15th October. If the sowing [पेरणी] is delayed, there is a possibility of infestation by shoot fly [खोड माशी] and therefore the proper number of plants is not obtained.

**Seed Rate [बियाण्याची प्रमाण] and Sowing Method [बियाणे पेरण्याची पद्धत]:** 7.5 to 10 kg of certified seeds per hectare is sufficient for Rabi sorghum [ज्वारी]. Sowing [पेरणी] should be done with a seed drill [बियाणे पेरणी यंत्र] at 45 cm (1.5 ft). Use a two-row seed drill [बियाणे पेरणी यंत्र] for sowing [पेरणी], which will facilitate the application of fertilizers along with sowing [पेरणी].

**Thinning [विरळणी करणे]:** Thinning [विरळणी करणे] should be done 15 to 20 days after sowing [पेरणी]. For this, keep the distance between two plants at 15 to 20 cm and keep the number of plants per hectare up to 1.50 lakh [लाख]. question: माझ्या शेताजवळील कोणती गोदामे पावतीवर बँक कर्ज मिळवण्यासाठी पात्र आहेत?
answer:
तुमच्या बोर्डी (तालुका मालेगाव, जिल्हा वाशिम) परिसरातील खालील गोदामांची माहिती उपलब्ध आहे; पण या डेटामध्ये कोणते गोदाम बँकेकडून पावतीवर कर्जासाठी खास पात्र आहेत की नाही हे स्पष्ट दिलेले नाही.

**गोदाम:**
- **मालेगाव (पूरतुर) गोदाम**  
  पत्ता: एमएसडब्ल्यूसी, कृषी उत्पन्न बाजार समिती, विरामगृह उतरट, मालेगाव  
  संपर्क: गोदाम व्यवस्थापक  
  फोन: ०७२५४-२७११०४  
  अंतर: ४.१७ कि.मी.

- **वाशिम गोदाम**  
  पत्ता: एमएसडब्ल्यूसी, कृषी उत्पन्न बाजार समिती, रेल्वे स्थानकजवळ, वाशिम  
  संपर्क: गोदाम व्यवस्थापक  
  फोन: ०७२५२-२३२१५८  
  अंतर: २१.१० कि.मी.

- **मंग्रूळपिर गोदाम**  
  पत्ता: एमएसडब्ल्यूसी, कृषी उत्पन्न बाजार समिती, मार्केट यार्ड, करंजा रोड, मंग्रूळपिर  
  संपर्क: गोदाम व्यवस्थापक  
  फोन: ०७२५३-२६०७०९  
  अंतर: ३२.९३ कि.मी.

- **रीसोड गोदाम**  
  पत्ता: एमएसडब्ल्यूसी, कृषी उत्पन्न बाजार समिती, मार्केट यार्ड, रीसोड  
  संपर्क: गोदाम व्यवस्थापक  
  फोन: ०७२५१-२२३६२२  
  अंतर: ४०.५३ कि.मी.

- **अकोला गोदाम**  
  पत्ता: एमएसडब्ल्यूसी, एन६६, फेज-४, मिडक क्षेत्र, शिवानी, अकोला  
  संपर्क: गोदाम व्यवस्थापक  
  फोन: उपलब्ध नाही  
  अंतर: ४५.१३ कि.मी.

**पावतीवर बँक कर्ज पात्रता:**
या सर्व गोदामांबद्दलची नोंद सुरक्षित साठवणूक सुविधा आहे अशी दिसते; मात्र बँकेच्या मान्यतेनुसार/बँकेचे नेमके निकष कोणते आहेत ते इथे दिलेले नाही.

answer:
तुरीवरील मर रोगावर उपाय म्हणून पीक फेरपालट, मर-प्रतिकारक वाण पेरणी आणि बियाण्याची बुरशीनाशक व ट्रायकोडर्मा प्रक्रिया ही सर्वात प्रभावी पद्धत आहे.

**मर रोग नियंत्रण:**
- शेतात दीर्घकालीन पीक फेरपालट पाळा
- मर-प्रतिकारक तूर वाण निवडा (उदा. गोदावरी, बी.डी.एन. ७१६, आय.सी.पी.एल. ८७११९ अशा, बी.एस.एम.आर. ७३६, बी.एस.एम.आर. ८५३, पी.के.व्ही. तारा, पी.डी.के.व्ही. अश्लेषा)
- पेरणीपूर्वी बियाणे खालीलप्रमाणे प्रक्रिया करा:
  - कार्बेन्डाझिम ३७.५% + थायरम ३७.५% मिश्रण ४ ग्रॅम प्रति किग्रा बियाणे
  - त्यानंतर ट्रायकोडर्मा ४ ग्रॅम प्रति किग्रा बियाणे (बुरशीनाशकाच्या प्रक्रियेनंतर ट्रायकोडर्मा लावा)

### **Diseases and Their Management [व्यवस्थापन] in Pigeon Pea [तूर] (Tur)**

**(1) Wilt [मररोग]:**

This disease [रोग] is caused by the soil [माती]-borne fungus _Fusarium udum_. The veins of the leaves turn yellow, and the leaves become yellow. The shoots of the plant become wilted and droop. The plant dries up while still green. The part of the stem near the ground becomes black. When the root is cut open vertically, the central part of the root appears black. Growth [वाढ] of the fungus is visible within. Sometimes, white fungus is also found on the stem.

**Management [व्यवस्थापन]:** Follow long-term crop rotation [पीक फेरपालट]. Sow [मादी डुक्कर] disease [रोग]-resistant varieties [प्रतिकारक वाण]. question: Ya athavdyat khat takane yogya raheel ka?
answer:
युरिया कधी द्यायचा हे तुमच्या पिकावर आणि तो कोणत्या अवस्थेत आहे यावर ठरते, म्हणून एकच वेळ सांगता येत नाही.

- काही पिकांमध्ये युरिया पेरणीवेळी पूर्ण देतात, तर काही पिकांमध्ये अर्धा भाग पेरणीवेळी आणि उरलेला भाग पेरणीनंतर साधारण ३० ते ४५ दिवसांनी देतात.
- मका: पेरणीवेळी ३५ किग्रा युरिया, त्यानंतर ३० दिवसांनी ३५ किग्रा आणि ४०–४५ दिवसांनी ३५ किग्रा.
- भेंडी: रोपांची लागवड/पेरणीवेळी ४३ किग्रा युरिया, ३० दिवसांनी २२ किग्रा, ४५ दिवसांनी २२ किग्रा.

**खाऊ वाया जाणे कमी करा:**
- पेलेट किंवा क्रंब स्वरूपातील खाऊ द्या; यामुळे निवडक खाणे कमी होते आणि खाऊची वाया जाणे कमी होते
- पिल्लांना पहिल्या चार आठवड्यांत माश/क्रंब आणि त्यानंतर पेलेट्स देता येतात
- खाऊचे भांडे दिवसाला दोन वेळा भरा जेणेकरून सर्व पिल्लांना समान खाऊ मिळेल

**आहार व्यवस्थापन (खर्च नियंत्रणासाठी):**
- घरी संतुलित मिसळलेला आहार द्या; असे केल्यास निवडक खाणे टाळता येते आणि चांगला आहार मिळतो
- शक्य असल्यास कमीत-कमी खर्चाचा संतुलित आहार तयार करण्यासाठी सोयाबीन मील यासारख्या महागड्या घटकांचे प्रमाण कमी करून स्थानिक उपलब्ध पर्यायी घटक वापरण्याची शिफारस आहे

**पद्धती निवड (घरगुती/कमी खर्च):**
- परसातील/मुक्त मोकळीक प्रणालीमध्ये जमिनीवर गवत, बिया आणि कीटक मिळतात, त्यामुळे भांडवल गुंतवणूक कमी होते आणि खाऊवरील खर्चही कमी होतो; मात्र यात इन्फेक्शन व कीड लागण्याची शक्यता जास्त असते

**दस्तऐवज नोंदणी (खर्च वाचवण्यासाठी उपयोगी):**
- रोजच्या नोंदी ठेवल्या तर खाऊचा खर्च कमी करायला मदत होते, कारण कार्यक्षमता तपासता येते आणि निर्णय सुधारता येतात?

**स्रोत: सस्टेनेबल पोल्ט्री प्रोडक्शन; ड्र. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ; अॅनिमल सायन्स अँड टेक्नॉलॉजी स्टँडर्ड ट्वेल्थ**

**Sustainable Livestock Production Prospects for Innovation**
```
We could not attain any significant outcomes in dry fodder [कोरडा चारा] management [व्यवस्थापन] also. This is attributed to crop diversification [पीक वैविध्यकरण] from cereals to commercial crops affecting the availability of crop [पीक] residues. Worsening the situation, no effective solution is available for burning of available crop [पीक] residues in fodder [चारा] surplus States like Punjab and Haryana year after year.

FODDER [चारा] RESOURCES MANAGEMENT [व्यवस्थापन]:

The National Livestock [पशुधन] Policy, 2013 put forward the following action points for livestock [पशुधन] feeding [खाऊ घालणे] in order to achieve sustainable development in the livestock [पशुधन] sector.

1. ENRICHMENT OF STRAW QUALITY

Enrichment and densification of crop [पीक] residues would be encouraged by using existing and newly developed technologies. Biotechnological techniques, which can develop recombinant microbes to digest straws, utilize lignin and its by-products and release carbohydrates through a solid-state fermentation process, shall be developed by involving research organizations of the government and private sector.

In view of the small proportion of total cropped area under fodder crops [चारा पीक] and sluggish growth [वाढ] therein, crop breeding [पीक सुधारणा] should focus on high-yielding and high-quality fodder [चारा] and forage [चारा] varieties. Economic incentives [आर्थिक प्रोत्साहन] (input subsidies for growing forage crops [चारापिक]) and vertical integration of the livestock [पशुधन] subsector, by developing marketing and processing [प्रक्रिया] infrastructure and institutions, would result in farmers bringing more land into fodder crop [चारा पीक] production [उत्पादन]. Crop breeding [पीक सुधारणा] programs should emphasize the breeding [प्रजनन] of dual-purpose crops for their superior quality straw/ stover [कडबा] without sacrificing grain [धान्य] yield [उत्पादन].

2. CEREALS AND OIL MEALS

The area under cultivation of coarse grains [धान्ये] has gone down over the years resulting in a shortage of feed ingredients and concentrates [दाणेदार खाद्य]. One of the major constraints in the poultry [कुक्कुट] sector is poor quality feeds/unavailability of balanced diets with seasonal fluctuations in demand and supply. Efforts would be made to enhance the availability of coarse grains [धान्ये] and oil meals for the livestock [पशुधन] and poultry [कुक्कुट] sector. Non-conventional animal feed [जनावरांचे खाद्य] resources would be exploited to make available protein [प्रथिने] and energy for livestock [पशुधन] feeding [खाऊ घालणे].

It is recommended to spray Potassium [पालाश] Nitrate 1% or Magnesium Carbonate 5% or Glysilol 5% along with 5 tons of straw mulch [धान्याच्या भुशाचे आच्छादन] per hectare 15 days after the flowering stage in water stress [पाण्याचा ताण] conditions of soybean [सोयाबीन] crop [पीक]. (A.Bha.Sa.So. San. Pra. 2014-15)

## **Sunflower [सुर्यफुल]**

Sunflower [सुर्यफुल] is an important oilseed [तेलबिया] crop [पीक] in Maharashtra that matures in a short period. As this crop [पीक] is not sensitive to sunlight, it is a reliable crop [पीक] that can be grown in all three seasons - Kharif, Rabi, and summer. If the sowing [पेरणी] of other Kharif crops [खरीप पिके] is delayed for some reason, sunflower [सुर्यफुल] is a suitable crop [पीक] as an emergency alternative. This crop [पीक] can tolerate water stress [पाण्याचा ताण] to a considerable extent. To increase the average productivity of sunflower [सुर्यफुल], it is essential to use improved hybrid varieties and advanced cultivation techniques.

**Climate [हवामान]:** Sunflower [सुर्यफुल] crop [पीक] can give good yield [उत्पादन] in rainfall of 700 to 1000 mm.

**Soil [माती]:** Select well-drained, medium to heavy soil [माती]. Avoid growing sunflower [सुर्यफुल] after sunflower [सुर्यफुल] as much as possible.

**Pre-cultivation and Manuring [खत देणे]:** Plough [नांगर] the land deep once every three years. Give 2-3 harrowing [वखरणी] to make the soil [माती] friable. Before the final harrowing [वखरणी], mix 5 to 10 tons of well-decomposed farmyard manure [शेणखत] or compost [कंपोस्ट] per hectare into the soil [माती].

**Recommended Varieties/Breeds:** For all three seasons.

question: सगण आंबा बागेचे व्यवस्थापन कसे करावे?
answer:
सगुण आंबा बागेचे व्यवस्थापन हे झाडाच्या वयानुसार छाटणी, खत देणे आणि पाणी देण्याची पद्धत या तीन गोष्टी ठरवून करणे सोपे होते.

**छाटणी (फळ येणाऱ्या झाडे):**  
- काढणीनंतर पहिली छाटणी जून/जुलैपर्यंत पूर्ण करा  
  - खालच्या लावड्या फांद्या काढणे  
  - आतल्या गुंडाळलेल्या फांद्या काढून अंदाजे प्रकाश जाऊ द्या  
  - रोगट/वाळलेल्या फांद्या काढणे  
  - एका वेळी एकूण वाढीच्या २५% पेक्षा जास्त भाग काढू नका  
- फुलोरा येण्यापूर्वी दुसरी छाटणी मध्य डिसेंबरपासून सुरू करून १२ आठवड्यांत पूर्ण करा  
  - खालच्या लावड्या फांद्या काढणे  
  - टिप छाटणी: नवे झुरखे परिपक्व लोहभागापर्यंत कपाय (फुलगंधासाठी)  

**खत व्यवस्थापन:**  
- गांडूळखत/घनजीवंमृत: प्रति झाड १०–२० किग्रा जून/जुलैत आणि ऑक्टोबर/नोव्हेंबरत (झाडाच्या वयाप्रमाणे)  
- कोरडवाहू फळझाडांसाठी रासायनिक खते वर्षात ३ समान हप्त्यांत देण्याची शिफारस आहे: जून–जुलै, सप्टेंबर–ऑक्टोबर, जानेवारी–फेब्रुवारी; झाडाच्या कर्णाभोवती अंगठी/सरी पद्धतीने द्या  
- घनजीवंमृत + जीवनजीवंमृत: ५ वर्षे वयाच्या (आणि पुढे) बागेसाठी पानांवरील फवारणी—पहिला फवारणी डिसेंबर/जनवरीत १५ ली. जीवनजीवंमृत २०० ली. पाण्यात मिसळून, दुसरा फवारणी फेब्रुवारी/मार्चत ३० ली. जीवनजीवंमृत २०० ली. पाण्यात मिसळून  

**फुलगंधा प्रवर्तक (बागांचा दरवर्षी फुलगंधा होत नाही अशा बागांसाठी):**  
- आयसीएआर अहवालानुसार आंब्यात फुलगंधा प्रवर्तनासाठी मातीमध्ये पीबीझचा वापर केला आहे; खर्च-कार्यक्षम शिफारस म्हणून पहिल्या वर्षी ४ ग्रॅम/झाड (अ‍ॅक्टिव्ह इंग्रिडियंट) आणि त्यानंतर अर्धी मात्रा २ ग्रॅम/झाड (दुसरे वर्ष) अशी शिफारस दिली आहे  
- सलग दोन वर्षे वापर केल्यास मातीवर टिकवणूक दिसली असल्याने ही मात्रा खूप काळजीपूर्वक द्या; अधिक मार्गदर्शन स्थानिक कृषी अधिकाऱ्यांकडून घ्या  

**स्रोत: नॅचरल फार्मिंग ट्रेनिंग टूलकिट अँड बेस्ट प्रॅक्टिसेस गाईड; डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ; आयसीएआर वार्षिक अहवाल २०२३–२४**  

तुमची आंबा बाग किती वर्षे जुनी आहे आणि सध्या दरवर्षी फुलगंधा होतो का?

Pre-Monsoon [पावसाळा] Dry [कोरडे] Sowing [पेरणी] in Mango [आंबा] Orchards

 Farmers establishing new orchards should first carry out pre-monsoon [पावसाळा] dry [कोरडे] sowing [पेरणी] and then plant grafts of high-yielding mango [आंबा] varieties to ensure good establishment and growth [वाढ].

- In orchards aged 05 years, along with pre-monsoon [पावसाळा] dry [कोरडे] sowing [पेरणी], grow intercrops such as coarse cereals, pulses, vegetables, leafy vegetables, and vine crops like pumpkin [भोपळा] and bottle gourd [दुधी भोपळा].
- Filler fruit crops such as papaya [पपई], drumstick (moringa [शेवगा]), and fig [अंजीर] can also be planted between two rows of mango [आंबा] trees.
- In orchards older than 5 years:
 - In shaded areas, grow rhizome [कंद] crops and root vegetables such as turmeric [हळद], ginger [आले], carrot [गाजर], beetroot [बीट], onion [कांदा], and radish [मुळा], along with leafy vegetables.
 - In sunny areas, adopt a multi-cropping system [पीक प्रणाली].
- Document the income obtained from the main crop [पीक] and intercrops.

(ii) Canopy [पर्णछाया] Management [व्यवस्थापन] in Mango [आंबा] Plants

Canopy [पर्णछाया] management [व्यवस्थापन] in young plants:

- Training [प्रशिक्षण] during the juvenile stage [किशोरावस्था] is necessary to give the plant a strong framework.
- Allow the graft to grow as a single stem up to a height of 1 meter above ground level.
- In OctoberNovember, cut the top at a height of 60 cm 70 cm to encourage primary branches.
- In MarchApril, 37 primary branches will emerge, of which 34 should be retained in different directions.
- In OctoberNovember, cut the primary branches at 60 cm 70 cm to encourage secondary branching.
- From secondary branches, retain 23 branches per primary branch.
- Tertiary branches are obtained by cutting secondary branches at 60 cm 70 cm.

question: रोपवाटिकेतील 'रोप कोलमडणे' (Damping Off) साठी घरगुती उपाय काय आहेत?
answer:
रोपवाटिकेतील रोप कोलमडणे (रोप सड रोग) हा मातीतला बुरशीजन्य रोग असल्याने घरगुती उपाय म्हणून उपलब्ध दस्तऐवजांमध्ये ताबडतोब वापरता येईल अशी अचूक माहिती मिळाली नाही; पण रोपांची मर कमी करण्यासाठी बीज प्रक्रिया आणि कंपोस्ट/खाते यांद्वारे आधीचे नियंत्रण शक्य आहे.

**बीज प्रक्रिया:**
- बीजप्रक्रियेत १० ग्रॅम प्रति किग्रा बियाणे या मात्रेत जैवउत्पादन वापरण्याची पद्धत दिलेली आहे, जी रोपमर/रोपांची मर कमी करून उत्पादन वाढवते असे नमूद आहे.

**माती व खते (घरगुती पर्याय):**
- कंपोस्टमधील सूक्ष्मजीव (उदा. बॅसिलस स्प.) मुळे रोप सड रोगाचा प्रादुर्भाव कमी होऊ शकतो असे दिलेले आहे.
- रोपवाटिकेची माती ओलसर राहू देऊ नका; पाण्याचा निचरा योग्य ठेवा कारण जास्त निचऱ्याच्या अभावी हा रोग वाढतो.

**कीड व रोग नियंत्रण (फक्त पीकनिहाय इथे उपलब्ध): मिरची रोपवाटिका:**
- कॅप्टन ७५% डब्ल्यू.पी. २.५ ग्रॅम प्रति ली. पाणी
- कार्बेन्डाझिम ७५% डब्ल्यू.पी. २ ग्रॅम प्रति ली. पाणी
- मेटालेक्सिल-एम ३१.८% ई.एस. २.० मि.ली. प्रति ली. पाणी
- मॅन्कोझेब ७५% डब्ल्यू.पी. ३ ग्रॅम प्रति ली. पाणी

**स्रोत: आयसीएआर बायोपेस्टिसाइड्स मार्गदर्शक, जनावरे आरोग्य व पोषण विस्तार मार्गदर्शक, कृषी व्ही.एन.एम.ए.यू., डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषि विद्यापीठ?**

तुमच्या बोर्डी (तालुका मालेगाव, जिल्हा वाशिम) परिसरात शेती यंत्रे भाड्याने मिळण्यासाठी खालील कस्टम हायरिंग सेंटर उपलब्ध आहेत; पण या माहितीमध्ये नेमकी कोणती यंत्रे (उदा. रोटावेटर, स्प्रेअर, ट्रॉली) आहेत हे यादीस्वरूपात दिलेले नाही.

**कस्टम हायरिंग सेंटर:**
- वेदाश्री फार्मर प्रोड्यूसर कंपनी लिमिटेड  
  पत्ता: चिकनाथ महाराज पुस्तिका मार्ग, दत्तनगर, नंदी गेट, मालेगाव, जिल्हा वाशिम  
  संपर्क: राहुल सुभाष लंडकार  
  फोन: ९०९६६१८३००  
  अंतर: २ कि.मी.

- ग्रोग्रीन अॅग्रोनॉमिक्स प्रोड्यूसर कंपनी लिमिटेड  
  पत्ता: मादमाईचा बाजार, हटकरबाग, धुरायाचा तावडी, मालेगाव, जिल्हा वाशिम  
  संपर्क: आशिश श्यामसुंदर मुंडहाडा  
  फोन: ९४२३६१११५२  
  अंतर: ७ कि.मी.

- मुंगसाजी महाraj स्वयं साहायता बचत गट  
  पत्ता: उडी, मालेगाव, जिल्हा वाशिम  
  संपर्क: jyoti धनंजयराव घुगे  
  फोन: ८६००२८५१३२  
  अंतर: ९ कि.मी.

- पैंगंगा मार्केटिंग अँड फार्मर प्रोड्यूसर कंपनी  
  पत्ता: मानपूर, भैंसी ठाणे, मालेगाव, जिल्हा वाशिम  
  संपर्क: शिवाराम राव वघ  
  फोन: ९५५२०६७६४६  
  अंतर: १० कि.मी.

- तपेनाथ फार्मर प्रोड्यूसर कंपनी लिमिटेड  
  पत्ता: मोतीनगर, मालेगाव, जिल्हा वाशिम  
  संपर्क: अनिल बाबन जोगडांड  
  फोन: ७०२८४४४४३३  
  अंतर: ११ कि.मी.

**स्रोत: कृषी सेवा माहिती**

तुम्हाला नेमकी कोणती यंत्रे भाड्याने हवी आहेत—रोटावेटर, टूलहॉर्स, पंप/स्प्रेअर, काढणी किंवा दाणा सोखणी—यापैकी कोणते? ?

question: शेतीत जीवामृताचा वापर करण्याचे फायदे काय आहेत?
answer:
जीवामृताचा वापर केल्याने मातीतील उपयुक्त जिवाणू वाढतात, पिकांना पोषक तत्वे पुरेशी मिळतात आणि पीकवाढ प्रोत्साहित होते.

**माती:**  
- मातीमधील उपयुक्त जीवाणूंची संख्या वाढते  
- मातीचे कार्बन प्रमाण वाढते  

**पीक व उत्पादन:**  
- पिकांना पोषक तत्वे पुरेशी मात्रेत उपलब्ध होतात  
- पीकवाढ प्रोत्साहन जास्त दिसून येते  
- कीड व रोगांचा प्रादुर्भाव कमी होण्याची नोंद आहे  

**खर्च व आर्थिक फायदा:**  
- घरातील शेण व घरच्या घरी बनवलेला हरभरा पीठ वापरल्यामुळे उत्पादन खर्च कमी होतो आणि उत्पन्न वाढते असे नमूद आहे  

**स्रोत: डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषि विद्यापीठ; नैसर्गिक शेती प्रशिक्षण टूलकिट व सर्वोत्तम पद्धती मार्गदर्शक**  

जीवामृत तुम्ही कोणत्या पिकासाठी देणार आहात—भाजीपाला की डाळ/कंदफळांसाठी??

Ingredients: Cow [गाय] (fresh dung [शेण]) - 5 kg, Cow [गाय] urine [मूत्र] - 3 litres, Milk [दूध] - 3 litres, Cow [गाय] milk [दूध] curd - 2 litres, Ghee [तूप] - 1/2 kg, Sugarcane [ऊस] juice - 3 litres or Jaggery [गूळ] - 3 kg, Coconut [नारळ] water - 3 litres, Ripe bananas - one dozen, Toddy/Madi - 2 litres. ``` ---- **Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth** ``` **Various Inputs Useful in Natural Farming [नैसर्गिक शेती]** **Jivamrut** | 10 liters of desi cow urine [देशी गायीचे मूत्र] | 1 kg of gram flour [हरभरा पीठ] | | --- | --- | | 10 kg of desi cow dung [शेण] | 1 kg of jaggery [गूळ] | | 1 kg of soil [माती] under banyan / peepal [पिंपळ] tree | 180 liters of water | | 1 liter of bacterial culture | Water tank of 200 liter capacity | **Method of Preparing Jivamrut:** For preparing Jivamrut, measure all the required ingredients as above. Cover the tank with a gunny sack and keep the mixture in the shade overnight. The mixture can be used for seed treatment [बीज प्रक्रिया] on the second day. ``` ---- **Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth** ``` **Benefits of Using Ghan-Jivamrut:** 1. In organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती], the yield [उत्पादन] increases by 8 to 10 percent if bacterial fertilizers like Rhizobium [रायझोबियम], Azotobacter, Azospirillum, Acetobacter, PSB are used as supplementary fertilizers according to the crop [पीक] to increase the number of beneficial bacteria [उपयुक्त जिवाणू]. At the same time, following the right cropping system [पीक प्रणाली] in organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती] improves the soil texture [जमीनीचा पोत] and provides economic benefits. In organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती], nutrient management [अन्नद्रव्य व्यवस्थापन] has to be done as per the needs of the crops. At the same time, it is possible to use biodynamic, Jeevamrut [जीवामृत], Beejamrut [बीजामृत], Panchagavya [पंचगव्य] etc. in organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती]. In addition to this, organic crop protection [सेंद्रिय पीक संरक्षण] recommendations have to be used to control diseases and pests. **Beejamrut [बीजामृत] (Seed Treatment [बीज प्रक्रिया]):** Beejamrut [बीजामृत] can be used for seed treatment [बीज प्रक्रिया]. To prepare Beejamrut [बीजामृत], mix 1 kg of native cow dung [शेण], 1 liter of cow [गाय] urine [मूत्र], 100 ml of milk [दूध], 50 gm of lime [चुना], 50 gm of loamy soil [माती] and 100 gm of Trichoderma [ट्रायकोडर्मा] viride and soak this mixture overnight and can be used for seed treatment [बीज प्रक्रिया] on the second day. **Jeevamrut [जीवामृत]:** Mix 10 kg of cow [गाय] or bull dung [शेण], 10 liters of cow [गाय] urine [मूत्र], 2 kg of jaggery [गूळ], 2 kg of gram flour [हरभरा पीठ], 1 kg of forest soil [माती] in a plastic drum in 200 liters of water and stir the mixture 3 times a day for 5-7 days. This mixture can be given to the crop [पीक] in 1 acre area through water. **Amrut Pani:** Mix 10 kg of cow dung [शेण], 250 gm of cow [गाय] ghee [तूप] and 500 gm of jaggery [गूळ] in 200 liters of water and give this prepared Amrut Pani to 1 acre area through water at an interval of 30 days. ``` ---- **Natural Farming Training Toolkit & Best Practices Guide** ``` 6.2.3 *Ghanjeevamrit* In addition to the liquid *Jeevamrit*, natural farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] utilizes a solid version known as *Ghanjeevamrit* (Fig [अंजीर] 6.4). Unlike its liquid counterpart, which is used for immediate nutrient [पोषक घटक] and microbial delivery, *Ghanjeevamrit* can be stored for several months and is ideal for applying as a basal dose [प्राथमिक मात्रा (खताची)] during land preparation [जमीन तयार करणे] or as a top dressing [वरून खत देणे] for crops. This provides a slow and steady release of beneficial microbes and nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] directly into the root zone [मुळांचा भाग]. The technical composition, preparation protocol and functional mechanism of *Ghanjeevamrit* are detailed in Table 6.5 and the different compositions estimated in *Ghanjeevamrit* are given in Table 6.6. Fig [अंजीर]. 6.4: *Ghanjeevamrit* Preparation Training [प्रशिक्षण] The benefits of *Ghanjeevamrit* are: - Nutrient [पोषक घटक] Activation: Helps the soil [माती] to activate its available nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] and microorganisms [सूक्ष्मजीव], making them accessible to the crops. - Increased Earthworm Count: Increases the number of earthworms in the soil [माती], which is beneficial for soil fertility [मृदा सुपीकता]. - Nutrient [पोषक घटक] Content: *Jeevamrit* contains many nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] such as nitrogen [नत्र], phosphorus [स्फुरद], calcium [कॅल्शियम], and other micronutrients [सुक्ष्म अन्नद्रव्ये]. - Higher Yield [उत्पादन]: Enhances the availability of nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] through faster decomposition of bulky organic [सेंद्रिय] manures and boosts microbial activity [सूक्ष्मजैविक क्रिया] in the soil [माती]. Microbial Richness: Many formulations are rich in beneficial microflora and can act as efficient plant growth [वाढ] promoters. If we do not treat these seeds and sow [मादी डुक्कर] them as they are, all these harmful fungi go into the soil [माती] along with the seeds and spread as soon as they get favorable conditions and penetrate the roots of the seedlings and patches fall on all the leaves and the leaves fall off. *Introduction*:
The Central Government has issued Operational Guidelines in the year 2024 for implementing the Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana - Per Drop More Crop, a centrally sponsored micro-irrigation scheme. This scheme is being implemented from the year 2022-23 under the name Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana - Per Drop More Crop. The Commissionerate of Agriculture, has issued guidelines for the micro-irrigation scheme. On the lines of this scheme, a micro-irrigation scheme (Drip and Sprinkler Irrigation) will be implemented under the Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Project. Accordingly, the following guidelines are being issued for implementing the approved micro-irrigation component in the villages selected under the project.

*Benefits*:
1.To increase the area under micro-irrigation by using modern technology in the project districts and to promote climate-resilient farming practices.
2. To encourage micro-irrigation methods for the development of agriculture and horticulture crops based on modern technology.
3. To manage fertilizers through the micro-irrigation system.
4. To increase agricultural production, the quality of agricultural produce, and consequently, the total income of farmers.
5. To increase water use efficiency.

*Eligibility*:
1. Farmers who have already received benefits on same land from any other scheme will not be eligible under this scheme.
2. If the farmer has availed the benefits of micro-irrigation components under any government scheme in the last 7 years, such areas will be excluded, and the remaining area can receive benefits within the total limit of 5 hectares.
3. The farmer must have access to water supply and electricity.
4. The benefits of this component under the project will be available to beneficiaries who own up to 5 hectares of land.

*Required Documents*:
1. If the applicant belongs to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe category, a caste certificate should be provided.
2. If the applicant is a joint account holder, a consent letter from the other account holders shall be submitted.
3. If the applicant is a person with disability, a disability certificate should be provided.

There is no need for farmer to visit a government office to apply for subsidy or receive disbursed funds. Also, farmers can track and monitor their applications in real time which shows transparency in NDKSP operations. This system facilitates NDKSP to perform its approval process in 100% paperless manner which eliminates intermediaries and establishes credibility.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for Drone Applications in Agriculture [शेती]

## SECTION-A: Pesticides for Crop Protection [पीक संरक्षण]

### Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for applying Pesticides for Crop Protection [पीक संरक्षण] by Using Drones in Agricultural, Forestry and Non-Cropped Area etc.

## Objectives

Indian Agriculture [शेती] has gone through rapid advancements and has benefited from research and adoption of new technologies by farmers. Technologies like drip irrigation [ठिबक सिंचन], mechanized farming [शेती करणे] for planting, harvesting [कापणी] and grading [गटवारी] are being successfully used for sustainable agriculture [शाश्वत शेती] in India.

In recent years, use of drone in agriculture [शेती] has gained prominence and some states are actively engaged in checking the suitability of this new technology in Indian agriculture [शेती]. Application of pesticides using drones has a great potential as we move towards commercialization and achieving precision in agricultural crops.

Drones are going to be important for increasing efficiency of application of crop protection chemicals [पीक संरक्षण रसायने] by reducing manpower requirement, reducing time of application, reducing volume of water, quantity of chemicals and saving drift to environment along with reducing exposure to human being to hazardous chemicals.

**11\. Greenhouse [हरितगृह] Area:** For general farmers to benefit economically, the greenhouse [हरितगृह] area should be at least 500 sq. m. The distance between the two upright pillars of the greenhouse [हरितगृह] should be 3 to 4 m. The length of a multi-span greenhouse [हरितगृह] should be approximately 20 to 25 meters. This will help in efficient ventilation [हवेची आदळ] through the side walls and roof vents. If a single-span greenhouse [हरितगृह] is to be constructed, the width should be approximately 6 to 8 meters.

**12\. Plastic Film Installation:** The covering work should be done when the air temperature [हवामानातील तापमान] is low and the wind [वारा] speed is low so that the film can be stretched properly and installed in a way that it will not tear. Use synthetic wire as much as possible when installing the film.

**13\. Temperature [तापमान] and Humidity [आर्द्रता] Control:** Considering the crop [पीक] to be grown in the greenhouse [हरितगृह] and its use, provide fan and pad systems or fogging facilities for climate [हवामान] control.

**14\. Use of Pesticides:** It is necessary to take care that pesticides are not sprayed on the plastic film while spraying [फवारणी] pesticides on the crops in the greenhouse [हरितगृह].

**15\. Weed Control [तण नियंत्रण] in Greenhouses:** To control weeds [तण] in greenhouses, it is beneficial to use black plastic film as a covering on the soil [माती] before planting the crop [पीक].

**16\. Energy and its Use:** In cold regions or especially in winter, the temperature [तापमान] outside at night is very low, which helps the internal energy to escape into the atmosphere. If the proper temperature [तापमान] is not maintained inside the greenhouse [हरितगृह] at night, crop [पीक] growth [वाढ] and yield [उत्पादन] can decrease. Therefore, put a black film on the roof of the greenhouse [हरितगृह] as needed during extreme cold.

**17\. Airtight Construction:** There is a big difference between the greenhouse [हरितगृह] and the outside environment, and airtight construction is necessary to maintain this difference. For this, a plastic film covering is very important. If the greenhouse [हरितगृह] is not airtight, the efficiency of the greenhouse [हरितगृह] is reduced by approximately 25 percent if outside air enters during the night.

Two factors should be considered when deciding on the direction of the greenhouse [हरितगृह]:

1. The growing crop [पीक] should get sufficient sunlight.
2. The greenhouse [हरितगृह] should not be endangered by the prevailing winds. Considering both these factors, the direction of the greenhouse [हरितगृह] should be south-north. Because of this, the top vent will be in the east/north direction.

**Technical Aspects to Keep in Mind While Constructing a Greenhouse [हरितगृह]**

Technical aspects to keep in mind while constructing a greenhouse [हरितगृह]

1. A strong foundation should be taken for the pillars. The size of the pit should be 1.5x1.5 x 2 feet. After installing the foundation pipe in the middle of it and inserting the hold-fast bar, concrete should be filled. While filling the concrete, the ratio [प्रमाण] of cement, sand, and gravel should be 1:4:8.
2. The vent to be placed on the roof should be 0.8 to 1.0 meters high and the direction of the vent should be east or north.
3. The width of one compartment of the greenhouse [हरितगृह] should not be more than 8 meters.
4. A GI sheet gutter should be provided on the polythene film of the roof between the two compartments to carry rainwater.
5. The film required for the roof should be of ultra-violet stabilized plastic and its thickness should be 200 microns. Other specifications should be as per the standards while using the film. About 5.3 sq. m. area can be covered in 1 kg of film. The transparency of the film should be of high quality (80 to 85 percent).
6. The fitting of the polythene film should be done in the aluminum channel patty with the help of GI springs.
7. A space of 3 meters should be kept on all four sides for ventilation [हवेची आदळ], and there should be a provision to close it with the help of curtains at night.
8. Of the materials used for erecting the greenhouse [हरितगृह], the materials for which ISI/BIS standards have been set must meet those standards.
9. The height of the greenhouses for Konkan, Marathwada, and Western Maharashtra should be 6 m, and for Khandesh and Vidarbha, it should be 6.50 m.
10. The size of the foundation pipe of the greenhouse [हरितगृह] should be 60 mm and the size of the column should be 76 mm.

question: एक एकर गव्हासाठी बियाण्याचे प्रमाण किती लागते?
answer:
एका एकर गहू पेरणीसाठी बियाण्याचे प्रमाण तुमची पेरणी पावसावर आहे की सिंचित आहे, आणि ती वेळेत आहे की उशिरा आहे यावर बदलते.

question: हरभरा पेरणीची योग्य वेळ कोणती आहे?
answer:
हरभरा पेरणीची योग्य वेळ ही तुमच्या शेतात पाऊस झाला की रब्बी हंगामात सुरू होणाऱ्या काळात येते, आणि महाराष्ट्रातील कमी पर्जन्यक्षेत्र/दुष्काळप्रवण भागासाठी साधारण पन्नास-शेतीकरी दोन ते पन्नास-शेतीकरी तीन हे प्रमुख वेळापत्रक दिलेले आहे.

**पेरणीचा काळ:**
- मिड-सीझन करेक्शन (पाऊस उशीराने आल्यास): पन्नास-शेतीकरी एक ते पन्नास-शेतीकरी तीन या आठवड्यांत हरभरा पेरणी करावी असे शिफारसीत आहे  
- दुष्काळप्रवण भागातील मध्यम ते खोल माती: पन्नास-शेतीकरी दोन ते पन्नास-शेतीकरी तीन मध्ये हरभरा पेरणी करावी  

**माती तयारीची तारीख:**
- खरीप पीक काढणीनंतर शेताची तयारी पन्नास-शेतीकरी अखेर पर्यंत पूर्ण करणे शिफारसीत आहे  

**माती:**
- चांगला निचरा असलेली मध्यम ते भारी काळी, सुपीक माती निवडावी  
- धूपट, दगडी, पाण्यात बसलेली, लवणी किंवा ऍलकलाइन माती टाळावी  
- मातीचा सामू साधारण ६.५ ते ७.५ राहील अशा मातीची निवड करावी

- एटीएमए योजनेत आधारभूत शिक्षण सुधारणा (एटीएमए) मार्गदर्शक सूचनांनुसार शेतकऱ्यांना पद्धतशीर प्रशिक्षणानंतर स्किल प्रमाणपत्र देण्याचा उल्लेख आहे; त्यामध्ये प्रत्यक्ष प्रशिक्षण व तपासणी केव्हीके/बहुद्देशीय संस्था यांच्या सहकार्याने होऊ शकते.

# Concept Note on Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) based Training [प्रशिक्षण] of Farmers
## 1. Background:
Agriculture [शेती] represent significant and skilled sector in which majority of the cultivation task need higher skills that include land preparation [जमीन तयार करणे], seed treatment [बीज प्रक्रिया], sowing [पेरणी], fertilizer application [खत देणे], pest management [कीड व्यवस्थापन], farm mechanization [शेतीचे यांत्रिकीकरण], irrigation [सिंचन], harvesting [कापणी], storage [साठवण], marketing etc. Several cultivation tasks involve intellectual understanding of the package of practices, tools & techniques and process to execute farming practices [शेती पद्धती].
As a matter of fact, farmers are performing field [शेत] operations from production [उत्पादन] to marketing of farm produce and skilfully undertaken such activities by virtue of their traditional & scientific knowledge and farming [शेती करणे] experience. It has often been felt that most of the Indian farmers have only access to traditional knowledge [पारंपरिक ज्ञान] and in most cases there is huge gap in existing knowledge and new skill sets required in modernizing agriculture [शेती].
Besides, farmers need to be empowered with latest farming [शेती करणे] technologies like irrigation [सिंचन] systems, mechanization [यांत्रिकीकरण], high yielding varieties [जास्त उत्पादन देणारे वाण], INM and IPM. However application of technology requires up-gradation of knowledge through training [प्रशिक्षण] and advisory services. This shall be achieved through short-term bridge courses in the priority areas of agriculture [शेती] and allied sector, which will act as enabler for upskilling and empowering the farmers.
2. Vision [दृष्टी]: To recognize the prior learning and up-skilling of 1.25 crore farmers in next five years for the period from 2021-22 to 2025-26.
## 3. Objective:
- To assess the competence of farmers in the structured framework through RPL and up-skilling them to adopt improved farm practices.
## 4. Implementation Strategy for RPL:
- ATMA being the Project Implementing Agency at District [जिल्हा] level to coordinate with KVKs, SAUs, agriculture [शेती] & allied Departments, District [जिल्हा] Training [प्रशिक्षण] Centres and other local bodies to implementing Guidelines for the same will be issued to States to conduct 2 days RPL based bridge training [प्रशिक्षण] for capacity building of farmers in agriculture [शेती] and allied areas.
- All farmers including women farmers [महिला शेतकरी] imparted training [प्रशिक्षण] under Extension Reforms(ATMA) to undergo five step RPL process (i) Mobilization, (ii) Counselling & pre-screening, (iii) Orientation, (iv) Assessment & (v) Certification.

question: नाशिक भागात गेल्या दोन दिवसांत द्राक्ष बागेवर परिणाम होईल इतकी थंडी होती का?
answer:
नाशिक भागात गेल्या काही दिवसांत किमान तापमान साधारण पंधरा ते वीस डिग्री सेल्सिअसच्या आसपास राहिलेले दिसते, त्यामुळे खूप तीव्र थंडीची नोंद या उपलब्ध ऐतिहासिक माहितीत नाही.

- तारीख ११ मार्च: किमान तापमान १९.२°C, कमाल तापमान ३७.७°C
- तारीख १२ मार्च: किमान तापमान १९.६°C, कमाल तापमान ३८.२°C
- तारीख १३ मार्च: किमान तापमान १९.४°C, कमाल तापमान ३८.३°C
- तारीख १४ मार्च: किमान तापमान २०.५°C, कमाल तापमान ३७.८°C

b) **Natural Ventilation [हवेची आदळ] Greenhouse [हरितगृह]:** This type of greenhouse [हरितगृह] is based on natural ventilation [हवेची आदळ], based on which temperature [तापमान], humidity [आर्द्रता], and carbon dioxide gas levels can be maintained according to the requirements of the crops. question: शेतासाठी हार्वेस्टर घेण्यास कोणती योजना मदत करते?
answer:
शेतासाठी हार्वेस्टर (पिक काढणी यंत्र) घ्यायचे असल्यास खालील योजना अनुदानात मदत करतात.

**राज्य पुरस्कृत कृषी यांत्रिकीकरण** ही राज्य योजना आहे जी शेती यंत्रे व अवजारे विक्रयण्यासाठी आर्थिक मदत देते.  
**उप-अभियान कृषी यांत्रिकीकरण** ही केंद्र योजना आहे जी शेती यंत्रे व अवजारे विक्रयण्यासाठी आर्थिक मदत देते.

**लाभ:**
- शेतकऱ्यांना यंत्र/अवजारे विक्रयण्यासाठी अनुदान; साधारणपणे अनुसूचित जाती, अनुसूचित जमाती, लहान शेतकरी, महिला शेतकरी यांच्यासाठी ४०% आणि इतर शेतकऱ्यांसाठी ५०% इतके अनुदान (किंवा शासनाने जाहीर केलेली कमाल मर्यादा—यापैकी जो कमी असेल तो); कमाल अनुदान रक्कम शासन ठरवते

**पात्रता:**
- वैयक्तिक शेतकरी

**आवश्यक कागदपत्रे:**
- विक्री करायच्या अवजार/यंत्राचा कोटेशन
- अवजार/यंत्राचा चाचणी अहवाल
- ट्रॅक्टर चालित अवजारे असतील तर ट्रॅक्टरची वाहन नोंदणीपत्रिका

तुम्हाला ट्रॅक्टर चालित ग्रेन हार्वेस्टर (मका/तूर/हरभरा/बाजरी) घ्यायचा आहे की पॉवर मिलनिंग/थ्रेशिंगसारखे वेगळे यंत्र? ?

*Id*:
61

*Scheme Code*:
sdda-farm-machinery-and-equipments

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
DDA MECHANIZATION

*Scheme Name*:
State Sponsored Agriculture Mechanization

*Main Component*:
Benefit for Farm Machinery and Equipments.

*Sub Component*:
Tractors, power tillers, automated machinery, tractor-operated implements, tractor-operated crop protection implements, and post-harvest primary processing implements.

*Introduction*:
The declining number of livestock and the shortage of labor for agricultural work necessitate mechanization in agriculture. Mechanization allows work to be completed within a specified time frame, saves inputs, and saves production costs.
Objective:-
        Resolve labour issues in agriculture.
        Promote Farm Mechanization.
        Enable farmers to take up farm operations in time.
        Promote custom hiring services for farm mechanization.
        Create rural employment.
        Help to Increase agriculture production.

*Benefits*:
1. Financial assistance to farmers for procurement of farm machinery and implements
2. Generally, the subsidy is given at a rate of 40 % for SC, ST & small farmers, Womens & 50% for other farmers percent of the cost or the maximum subsidy limit declared by the Central Government, whichever is lower.

*Eligibility*:
Individual Farmer.

*Required Documents*:
1. Quotation of Implement to be purchase.
2. Test report of the Implement.
3. RC of tractor for tractor driven implements.

*Application Process*:
Applications from Interested farmers are invited on https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/ this portal. For transparency in beneficiary selection, presanction is being given by determining seniority through FCFS method. All the processes from beneficiary selection to grant payment are being implemented online.
After presanction, farmers are being allowed to purchase from the open market as per their choice. At the time of purchase, farmers are required to make payment through cheque/DD/online from their own bank account. The subsidy amount is being transferred to the Aadhaar-linked bank account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) method.

question: मी माझ्या शेतामध्ये कापसाची लागवड करण्याची योजना आखत आहे. यासाठी मी पात्र असलेल्या कोणत्याही शासकीय योजना आहेत का?
answer:
कापूस लागवडीसाठी तुमच्यासाठी काही शासकीय योजना उपलब्ध आहेत; पण नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्पाअंतर्गत ठिबक/तुषार/शेततळे या पोक्रा योजना तुमच्या गावासाठी लागू नाहीत, कारण तुमचे गाव पोक्रा-नियुक्त नाही.

**राष्ट्रीय अन्न सुरक्षा आणि पोषण अभियान (एन.एफ.एस.एन.एम.) — व्यापारी पीक कापूस विकास योजना** ही राज्य योजना आहे जी कापसासाठी प्रात्यक्षिके, वरचा घनता लागवड चाचण्या, एकात्मिक पीक व्यवस्थापन प्रात्यक्षिके, कापूस बिया उत्पादन, रोग-कीड व्यवस्थापनासाठी उपाय देते.  
**लाभ:**
- मूग/उडीद आंतरपीक प्रात्यक्षिक: **₹८००० प्रति हे.**
- वरचा घनता लागवड चाचण्या: **₹१०००० प्रति हे.**
- एकात्मिक पीक व्यवस्थापन प्रात्यक्षिक: **₹८००० प्रति हे.**
- कापूस बिया उत्पादन (देशी/अतिदीर्घ तंतू) प्रात्यक्षिक: **₹९००० प्रति हे.**
- वनस्पती संरक्षण औषधे व जैव एजंट वितरण: **₹५०० प्रति हे.** किंवा खर्चाच्या ५०% (जे कमी ते)
- ऑनलाईन कीड निगरानी व सल्ला सेवा: **₹८००० प्रति हे.**
- लवकर काढणी व अवशेष काढणी प्रात्यक्षिक: **₹५००० प्रति हे.**
- बायोचॅर: **₹१०००० प्रति युनिट**

**पात्रता:**
- पीक प्रात्यक्षिके गट लाभार्थ्यांसाठी (टीप: बायोचॅर वैयक्तिक लाभार्थीसाठी)
- महाराष्ट्रातील कापूस विकास कार्यक्रम योजनेत नंदुरबार जिल्हा समाविष्ट आहे

**प्रधानमंत्री किसान सन्मान निधी योजना (पीएम-किसान)** ही केंद्र योजना आहे जी **₹६००० प्रति वर्ष** मदत ३ समान हप्त्यांत देते.

**पात्रता:**
- लागवडीयोग्य जमीनधारक शेतकरी कुटुंब (कार्यान्वयन निकषांसह)

**प्रधानमंत्री फसल विमा योजना (पीएमएफबीवाई)** ही केंद्र योजना आहे जी अधिसूचित पिकांसाठी नैसर्गिक आपत्ती, कीड व रोगामुळे झालेल्या पीक नुकसानावर विमा संरक्षण देते.

**पात्रता:**
- अधिसूचित क्षेत्रात अधिसूचित पिके घेणारे सर्व शेतकरी; कर्जदार व बिगरकर्जदार दोघांसाठी पर्यायी

**राज्य पाठपुरावा कृषी यांत्रिकीकरण** ही राज्य योजना आहे जी ट्रॅक्टर, पॉवर टिलर, ट्रॅक्टर चालित अवजारे इत्यादींसाठी अनुदान देते.  
**लाभ:**
