question: Thibak sinchanat kshar sachne kase thambvave?
answer:
ठिबक सिंचनात क्षार (खारटपणा) थबकावा म्हणजे पाण्यातील आणि मातीतील क्षारांचा दबाव कमी करून पीक सुरक्षित ठेवणे; याला पाणी गुणवत्ता, निचरा, आणि जमिनीच्या प्रकारानुसार उपाय लागतात.

**माती व पाणी तपासणी:**
- जमिनीची ई.सी., पीएच, आणि इ.एस.पी. तसेच पाण्याची विद्राव्य क्षारांची मात्रा किंवा ३.१२ डी.एस./मी. पर्यंत आहे का हे माती परीक्षण/पाणी तपासणीने ठरवले पाहिजे.

**निचरा व्यवस्था:**
- खारयुक्त मातीसाठी जमिनीला सुमारे १% उतार देऊन शेतात चर खोदावेत; मग शेताला चांगले पाणी द्यावे आणि त्या चरांतून विद्राव्य क्षार बाहेर नेऊन सोडावेत.
- अतिरिक्त पाणी वापर टाळा आणि पाणी साचणे होऊ देऊ नका.

**ठिबक सिंचन पद्धत:**
- जर पाण्यातील विद्राव्य क्षारांची मात्रा ३.१२ डी.एस./मी. पेक्षा कमी असेल तर ठिबक वापरू शकता; अशा वेळी ओलसर क्षेत्राचे सुमारे २०% आच्छादन (ओव्हरलॅप) ठेवल्यामुळे ड्रिपरजवळ आर्द्रता स्थिर राहते आणि खारटपणाचा परिणाम कमी होतो.
- पीक ड्रिपरजवळ लावणे फायदेशीर असते.

**सेंद्रिय पदार्थ व पीक व्यवस्थापन:**
- सेंद्रिय खत आणि हिवरळीची खत जास्त प्रमाणात वापरावी; पीक अवशेषांचे आच्छादन करावे; पोक्रा गावात नसल्यास या गोष्टी महत्त्वाच्या आहेत.
- क्षार सहनशील पिके घ्या: गहू, ज्वारी, ऊस, मका, सुर्यफुल, कापूस, पालक, ल्युसेर्न अशी पिके उपलब्ध दस्तऐवजांत दिलेली आहेत.

**क्षारयुक्त की क्षारीय (सॉडिक) माती:**

1. Sulphur [गंधक]

Sulphur [गंधक] is used for improvement of the chalked alkaline soil [क्षारयुक्त जमीन]. By reaction of water and oxygen from air Sulphur [गंधक] generates Sulphuric acids these sulfuric acid’s make a reactions with lime [चुना] in the soil [माती] and produce Calcium [कॅल्शियम] sulphate (Gypsum [जिप्सम]). Chalk + Sulphur [गंधक] + Acid = Gypsum [जिप्सम] + Water + Carbon di-oxide. With generated gypsum [जिप्सम]’s calcium [कॅल्शियम] creates a relations with soil [माती] sodium then Sodium Sulphate generated. Because Sodium Sulphate is soluble in water, gets leeched out with water and the level of sodium reduces in the soils, so the soil [माती] become more workable and physical [शारीरिक तपासणी] properties of the soil [माती] improved and good. In chalked alkaline soil [क्षारयुक्त जमीन] with soil testing [माती परीक्षण], 1/5th the content of gypsum [जिप्सम] can be mixed with FYM and used as soil amendment [मृदा सुधारणा].

**C. Soil Management [मृदा व्यवस्थापन]**

1. **Land Leveling [जमीन समतलीकरण]:**

Leveling is essential for uneven or steeply sloping land. On unevenly levelled fields, water either doesn't reach the elevated areas or reaches in reduced quantities, while it accumulates in excess in low-lying areas. If there is an excessive slope, water applied through canals or wells runs off in the direction of the slope, and less water is available for irrigation [सिंचन]. In saline soils and soils with a high water table [पाण्याची पातळी], waterlogging [पाणी साचणे] should be avoided. Rainwater should also be directed in channels in the direction of the slope. Therefore, a slope of 0.05 to 0.25% is satisfactory for heavy soils, 0.20 to 0.40% for medium soils, and 0.25 to 0.35% for light [प्रकाश], sandy soils.

1. **Water Management [पाण्याचे व्यवस्थापन]:**

To reduce the salinity [खारटपणा] of the soil [माती] and to prevent the water table [पाण्याची पातळी] from rising after the reclamation of saline soils [क्षारयुक्त मृदेची पुनर्बांधणी], excessive use of water should be minimized. Effective techniques such as drip irrigation [ठिबक सिंचन] should be used. Drip irrigation [ठिबक सिंचन] allows for the efficient use of brackish or saline groundwater. If the water quality [पाण्याची गुणवत्ता], salt [मीठ] level, and soluble salt [मीठ] content are up to 2000 milligrams/liter or 3.12 decisiemens/meter, the water can be used for drip irrigation [ठिबक सिंचन]. A 20% overlap of wetted area is necessary to maintain a constant moisture content [आर्द्रता] near the dripper outlet. The concentration of salts in the brackish water [खारट पाणी] is thereby reduced. Therefore, planting the crop [पीक] near the dripper is beneficial.

question: संत्र्यामध्ये बहार धरण्याची योग्य वेळ कोणती?
answer:
संत्र्यात बहार (फुलोरा) नेमकी कधी घ्यायची हे तुम्ही कोणती बहार ठरवता त्यावर अवलंबून असते; आंबिया बहारीसाठी फुलोरा जानेवारी ते फेब्रुवारी, तर मृग बहारीसाठी फुलोरा जून ते जुलै या काळात येतो?

**बहार वेळ व पाण्याचा ताण:**  
- **आंबिया बहार:** फुलोरा जानेवारी–फेब्रुवारी, कापणी नोव्हेंबर–डिसेंबर; माध्यम मातीत संत्र्यासाठी ३० दिवस पाण्याचा ताण दिसतो डिसेंबर १५ ते जानेवारी १५ असा.  
- **मृग बहार:** फुलोरा जून–जुलै, कापणी फेब्रुवारी–मार्च; माध्यम मातीत संत्र्यासाठी ५० दिवस पाण्याचा ताण दिसतो एप्रिल २५ ते जून १५ असा.  

**स्रोत: डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ (बाहार व्यवस्थापन मार्गदर्शक)**

question: रोग निदानासाठी माझ्या शेताला भेट देऊ शकणारे कृषी विज्ञान केंद्राचे शास्त्रज्ञ उपलब्ध आहेत का?
answer:

अंतर: ५९ कि.मी.

संपर्क: सचिव, महात्मा गंधी मिशन, एन-६, सीआयडीसीओ, औरंगाबाद- ४३१ ००३  
अंतर: ६० कि.मी.

**कृषी विज्ञान केंद्र, बुलढाणा**  
पत्ता: कृषी विज्ञान केंद्र, बुलढाणा जिल्हा, महाराष्ट्र  
संपर्क: कुलगुरु, पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ, अकोला

question: कांदा पिकातील फुलकिडे (Thrips) कसे हाताळावे?
answer:
कांदा पिकातील फुलकिडे नियंत्रणासाठी सेंद्रिय जीवाणू फवारणी आणि गरज भासल्यास कीटकनाशक फवारणी यांचा पर्यायी वापर करा?

**कीड ओळख:**
- पानांवर कागडासारखे धूसर पांढरे डाग दिसणे, हळूहळू पाने तपकिरी होऊ वक्र/विकृत होणे?

**सेंद्रिय उपाय:**
- लागवडीनंतर ३० ते ३५ दिवसांनी वर्टिसिलियम लेकॅनी ४० ग्रॅम प्रति १० ली. पाणी फवारणी
- लागवडीनंतर ५५ ते ६० दिवसांनी मेटारिझियम अ‍ॅनिसोप्लिए ४० ग्रॅम प्रति १० ली. पाणी फवारणी?

**रासायनिक उपाय (पर्याय):**
- टॉल्फेनपायरॅड १५ ई.सी. २ मि.ली. प्रति १० ली. पाणी
- डेल्टामेथ्रिन ११ ई.सी. ३ मि.ली. प्रति १० ली. पाणी
- लॅम्ब्डा सायहॅलोथ्रिन ५% ई.सी. १० मि.ली. प्रति १० ली. पाणी  
ही फवारणी हातपंपाने पर्यायी स्वरूपात करा?

**इतर उपयुक्त उपाय:**
- कधीकधी ५% कडुलिंबाचे तेल फवारणी करा
- फवारणीवेळी स्टिकर ०.१% वापरा?

question: भात पिकावरील करपा रोगाची चिन्हे काय आहेत?
answer:
भात पिकावरील करपा रोगाची लक्षणे पानांवर, कणसामुळाशी आणि कणसाला दिसतात—रोपवाटिकेतून साधारणपणे लागवडीनंतरच्या अवस्थेपर्यंत; तसेच एका वेगळ्या जीवाणुजन्य कडाकरपा रोगात पानांच्या कडांना जळण्यासारखी लक्षणे दिसतात?

**लक्षणे:**
- रोपवाटिकेत सुरुवातीला पानांवर जांभळट डाग दिसतात.
- पीक वाढल्याने डागांचा आकार वाढतो; अनेक पानांवर अनेक डाग येतात.
- डाग मोठे झाल्यावर मधला भाग राखाडी रंगाचा होतो.
- कणसाचे बाहेर येण्याच्या काळात कणीसाचा खोड कोळपून काळपट होतो व कुजतो, तिथे कणीस तुटतो; तो टुटलेला कणीस अपरिपक्व राहतो (या अवस्थेला ग्रामीण भागात मनमोदी असेही म्हणतात).
- काही वेळा दाण्या भरण्याच्या प्रक्रियेत अडथळा येऊन दाणे भुसभुशीत होतात.

**जीवाणुजन्य कडाकरपा रोगातील (बॅक्टेरियल लिफ ब्लायट) वेगळी लक्षणे:**
- पानांच्या टोकांना व कडांना सुरुवातीला पिवळेपणा येतो, नंतर हा भाग राखाडी होतो; कडेलगतचा भाग सर्पिल (मांडवासारखा) दिसू शकतो.
- पानांच्या कडा जळल्यासारख्या दिसतात.

**स्रोत: कृषी दर्शनी डॉ. बाबासाहेब आंबेडकर मराठवाडा कृषी विद्यापीठ, औरंगाबाद; कृषी दर्शनी डॉ. बी. एस. के. के. व्ही., दापोली २०२५?**

question: केळी बागेसाठी कोणत्या सरकारी योजनेचा लाभ मिळू शकतो?
answer:
केळी बागेसाठी तुमच्या प्रोफाइलनुसार (नाला गाव, अक्कलकुवा तालुका, नंदुरबार जिल्हा; पोक्रा-नियुक्त गाव नाही) खालील योजनेंतर्गत लाभ मिळू शकतो:

**डॉ. बाबासाहेब आंबेडकर कृषी स्वावलंबन योजना** ही राज्य योजना आहे जी सिंचन सुविधा व ठिबक/तुषार स्रोत अनुदान घटक देते.  
**पात्रता:**
- अनुसूचित जाती/नवबौद्ध शेतकरी असणे आवश्यक (जातीचा दाखला)
- जमीनधारणा ०.२० हेक्टर ते ६.०० हेक्टर (काही घटकांसाठी किमान ०.४० हेक्टर लागते)
- महाडीबीटीवर ऑनलाईन अर्ज; निवड प्रथम येणाऱ्याला प्राधान्य पद्धतीने होते
- आधार संलग्न बँक खाते असणे आवश्यक
**अर्ज कसा करावा:**
- महाडीबीटी पोर्टलवरून अर्ज करायचा असतो

**पीएम-आर.के.व्ही.वाय.-पर ड्रॉप मोअर क्रॉप (पी.डी.एम.सी.)** ही केंद्र योजना आहे जी ठिबक व तुषार सेटसाठी अनुदान देते.  
**पात्रता:**
- ७/१२ आणि ८-अ धारक शेतकरी
- सिंचन स्रोत उपलब्ध असणे आवश्यक
**अर्ज कसा करावा:**
- महाडीबीटी पोर्टलवरून अर्ज करायचा असतो

**भावसाहेब फंडकर फलोत्पादन लागवड योजना** मधील नोंद केलेल्या दीर्घकालीन फळांच्या यादीत केळीचा समावेश दिसत नाही, म्हणून त्या योजनेमध्ये केळीसाठी पात्रता स्पष्ट नाही.  

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**?

तुम्ही केळी बागेसाठी ठिबक सिंचन टाकणार आहात की शेवगाळे उगवणीनंतरची पहिली लावणी/वाढ करणार आहात?

Selection of beneficiary is done throgh Mahadbt-Portal by lottery.

## 2. Scheme Information

*Id*:
65

*Scheme Code*:
mahadbt-baksy

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
Maha-DBT

*Scheme Name*:
Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar Krushi Swavalamban Yojana (BAKSY)

*Main Component*:
Providing Irrigation Fscilities to the eligible beneficiaries of Scheduled Cast (SC) category

*Sub Component*:
1. New Irrigation Well
2. Old Well Repair
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds
4. Inwell Boring
5. Electricity Connection
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)
7. Solar pump (instead of electrical connection Charges and pump set)
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)
9. Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) AND
     Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements)
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden

*Introduction*:
The Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan (Special Component Scheme(scp)) was being implemented from the year 1982-83 to increase the income of Scheduled Caste / New-Buddhist farmers and improve their standard of living. Since the said scheme has been implemented for a long period of time, the GOVERNMENT OF MAHARASHTRA has decided to implement the Special Component Scheme for Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist farmers since 1982-83 and the recommendations of the Agriculture Commissionerate dated 27/04/2016 on the report dated 19/04/2016 and special component scheme the announced by the Hon'ble Minister (Finance). Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana is not being implemented separately, but the current special component scheme, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana, is being implemented from 2016-17 as per the changed criteria, taking into account the needs of the changed situation and maintaining soil moisture.
Also, the government has approved the amendment in the financial criteria and inclusion of new components under the said scheme as per the government decision dated 01 October, 2024.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    beneficiary Selection criteria are as follows
1.  Scheme is only for Scheduled Caste/ Nav Baudha farmers.
2.  Scheme is implemented in all districts of Maharashtra (Except Mumbai districts).
3. At field level  scheme is under Implementation by department of Agriculture, Zilha Parishad.
4. Funds are released from Social Justice Department to concerned  District Collector and then made available to concern Zilha Parishad.
5. Application ,Selection of beneficiaries upto payment of subsidy all process are done through MAHADBT Portal through online system.                                                                  "

*Benefits*:
Benefit provided on subsidy basis as per the norms of components, through online system. The said scheme shall be implemented in the financial year 2025-26 as follows. In the said scheme, grants shall be admissible for the following components in the year 2025-26 up to the maximum limit of the amount mentioned below.
1. For New Irrigation- Well Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Rs.4,00,000/ - is admissible.
2. For Old Well Repair - Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 1,00,000/- is admissible
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds-Grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the amount calculated as per the prevailing financial parameters of the National Horticulture Mission Guideline and the size of the farm pond or actual cost or Rs. 2,00,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
4.Inwell Boring- Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 40,000/- is admissible
5. Electricity Connection-Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Amount 20,000/- or actual paid amount whichever is less is admissible.
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)(Diesel Engine - New Item) For pump sets up to 10 HP capacity, grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial parameters or actual cost or Rs. 40,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
7. Grant Solar pump (instead of electrical connection and pump set)- Maximum subsidy will be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial criteria or actual expenditure incurred or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)- Under the Food and Nutrition Security Scheme - Food Crops Scheme, subsidy of 100% of the prevailing economic standard or actual cost incurred per meter or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less will be admissible.
9.1 For Micro irrigation system Under Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) 9.1.1) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and9.1.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 47,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy. (Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
9.2 For Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant 9.2.1 ) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and 9.2.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 97,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy.(Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements) (New item)maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden (New Item) maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible .

*Eligibility*:
1. Scheme is only for Scheduled Tribe farmers. Caste  certificate is essential.
2. Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to  6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential)
3.1 It will be mandatory for the beneficiary to be a farmer belonging to the Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist category.
3.2 The farmer must have a caste certificate issued by the competent authority.
3.3 Farmers residing the Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika is necessary to have 7/12 certificate and 8A extract of land tenure in the name of the farmer. ( Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika area (Reference Government Letter No. Sankirna- 2017/Pr.No.142/3A, dated 24 April 2018))
3.4 The beneficiaries must have their own Aadhaar link active bank account .
3.5 The beneficiaries below the poverty line will be given  first priority.
3.6 The beneficiary farmer must have a minimum of 0.40 hectares and a maximum of 6 hectares of agricultural land. If the beneficiary's land is in a remote and fragmented area and two or more beneficiaries with less than 0.40 hectares of land come together and their combined land is at least 0.40 hectares, then if they sign an agreement, they will be eligible for the benefit of the scheme. Similarly, the condition of maximum 6.0 hectares of land will not be applicable to the beneficiaries below the poverty line.
3.7 Once the full benefit of the relevant scheme is taken, the benefit of this scheme will not be payable to the same beneficiary or family for the next five years. The beneficiary who has taken the benefit of the new well component will be eligible for the benefit of the old well repair component after 20 years.
If the benefit has been given under the Special Component Scheme for similar agricultural development schemes and the scheme implemented from the funds made available under the SCA of the Central Government and Article 275 (A) of the Constitution, the benefit provided under this scheme will not be admissible.

*Required Documents*:
1. Caste Certificate of SC category issued by compitant authority
2. current 7/12 report having Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to 6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential) within the period of
3 months 3.GSDA Certificates
4. There is no income limit for this scheme

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on Mahadbt portal as follows
1. Applications from farmers are being invited for the said scheme on the Maha-DBT portal website mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/farmer/login /login and the applications received within the limit of lakhs received by the concerned talukas / blocks will be selected online on a first come, first served basis (fcfs). After selection, all the proceedings up to the payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done online. In this regard, proceedings from acceptance of application to payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done as mentioned in the referenced government decision dated 04/11/2020.
2. The Agricultural Officer (Agriculture), P.S., should conduct a site inspection of the area of the beneficiary selected for the new well and old well repair on a first come, first served basis and check the technical feasibility. After the inspection, if the location of the beneficiary's new well and the proposal for repair of the old well of the beneficiary is technically suitable, the Agricultural Development Officer should approve the budget for this matter and give prior approval to the proposals of the concerned beneficiary within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents. Similarly, the selection of the beneficiaries whose proposals are found to be technically unsuitable during the site inspection should be cancelled.
3. Beneficiaries selected for other matters other than new well and old well repair under the scheme should be given prior approval within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents and they should be given the benefit of the scheme in the current financial year 2025-26 itself.
4. The prior approval of the beneficiaries who do not implement the matters under the scheme within the prescribed period should be cancelled.
5. While selecting individual beneficiary, priority will be given to women and disabled beneficiaries. Out of the total sanctioned funds, 5 percent of the funds should be given priority to be spent on disabled beneficiaries and 30 percent of the funds should be spent on women beneficiaries.
6. As per the demand of the final selected beneficiaries as per the target of the taluka & district, a draft plan of the district should be prepared within 7 days as per Appendix No. 1, component-wise and beneficiary-wise. The responsibility of preparing the draft plan will be the responsibility of the Agricultural Development Officer.

question: उसावरील तांबेरा रोग कसा ओळखावा आणि त्यावर उपचार काय?
answer:
ऊसावरील तांबेरा म्हणजे गंज रोग (बुरशीजन्य) आहे; याची पहिली लक्षणं पानांच्या खालच्या बाजूला जमिनीजवळ तपकिरी-तांबूस रंगाचे फोड दिसणे आणि नंतर त्यातून तपकिरी धूळसारखी बुरशीचे बीजाणू निघून हवेने पसरणे ही आहेत.

**ओळख (लक्षणे):**
- सुरुवातीला खालच्या पानांच्या खालच्या बाजूवर तपकिरी-तांबूस फोड दिसतात
- पुढे फोडांतून तपकिरी धूळ/बीजाणू बाहेर पडतात व आर्द्रता जास्त असल्यास वरच्या तरुण पानांवरही रोग दिसू शकतो
- साधारण १० ते १२ दिवसांत पाने पिवळी पडून पानगळ होऊ शकते, आणि उत्पादन घटते

**उपचार:**
- **पर्याय १ (फवारणी):** मॅन्कोझेब ०.३०% किंवा टेब्युकोनॅझोल ०.१% किंवा अॅझॉक्सीस्ट्रोबिन १८.२% + डिफेनोकॉनॅझोल ११.४% एस.सी. ०.१% — प्रति १० ली. पाणी: मॅन्कोझेब ३० ग्रॅम किंवा टेब्युकोनॅझोल १० मि.ली. किंवा संयुक्त बुरशीनाशक १० मि.ली.
- **पर्याय २ (विशेष शिफारस):** रोग दिसताच अॅझॉक्सीस्ट्रोबिन १८.२% + डिफेनोकॉनॅझोल ११.४% एस.सी. ०.१% (१ मि.ली./ली. पाणी) — एकूण तीन फवारण्या, प्रत्येकी १५ दिवसांच्या अंतराने

**स्रोत: एम.पी.के.व्ही. कृषी दर्शनी; एम.पी.के.व्ही. संशोधन शिफारसी २०२३ (राहुरी)**

तुमच्या ऊसात सध्या कोणत्या टप्प्यावर (लागवड, वाढ, शेकड) आहे आणि पानगळ किती झाली आहे??

question: कापूस पिकासाठी RWBCIS विमा कव्हरेज किती आहे
answer:

समानंतर बांध म्हणजेच समपातळी बांध हा पावसाचे वाहू पाणी थांबवून मातीमध्ये झिरपवतो, त्यामुळे धूप कमी होते आणि मृदा संरक्षण होते.  

**कधी करायचे:**  
- शेताचा उतार १% पेक्षा जास्त असेल तर पेरणी व मशागत नेहमी उताराच्या आडवी (समपातळीने) करा.  
- जेथे वर्षाभरात पाऊस ६०० मिमीपर्यंत असतो आणि माती हलकी ते मध्यम आहे तसेच उतार १ ते ६% आहे तिथे समपातळी बांधांचा उपयोग जास्त होतो.  

**बांध काढण्याची पद्धत:**  
- उतारावर दोन बांधांमधले पाणी थांबवून वरच्या बाजूला झिरपावे अशी व्यवस्था ठेवा.  
- २ ते ३% उतारासाठी दोन बांधांमधील अंतर साधारण ६० ते ७० मीटर ठेवा.  
- जर पावसाचे प्रमाण ६०० मिमीपेक्षा जास्त असेल आणि माती मध्यम ते भारी असेल तर दिशेने थोडा उतार दिलेले डिव्हर्जन बांध (उतार साधारण ०.२ ते ०.६%) घ्या; यामुळे वेगाने येणारे पाणी नियंत्रणात येते आणि धूप कमी होते.  

**जास्त उतार/जास्त पाऊस:**  
- उतार ५ ते १०% आणि पाणी झिरपण्याची क्षमता कमी असेल तर ३० सेंमी उंचीचे, ०.६% ग्रेडेड बांध ३ मीटर अंतरावर घेणे उपयुक्त ठरते; अतिरिक्त पाणी हळूहळू बाहेर निघते.

Matching Terms for `समानंतर बांध`

> Search Results for `Soil conservation contour bund construction method`

**Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth**
```
1. **Contour Cropping:** Planting crops always across the slope (preferably at the same level) helps the rainwater to percolate evenly over the entire area. Tillage [जमिनीची मशागत] across the slope prevents rainwater from flowing out of the field [शेत] quickly, and the ridges created by tillage [जमिनीची मशागत] slow down its speed and allow it to seep into the field [शेत]. This type of crop [पीक] pattern is called contour cropping. This method must be implemented when the slope of the farmland is more than one percent. Placing guide contour bunds (of khus or other grass) at regular intervals provides direction for sowing [पेरणी] and other tillage [जमिनीची मशागत] operations, and allows more rainwater to seep into the soil [माती].
2. **Soil [माती] Conserving Tillage [जमिनीची मशागत]:** Proper interculture of the crop [पीक] during the growing season keeps the soil [माती] loose and increases the process of rainwater percolation [पाझरण]. If a furrow [सरी] is created between two crop [पीक] rows by tying a rope [दोरी] to the drag of a cultivator [कल्टिव्हेटर (नांगरणीचे अवजार)] during such interculture, it helps to store excess water and seep it into the field [शेत] itself, and the crop [पीक] benefits from it. At the same time, deep plowing [खोल नांगरणी] should be done every 3 to 4 years so that a hard crust is not formed below the surface.
3. **Bund Construction:** In low rainfall areas (up to 600 mm) in light [प्रकाश] and medium soils up to 1 to 6 percent slope, water flowing between two bunds is prevented and seeped into the upper side of the contour bund [समपातळी बांध]. When the annual rainfall is more than 600 mm and the soil [माती] is medium to heavy, diversion bunds should be constructed instead of contour bunds, giving some specific slope (up to 0.2 to 0.6 percent). These bunds control the fast-flowing rainwater and slowly release it out of the field [शेत]. तुमच्या महाडीबीटी खात्यात सध्या कोणताही योजना अर्ज दिसत नाही, त्यामुळे कोणती कागदपत्रे राहिली आहेत आणि ती कधीपर्यंत द्यावी लागतील याची माहिती मला सांगता येत नाही?

तुम्ही कोणत्या योजनेसाठी अर्ज केला आहे ते नाव सांगाल का (उदा. ठिबक सिंचन, शेततळे, पिक विमा इ.), म्हणजे मी त्या योजनेसाठी आवश्यक कागदपत्रांची यादी काढून देऊ?

question: लहान शेतकऱ्यांसाठी कोणत्या योजनांमध्ये अनुदान जास्त मिळते?
answer:
लहान शेतकऱ्यांसाठी एकूण अनुदानाची रक्कम जास्त कधी मिळते हे तुम्ही कोणत्या प्रकारचा खर्च करणार आहात (सिंचन, यंत्रे, फलोत्पादन) यावर ठरते; त्यामुळे “जास्त अनुदान” ही योजना वागळून पाहणे सोपे नाही.

**डॉ. बाबासाहेब आंबेडकर कृषी स्वावलंबन योजना (बाक्षी):**
- **लाभ:** नवीन सिंचनविहिरीसाठी कमाल **₹४,००,०००**; जुनी विहीर दुरुस्तीसाठी कमाल **₹१,००,०००**; शेततळे प्लास्टिक लाइनिंगसाठी किमान **₹१४४३३** ते कमाल **₹२,००,०००** (योजना नियमांनुसार); पंपसेट/अन्नपूर्विका इ. घटक साठीही कमाल मर्यादा दिलेली आहे.
- **पात्रता:**
  - अनुसूचित जाती/नवबौद्ध शेतकरी (जात प्रमाणपत्र आवश्यक)
  - जमीनधारणा ०.२० ते ६.०० हेक्टर (काही घटकांसाठी किमान ०.४० हेक्टर)
  - ७/१२ व ८-अ उतारा, आधार संलग्न बँक खाते
  - अशिक्षित/अध：युक्त: महिला व दिव्यांग लाभार्थ्यांना प्राधान्य
- **टीप:** तुमच्या प्रोफाइलनुसार तुम्ही सामान्य वर्गात येता, म्हणून ही योजना तुमच्यासाठी लागू होत नाही.

**राज्य पुरस्कृत कृषी यांत्रिकीकरण (शेतयंत्रे व अवजारे):**
- **लाभ:** लघु शेतकऱ्यांसह ठराविक गटांना खर्चाच्या ४०% पर्यंत अनुदान (किंवा सरकारने जाहीर केलेली कमाल मर्यादा, जो कमी असेल तो).
- **पात्रता:** वैयक्तिक शेतकरी (कोटेशन व चाचणी अहवाल लागू शकतो).

**मुख्यमंत्री शाश्वत कृषी सिंचन योजना – वैयक्तिक शेततळे:**
- **लाभ:** शेततळ्याचा आकारानुसार किमान **₹१४४३३** ते कमाल **₹७५०००**.
- **पात्रता:**
  - कोकण भागात किमान ०.२० हेक्टर; उर्वरित महाराष्ट्रात किमान ०.४० हेक्टर
  - ७/१२ किंवा ८-अ, आधार प्रमाणपत्र, आधार संलग्न बँक खाते

**प्रधानमंत्री किसान सन्मान निधी योजना (पीएम-किसान):**
- **लाभ:** प्रति कुटुंब वर्षाला **₹६०००** (३ समान हप्त्यांत), काढणी निकषांखाली.
- **पात्रता:** लागवडीयोग्य जमीनधारक शेतकरी कुटुंब (७/१२, आधार संलग्न, ई-केवायसी).

**नमो शेतकरी महासन्मान निधी:**
- **लाभ:** पीएम-किसानला पात्र असलेल्यांना पीएम-किसानशिवाय वेगळी मदत म्हणून वर्षाला **₹६०००** (३ समान हप्त्यांत).
- **पात्रता:** पीएम-किसानमध्ये पात्र लाभार्थी असणे.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**?

तुम्हाला अनुदान नेमके कोणत्या कामासाठी हवे आहे—विहीर/शेततळे, ठिबक/तुषार, की यंत्रासाठी?

*Main Component*:
Providing Irrigation Fscilities to the eligible beneficiaries of Scheduled Cast (SC) category

*Sub Component*:
1. New Irrigation Well

*Introduction*:
The Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan (Special Component Scheme(scp)) was being implemented from the year 1982-83 to increase the income of Scheduled Caste / New-Buddhist farmers and improve their standard of living. Since the said scheme has been implemented for a long period of time, the GOVERNMENT OF MAHARASHTRA has decided to implement the Special Component Scheme for Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist farmers since 1982-83 and the recommendations of the Agriculture Commissionerate dated 27/04/2016 on the report dated 19/04/2016 and special component scheme the announced by the Hon'ble Minister (Finance). Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana is not being implemented separately, but the current special component scheme, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana, is being implemented from 2016-17 as per the changed criteria, taking into account the needs of the changed situation and maintaining soil moisture.
Also, the government has approved the amendment in the financial criteria and inclusion of new components under the said scheme as per the government decision dated 01 October, 2024.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    beneficiary Selection criteria are as follows
1.  Scheme is only for Scheduled Caste/ Nav Baudha farmers.
2.  Scheme is implemented in all districts of Maharashtra (Except Mumbai districts).
3. At field level  scheme is under Implementation by department of Agriculture, Zilha Parishad.
4. Funds are released from Social Justice Department to concerned  District Collector and then made available to concern Zilha Parishad.
5. Application ,Selection of beneficiaries upto payment of subsidy all process are done through MAHADBT Portal through online system.                                                                  "

*Benefits*:
Benefit provided on subsidy basis as per the norms of components, through online system. The said scheme shall be implemented in the financial year 2025-26 as follows. In the said scheme, grants shall be admissible for the following components in the year 2025-26 up to the maximum limit of the amount mentioned below.
1. For New Irrigation- Well Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Rs.4,00,000/ - is admissible.
2. For Old Well Repair - Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 1,00,000/- is admissible
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds-Grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the amount calculated as per the prevailing financial parameters of the National Horticulture Mission Guideline and the size of the farm pond or actual cost or Rs. 2,00,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
4.Inwell Boring- Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 40,000/- is admissible
5. Electricity Connection-Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Amount 20,000/- or actual paid amount whichever is less is admissible.
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)(Diesel Engine - New Item) For pump sets up to 10 HP capacity, grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial parameters or actual cost or Rs. 40,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
7. Grant Solar pump (instead of electrical connection and pump set)- Maximum subsidy will be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial criteria or actual expenditure incurred or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)- Under the Food and Nutrition Security Scheme - Food Crops Scheme, subsidy of 100% of the prevailing economic standard or actual cost incurred per meter or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less will be admissible.
9.1 For Micro irrigation system Under Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) 9.1.1) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and9.1.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 47,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy. (Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
9.2 For Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant 9.2.1 ) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and 9.2.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 97,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy.(Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements) (New item)maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden (New Item) maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible .

*Eligibility*:
1. Scheme is only for Scheduled Tribe farmers. Caste  certificate is essential.
2. Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to  6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential)
3.1 It will be mandatory for the beneficiary to be a farmer belonging to the Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist category.
3.2 The farmer must have a caste certificate issued by the competent authority.
3.3 Farmers residing the Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika is necessary to have 7/12 certificate and 8A extract of land tenure in the name of the farmer. ( Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika area (Reference Government Letter No. Sankirna- 2017/Pr.No.142/3A, dated 24 April 2018))
3.4 The beneficiaries must have their own Aadhaar link active bank account .
3.5 The beneficiaries below the poverty line will be given  first priority.
3.6 The beneficiary farmer must have a minimum of 0.40 hectares and a maximum of 6 hectares of agricultural land. If the beneficiary's land is in a remote and fragmented area and two or more beneficiaries with less than 0.40 hectares of land come together and their combined land is at least 0.40 hectares, then if they sign an agreement, they will be eligible for the benefit of the scheme. Similarly, the condition of maximum 6.0 hectares of land will not be applicable to the beneficiaries below the poverty line.
3.7 Once the full benefit of the relevant scheme is taken, the benefit of this scheme will not be payable to the same beneficiary or family for the next five years. The beneficiary who has taken the benefit of the new well component will be eligible for the benefit of the old well repair component after 20 years.
If the benefit has been given under the Special Component Scheme for similar agricultural development schemes and the scheme implemented from the funds made available under the SCA of the Central Government and Article 275 (A) of the Constitution, the benefit provided under this scheme will not be admissible.

*Required Documents*:
1. Caste Certificate of SC category issued by compitant authority
2. current 7/12 report having Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to 6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential) within the period of
3 months 3.GSDA Certificates
4. There is no income limit for this scheme

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on Mahadbt portal as follows
1. Applications from farmers are being invited for the said scheme on the Maha-DBT portal website mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/farmer/login /login and the applications received within the limit of lakhs received by the concerned talukas / blocks will be selected online on a first come, first served basis (fcfs). After selection, all the proceedings up to the payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done online. In this regard, proceedings from acceptance of application to payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done as mentioned in the referenced government decision dated 04/11/2020.
2. The Agricultural Officer (Agriculture), P.S., should conduct a site inspection of the area of the beneficiary selected for the new well and old well repair on a first come, first served basis and check the technical feasibility. After the inspection, if the location of the beneficiary's new well and the proposal for repair of the old well of the beneficiary is technically suitable, the Agricultural Development Officer should approve the budget for this matter and give prior approval to the proposals of the concerned beneficiary within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents. Similarly, the selection of the beneficiaries whose proposals are found to be technically unsuitable during the site inspection should be cancelled.
3. Beneficiaries selected for other matters other than new well and old well repair under the scheme should be given prior approval within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents and they should be given the benefit of the scheme in the current financial year 2025-26 itself.
4. The prior approval of the beneficiaries who do not implement the matters under the scheme within the prescribed period should be cancelled.
5. While selecting individual beneficiary, priority will be given to women and disabled beneficiaries. Out of the total sanctioned funds, 5 percent of the funds should be given priority to be spent on disabled beneficiaries and 30 percent of the funds should be spent on women beneficiaries.
6. As per the demand of the final selected beneficiaries as per the target of the taluka & district, a draft plan of the district should be prepared within 7 days as per Appendix No. 1, component-wise and beneficiary-wise. The responsibility of preparing the draft plan will be the responsibility of the Agricultural Development Officer.

question: भातावरील खोडकिडा कसा नियंत्रित करावा?
answer:
भातावरील खोडकिडा (खोड किडा) नियंत्रणासाठी आधी पीक तपासणी करून प्रकोप ५% पेक्षा जास्त दिसत असेल तरच फवारणी/उपाय करा, आणि शक्य असल्यास परजीवी कीटक सोडणे व वेळीची काढणी-शेतातील व्यवस्थापन हे एकत्रितपणे करा.

**वाण निवड:**  
- सकोली-८, सिंडेवाही-५ अशा खोडकिडांना प्रतिकारक वाण घ्या.

**रोपवाटिका व लागवडीआधी उपाय:**  
- रोपे लावण्यापूर्वी त्यांच्या मुळांचा क्लोरपायरीफॉस २०% ई.सी. १० मि.ली. प्रति १० ली. पाणी या मिश्रणात १२ तास बुडवून ठेवा आणि मग पुनर्लागवड करा.

**जैविक नियंत्रण:**  
- ट्रायकोग्रामा जपॉनिकम ५०,००० प्रति हेक्टर दराने सात दिवसांच्या अंतराने ३ ते ४ वेळा सोडा; सोडण्याच्या ३ ते ४ दिवस आधी आणि नंतर रासायनिक फवारणी करू नका.
- दुसऱ्या पद्धतीनुसार ट्रायकोग्रामा अंडी १,६०,००० (८ कार्ड) प्रति हेक्टर दराने पुनर्लागवडीनंतर साधारण तीस दिवसांनी सुरू करून आठवड्याच्या अंतराने सहा वेळा सोडण्याची शिफारस आहे.

**रासायनिक नियंत्रण (प्रकोप दिसताच):**  
- शेतात ५% झाडांवर प्रादुर्भाव दिसताच पुढीलपैकी कोणतेही एक औषध फवारणी/ओळीमध्ये देणे:
  - अझॅडिरॅक्टिन ०.१५% ३०–५० मि.ली. प्रति १० ली. पाणी, किंवा
  - क्विनाल्फॉस ३२ मि.ली. प्रति १० ली. पाणी, किंवा
  - कार्बोसल्फान २५% १६ मि.ली. प्रति १० ली. पाणी  
- ओळीमध्ये दाणेदार औषध देण्यासाठी: कार्बोफ्युरान ३% दाणेदार २५ किग्रा प्रति हेक्टर, किंवा फिप्रोनिल ०.३% दाणेदार १६.६७ किग्रा प्रति हेक्टर.

**काढणी व शेतातील व्यवस्थापन:**  
- भात जमिनीच्या जवळपास कापा आणि काढणीनंतर माती तयार झाली की नांगरट करून खुंट गोळा करून नष्ट करा.

**स्रोत: डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ — बासमती तांदूळ पिकातील कीड व्यवस्थापन**  

तुमचा भात सध्या कोणत्या अवस्थेत आहे (पुनर्लागवड झाली का, किती दिवस), आणि प्रत्यक्ष शेतात धूपलेली/आत रिकामी होणारी खोडं किती टक्के दिसत आहेत??

### **Management [व्यवस्थापन] of Pests on Rice [बासमती तांदूळ]**

**1\. Stem Borer [खोड किउा]:** 1) Plant rice [बासमती तांदूळ] varieties resistant to stem borer [खोड किउा], e.g., Sakoli - 8, Sindewahi -5. 2) Before transplanting [पुनर्लागवड], soak the roots of the seedlings in a mixture of Chloropyriphos 20% EC at 10 ml per 10 liters of water for 12 hours and then transplant. 3) Release the parasitoid [परजीवी] insect [कीटक] Trichogramma [ट्रायकोग्रामा] japonicum at the rate of 50,000 per hectare 3 to 4 times at intervals of 7 days. Do not spray chemical insecticides [कीटकनाशके] 3 to 4 days before and after release. 4) As soon as 5% pest [कीड] infested tillers are seen in the field [शेत], spray Azadirachtin 0.15% @ 30-50 ml or Quinolphos @ 32 ml or Carbosulfan 25% @ 16 ml mixed in 10 liters of water or Carbofuran [कार्बोफ्युरान] 3% granular 25 kg/ha or Fipronil 0.3% granular 16.67 kg/ha should be applied in the ridges. 5) Harvest [कापणी] the rice [बासमती तांदूळ] close to the ground. 6) After rice [बासमती तांदूळ] harvesting [कापणी], plough [नांगर] when the field [शेत] comes to condition and collect and destroy the stubble [खुंट].

Integrated Disease [रोग]/Pest Management [कीड व्यवस्थापन]

Considering the overuse of chemical drugs, their huge cost, the necessary equipment, labourers, and the pollution problem caused by the use of drugs, integrated disease [रोग]/pest management [कीड व्यवस्थापन] has become a need of the hour. Integrated disease [रोग]/pest management [कीड व्यवस्थापन] is the use of cultivation methods, improved machinery and technology, biological, physical [शारीरिक तपासणी], chemical measures, etc. in a combined and systematic manner to maintain the balance of the environment and bring the number of diseases/pests below the level of economic damage. This is called 'Integrated Disease [रोग]/Pest Management [कीड व्यवस्थापन]'.

Principles of Integrated Pest Management [एकात्मिक कीड व्यवस्थापन] -

- 1. Estimating the intensity of diseases and pests and determining the level of damage or injury (incidence and intensity limits). For example, in rice [बासमती तांदूळ] crops, chemical control [रासायनिक नियंत्रण] is beneficial if 5% of the stems are infested with stem borer [खोड किउा] or one egg mass or moth is found per sq. Meter area.
- 2. Prepare a plan to reduce the number of pests or the extent of disease [रोग] severity or to use basic principles for integrated control [एकात्मिक नियंत्रण उपाय].
- 3. In case of emergency, control measures should be such that the balance of nature is disturbed to a minimum extent, implement such control measures.

The most important thing in all this is to determine the level of economic damage as shown above. The use of drugs only when necessary is an aspect of integrated disease [रोग]/pest management [कीड व्यवस्थापन].

To know the level of damage, it is necessary to find out which disease [रोग]/pest [कीड] is present in the field [शेत] and to what extent. For this, it is necessary to survey the field [शेत]. If necessary, seek guidance from experts.

question: माझ्या जवळच्या कोणत्या गोदामाचे साठवणूक शुल्क (Tariff) सर्वात कमी आहे?

question: ज्वारीमधील कानी रोग कसा ओळखावा?
answer:
ज्वारीच्या कणसात दाण्याऐवजी काळी भुकटी दिसली तर तो स्मट (काजळी/स्मट) रोग असण्याची शक्यता जास्त आहे; हा बुरशीजन्य रोग आहे?

**लक्षणे:**
- ज्वारीच्या कणसामध्ये धान्ये तयार होण्याऐवजी काळी भुकटी निर्माण होते आणि उत्पन्नात घट येते
- ज्वारीमध्ये स्मटचे चार प्रकार दिलेले आहेत: ग्रेन स्मट, लूज स्मट, कवर्ड स्मट, आणि लाँग स्मट
- हा रोग संक्रमित बियाणे किंवा मातीमधून पसरतो

The quality of grape fruits deteriorates. In roses, this powdery mildew [भुरी रोग] affects the flowers, deteriorating their quality. - **Ergot (Sclerotia [स्क्लेरोशिया]):** This disease [रोग] mainly affects pearl millet [बाजरी] (bajra [बाजरी]). Instead of grains [धान्ये] filling in the ear, a blackish fungal growth [वाढ] occurs. These are called Sclerotia [स्क्लेरोशिया].

- **Anthracnose [बुरशीजन्य रोग]:** Spots appear on the leaves and bolls of cotton [कापूस]. These are round in shape. The cotton [कापूस] inside the boll turns yellowish. Its quality deteriorates, and such cotton [कापूस] fetches a lower price.
- **Smut:** In the ears of sorghum [ज्वारी], wheat [गहू], etc., instead of grains [धान्ये] forming, a black powder is produced. This reduces the yield [उत्पादन]. There are four types of sorghum [ज्वारी] smut: Grain [धान्य] Smut, Loose Smut, Covered Smut, and Long Smut. This fungus spreads through infected seeds or from the soil [माती].
- **Rust [गंज रोग]:** Wheat [गहू], pearl millet [बाजरी], sorghum [ज्वारी], fig [अंजीर], soybean [सोयाबीन], etc., crops are affected by 'Rust [गंज रोग]'. The leaves turn reddish-brown. A balanced soil [माती] ecosystem, therefore, emerges from the synergy of organic carbon [सेंद्रिय कार्बन] enrichment, microbial vitality, and pH correction, all achieved without synthetic inputs. Indian Natural Farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] experiments have reported measurable improvements in soil health [मृदा आरोग्य] parameters. ICARNAARM field [शेत] studies under Zero Budget Natural Farming [शून्य खर्च नैसर्गिक शेती] in Andhra Pradesh recorded an increase of 821% in soil organic carbon [मातीतील सेंद्रिय कार्बन], 1327% higher microbial biomass [वनस्पती झाडे पीके व शैवाल यापासुन निर्माण होणारा सेंद्रीय पदार्थ] carbon, and significantly higher soil [माती] enzymatic activity compared to conventional farming [पारंपरिक शेती] systems. question: सेंद्रिय शेतीसाठी कोणती योजना उपलब्ध आहे?
answer:
सेंद्रिय शेतीसाठी तुमच्या भागात नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प (पोक्रा) अंतर्गत सेंद्रिय उत्पादन युनिट ही योजना उपलब्ध आहे.

**नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प (पोक्रा) — सेंद्रिय उत्पादन युनिट** या योजनेत खालील घटक येतात:
- वर्मी कंपोस्ट उत्पादन युनिट
- नाडेप कंपोस्ट उत्पादन युनिट

**पात्रता:**
- या घटकासाठी दुसऱ्या कोणत्याही योजनेतून आधी लाभ घेतलेला असेल तर पुन्हा लाभ मिळणार नाही
- युनिट उभारल्यावर त्याची योग्य चालना सुनिश्चित करण्यासाठी किमान दोन मोठी जनावरे (गाय/बуйल/मेंढी) उपलब्ध असणे आवश्यक
- एकूण जमीनधारणा पाच हेक्टरपर्यंत असणे आवश्यक
- ही योजना फक्त पोक्रा-नियुक्त गावांतील शेतकऱ्यांसाठी लागू आहे

**अर्ज कसा करावा:**
योजना पोक्रा डीबीटी सिस्टमद्वारे चालते; शेतकरी लॉग-इन करून अर्ज करता येतो आणि अनुदान रक्कम आधार- जोडलेल्या बँक खात्यात थेट जमा होते.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

तुमचे गाव पोक्रा-नियुक्त आहे का, आणि वर्मी कंपोस्ट की नाडेप कंपोस्ट युनिट करायचे आहे? ?

*Id*:

*Scheme Code*:
ndksp-organic-production-unit

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp

*Scheme Name*:
Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp

*Main Component*:
Organic Production Unit

*Sub Component*:
1. Vermicompost Production Unit 
2. NADEP Compost Production Unit

*Introduction*:
Under the organic farming system, conserving nature, reducing crop production costs, and increasing the use of alternative organic and biological inputs for hazardous chemicals like chemical fertilizers, pesticides, herbicides, and hormones is the need of the hour. Vermicompost is made from farm waste, plant-based materials, and cow dung by earthworms. Vermicompost contains various bacteria, enzymes, vitamins, and other useful chemicals, which have a positive effect on plant growth. 
Similarly, processing farm waste through composting results in the decomposition of its organic matter through biological methods by microorganisms and earthworms, producing excellent humus-like organic compost. If this compost is used extensively in the fields, it will significantly improve soil health and greatly boost agricultural production. It is the need of the hour to prepare organic manure from all plant-based materials generated in the field and return it to the field. Organic manure improves soil texture and water retention capacity, ensuring an adequate supply of nutrients. The soil remains friable, which keeps it aerated. It helps in the growth of beneficial microorganisms in the farm. 
In this regard, considering the above matter, it is proposed to implement the Vermicompost Production Unit and NADEP Compost Production Unit as individual benefit components.

*Benefits*:
1.To enable small and marginal farmers in the village clusters included in the Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp to adapt to the situation arising from climate change.
2. To produce nutritious food grains.
3. To practice agriculture by making proper use of natural elements without harming them.
4. To increase soil fertility and maintain it for a long time.
5. To reuse local resources in agriculture.
6. To reduce the cost of agricultural production and increase the net income of the farmer.

*Eligibility*:
1. Farmers who have received benefits from any other scheme for this component will not receive benefits again under this scheme.
2. After the unit is established, the benefit will be given to farmers who have at least two large livestock (cows, buffaloes, or bullocks) available to ensure its proper functioning.
3. The benefits of this component under the project will be available to beneficiaries who own up to 5.00 hectares of land.

*Required Documents*:
1. If the applicant is a person with disability, a disability certificate should be provided.
2. If the applicant belongs to the Scheduled Castes or Scheduled Tribes category, evidence related to that.
3. If the applicant is a joint account holder, a consent letter from the other account holders shall be submitted.

*Application Process*:
The NDKSP DBT Portal has been created with the following objectives - 
DBT System for accepting and processing subsidy applications received from farmers. Through this system, farmers can directly login and apply for financial assistance under scheme and disbursement of funds happen directly to the Aadhaar linked account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode. There is no need for farmer to visit a government office to apply for subsidy or receive disbursed funds. Also, farmers can track and monitor their applications in real time which shows transparency in NDKSP operations. This system facilitates NDKSP to perform its approval process in 100% paperless manner which eliminates intermediaries and establishes credibility. 
To avail the benefits of the components under the project, the beneficiary (farmer) must directly login on the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system using their Farmer ID. After login, the beneficiary becomes eligible to receive the project benefits. Additionally, it is mandatory for the beneficiary to link their Aadhaar number with their bank account so that the benefit amount can be directly transferred to their personal bank account.
The following farmer attributes need to be entered in the Portal: 
Farmer Attributes: (Essential): 
State, District, Sub-District/Block, Village, Farmer Name, Type of Identity  Farmer ID for landholder farmer is essential, Gender, Category, land cosent letter for joint landholders. 
Farmer Login and application Module:
Step 1: Farmer Login and Application Process through the "Mahavistaar-AI Application"
a) First, download and install the "Mahavistaar-AI Application" from the "Google Play Store" on your mobile.
b) After entering the application, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, click the "DBT" tab at the bottom right of the Dashboard screen.
d) Upon clicking, click the "NDKSP (PoCRA)" tab.
e) To avail benefits for various items under individual components, click the "Click Here" link at the end of this screen to apply.
f) Following this, your NDKSP (PoCRA) project dashboard screen will be available.
g) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.
Step 2: Farmer Login and application Process through the "Project's DBT Web Portal"
a) Visit to "https://mahapocra.gov.in/mr/applications" NDKSP 2.0 website
b) After entering the webpage of Farmer login, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, dashboard screen will be available.
d) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.

2. Winter Management [हिवाळा काळातील व्यवस्थापन] for Chickens

To get good production [उत्पादन] from chickens, it is necessary to maintain the shed [निवारा] temperature [तापमान] at 21 to 23 Celsius. However, in some areas during winter, the temperature [तापमान] drops much lower than 21 Celsius. In such situations, birds require extra energy to maintain their body temperature [शरीराचा तापमान]. If the temperature [तापमान] drops too low in winter, birds can die due to 'cold shock'. Therefore, proper care of birds in winter is extremely important.

Implement the following measures due to the cold weather [वातावरण] in winter.

- 1. Put curtains on both sides of the shed [निवारा]'s netting. Close these curtains at night and during cold early mornings. Keep the curtains open during the day.
- 2. Increase the shed [निवारा] temperature [तापमान] with the help of electric bulbs, heaters, or brooders.
- 3. Increase the proportion of energy and protein [प्रथिने] in the winter feed so that the increased energy requirement in cold weather [वातावरण] is met and birds grow well.
- 4. During periods of cold stress [थंडीचा ताण], have immediate provisions like a generator and battery backup to increase the shed [निवारा] temperature [तापमान].

**Sudden Wilt Disease [मररोग]**

Symptoms [लक्षणे]: If the daytime temperature [तापमान] remains above 380 C for a long time as well as water stress [पाण्याचा ताण] occurs and if water accumulates in the field [शेत] during the rainy season, it has an adverse effect on the physiology of cotton [कापूस]. Due to water stress [पाण्याचा ताण], water vessels that absorb nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] become swollen and the pipes close. Leaves, flowers and bolls of the plant do not get nutrient [पोषक घटक] supply, the radiance of the leaves disappears and the leaves turn yellow. The leaves, flowers and bolls are shed [निवारा] and the plant dies.  
Remedy: 1) Plant summer irrigated Bt cotton [बीटी कापूस] from the second fortnight of May to the first week of June and water it at an interval of 8 to 15 days.  
2) Take care that water will not accumulate in the crop [पीक] and drain the accumulated water immediately. 3) As soon as the symptoms [लक्षणे] appear on the deformed plants, apply 1.5 kg Urea [यूरिया] + 1.5 kg Muriate of Potash 150 to 200 ml in 100 liters of water. 4) After that, mix 2 kg DAP in 100 liters of water and pour this solution near the stump of the plant at 150 to 200 ml after 8-10 days and water immediately.

4. Managemental interventions:

Hence, provision has to be made for supply of continuous clean, fresh and cool water to the animals. Cleaning [साफसफाई] the feeding [खाऊ घालणे] trough frequently and providing fresh feed will encourage the animals to take more feed. Splashing the cool water over the animals at regular intervals during the hot period will reduce the heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण].
- 2. Feeding [खाऊ घालणे] time: Providing feed to the animals during cool period i.e. evening or night will improve the feed intake by the animals. Likewise, providing additional drinking

water supplies and shifting feeding [खाऊ घालणे] times, so that cows are not all feeding [खाऊ घालणे] during the hottest parts of the day, will cut heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण] risks.

- 3. Stocking density: Reducing the stocking density during hot weather [वातावरण] will help the animals in dissipating the body heat more efficiently through manifestation of behavioural adaptation.
- 4. Shade: The use of shades is an effective method in helping to cool animals.
- 5. Provision of vegetative cover over the surrounding area will reduce the radiative heat from the ground.
- 6. Provision of elongated eaves or overhang will provide shade as well as prevent rain water from entering the sheds during rainy season.
- 7. Ventilation [हवेची आदळ]: increasing the ventilation [हवेची आदळ] or air circulation in the animal sheds will aid the animals in effective dissipation the heat. **Dairy Farming A Profitable Venture**
```
Management [व्यवस्थापन] strategies to improve dairy [दुग्धव्यवसाय] production [उत्पादन] in the changing climate [हवामान]

Animal housing [निवास व्यवस्था] is one of the approaches to alleviate the impacts of climate change [हवामान बदल] on cattle [गाय वर्ग]. Shade reduces the severity of heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण] in animals that are being exposed to sun. It is an effective method to protect the animals from radiant heat load and helps to cool the animals. Shades can be made artificial or natural. Aluminum or galvanized steel roofs are artificial shades while the roofs made out of straw are of natural means. Provision of trees and other vegetative covers over the surrounding area will reduce the effect of radiative heat load on the cattle [गाय वर्ग]. Roofing materials should always be a bad conductor of heat and the best housing [निवास व्यवस्था] will have roofs painted in white so as to reflect the radiation of sun. Physical [शारीरिक तपासणी] protection with artificial or natural shade presently offers the most immediate and costeffective approach for enhancing reproductive efficiency [प्रजनन कार्यक्षमता] of animals. Evaporative cooling also can be effective. Various shade management [व्यवस्थापन] systems have been evaluated extensively and generally result in improved feed intake and productivity. The orientation of the shed [निवारा] should be in north-south direction in the northern hemisphere so that the direct incidence of solar radiation [सौर किरणोत्सर्ग] into the shed [निवारा] is avoided. For effective heat dissipation in cattle [गाय वर्ग], there should be free flow of air inside the shed [निवारा], this can be done by increasing the ventilation [हवेची आदळ] by means such as keeping half side wall i.e., open housing [निवास व्यवस्था] system, use of fan, increasing the height of the building etc. Shade alone will reduce a cow [गाय]'s respiration [श्वसन] rate by 30%, and adding sprinklers will reduce the respiration [श्वसन] rate by 67%. Both methods of cooling will also lower rectal temperatures. Use of shade plus fans and sprinklers has an additive effect. Use of fans is important, especially in confined structures, because fans help to move warm air from cows' bodies.

Rainy: Dry [कोरडे] bedding [गादी] for the kids is prepared. The dry [कोरडे] straw or animal mattresses can be used during rainy days. Before the onset of rainy season, the roof of animal shed [निवारा] should be made rain proof. There should be no leakage in the shed [निवारा] roof as it enhances moisture levels and affects comfort of animals. Water logging and floor dampness may lead to increase in ammonia levels which can cause eye infection [डोळ्याचा संसर्ग] and respiratory disorders. Wet floor may also lead to diarrhoea [अतिसार], fever [ताप], pneumonia, coccidiosis [कॉक्सिडिओसिस], hypothermia [हायपोथर्मिया] leading to death. Young kids are at higher risk of developing disease [रोग] due to wet floors. Farmer [शेतकरी] should ensure that feed is free from moulds during rainy days. Feeding [खाऊ घालणे] of mouldy feed causes digestive disorders. The kids should not be let loose outside during rainy season and should be provided with a heat source if the temperature [तापमान] drops down. Kids above 3 months of age should be given dewormer and should be vaccinated against infectious diseases before the rainy season.

Summer: One of the most popular technique to minimize heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण] is to change the environment to enhance the heat dissipation process. Shade, evaporative cooling with water in the form of mist, spraying [फवारणी] of natural or forced air, and potentially cooling pools etc all are included. Ventilation [हवेची आदळ] of the shed [निवारा] is a must in hot weather [वातावरण] to protect kids from heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण]. Cross ventilation [हवेची आदळ], which brings in fresh air and removes stale air and odour is preferred. An unhygienic shed [निवारा] with dirty bedding [गादी] invites skin rashes [त्वचेवर पुरळ], lung difficulties, foot problems, and other diseases. These problems are increased in summer, and therefore the kids are kept in clean shelter [आश्रयस्थान] as far as possible. In the summer heat, diarrhoea [अतिसार] may quickly lead to dehydration [निर्जलीकरण] and hence, kept a constant supply of cool, clean water [स्वच्छ पाणी] available for drinking. Persistent diarrhoea [अतिसार] in young kids can lead to death, if left untreated.

Because glucose use predominates during heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण], chromium supplementation may improve thermal tolerance [उष्णता सहनशीलता] or production [उत्पादन] in heat-stressed animals. ** Care and Management of Animals in AdverseEnvironmental conditions**
```
Animal Behavior and Stress Management [ताण व्यवस्थापन]: Animals may become frightened or agitated; handle calmly and quietly to reduce panic and injury. Avoid loud noises or sudden movements. Lightning Safety [वीज सुरक्षा] Specifics: Avoid allowing animals to congregate near tall isolated objects like trees or metal poles. Use grounded lightning rods on shelters and metal fencing. Consider installing lightning warning systems to provide advance alerts for taking protective actions. e. During extreme Hot, cold, Rainy season

Extreme Hot Weather [वातावरण] Management [व्यवस्थापन]:

Heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण] leads to increased respiration [श्वसन], reduced feed intake, lethargy, and production [उत्पादन] losses. Animals generate more body heat during digestion, worsening heat load. Shade & Shelter [आश्रयस्थान]: Provide ample shade using natural trees or constructed shelters. Shade can reduce solar radiation [सौर किरणोत्सर्ग] by up to 50%, significantly lowering heat exposure. Ventilation [हवेची आदळ] & Airflow: Ensure barns and holding areas have good ventilation [हवेची आदळ]. Use fans and automated cooling systems (misters, sprinklers) to enhance evaporative cooling. Automated systems that adjust according to temperature [तापमान] and humidity [आर्द्रता] optimize cooling and energy use. Water Supply: Provide unlimited access to cool, clean water [स्वच्छ पाणी]. Water intake increases during heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण]. Water troughs should be checked and maintained before hot seasons to ensure reliability. Bury water lines to keep water cool. Feeding [खाऊ घालणे] Management [व्यवस्थापन]: Feed animals during cooler parts of the day (early morning or late evening) to reduce heat from digestion. Provide high-quality, easily digestible feed [पचण्यास सुलभ खाद्य] to minimize metabolic heat. Reduce Handling & Stress: Avoid moving or handling animals during peak heat hours. If necessary, do so early morning or late evening. Monitoring: Watch for heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण] signs like panting, increased salivation, lethargy, and high respiration [श्वसन] rates (e.g., >60 breaths/min in cattle [गाय वर्ग]). Immediate cooling and veterinary intervention [पशुवैद्यकीय हस्तक्षेप] may be required. Cooling Techniques: Spray or hose animals with cool water, focusing on legs and feet. Allow access to water bodies for natural cooling if possible.

Other fungicides [बुरशीनाशके] and insecticides [कीटकनाशके] are not label-claimed.
- **Harvesting [कापणी] and Production [उत्पादन]:** Flowers are ready for harvesting [कापणी] six months after planting and 190 to 230 flowers per sq. mt. per year are obtained.

**Gerbera [जरबेरा]**
```


----

**Sustainable Poultry Production**
```
In addition, poultry [कुक्कुट] under heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण] conditions have reduced feed intake, water consumption, body moments, and consequently become depressed, dull [म्लान] and lethargic. From a practicable perspective, it is crucial to consistently and properly monitor water utilization, feed intake, sleep interval, movement, and other behavioural activities when conditions are favourable for the development of heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण] in commercial poultry [कुक्कुट] production [उत्पादन]. The prompt decrease in water intake, reduced feed consumption, behavioural changes [वर्तन बदल], and physiological appearance of the body are the best and key indicators of birds experiencing heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण]. Nutrition [पोषण] Strategy to Reduce heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण].

Despite advancements in management [व्यवस्थापन] technology, housing [निवास व्यवस्था], ventilation [हवेची आदळ], and cooling systems, the adverse impacts of heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण] on poultry [कुक्कुट] productivity, morbidity, and mortality remain a challenge in poultry [कुक्कुट] farms, particularly during severe hot weather [वातावरण] (Abo Ghanima et al., 2020). To further address this issue, alternative approaches, particularly nutritional manipulations, have gained attention. Complementing proper management [व्यवस्थापन] practices with specific dietary manipulations can help maintain good health [आरोग्य] and performance in poultry [कुक्कुट] flocks during periods of high ambient temperature [तापमान]. These dietary manipulations include such as Feed additives, natural antioxidants, minerals [खनिजे], electrolytes [इलेक्ट्रोलाइट्स], phyto-biotics, probiotics [प्रोबायोटिक्स], fat, and protein [प्रथिने] as feed additives can help mitigate the negative effects of heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण]. These additives can support the birds' antioxidant defence systems, electrolyte [विद्युतद्रव] balance, gut health [आरोग्य], and immune function, thereby improving their resilience to heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण].

Protein [प्रथिने] and amino acids [अमिनो आम्ल] supplementation

Reduced FI in chickens raised under heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण] condition cause a reduction in protein [प्रथिने] consumption Imbalance of dietary amino acids [अमिनो आम्ल] due to reduced FI alters amino acid transporters' gene expression in various tissues (Fagundes et al., 2020). Increasing protein [प्रथिने] level and amino acids [अमिनो आम्ल] concentrations in poultry [कुक्कुट] diets are recommended to compensate the reduction in FI during hot weather [वातावरण] conditions (Lagan et al., 2007).
```


----

**Animal Science and Technology Standard XII**
```
Management [व्यवस्थापन] during Summer Season [उन्हाळी हंगाम]

 Amongst the environmental factors, hot ambient temperature [तापमान] has significant impact on the productive and reproductive performance of livestock [पशुधन] species [प्रजाती]. Several factors are responsible for causing heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण] and major factors are high ambient temperature [तापमान] and high humidity [आर्द्रता].

 Heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण] is the point where the cow [गाय] cannot dissipate adequate quantity of heat to maintain bodys thermal balance.''

Symptoms [लक्षणे] of heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण]

- 1. Animal moves to shade
- 2. Water intake increased while feed intake reduced
- 3. Prefers standing than lying down
- 4. Increased respiration [श्वसन] rate, pulse [डाळ] rate and body temperature [शरीराचा तापमान]
- 5. Increased production [उत्पादन] of saliva [लाळ]
- 6. Open-mouth breathing [श्वासोच्छवास]/panting

Effects of heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण]

- 1. Decreases in milk yield [दुधाचे उत्पादन] between 10-30 % along with lactation length.
- 2. Reproductive efficiency [प्रजनन कार्यक्षमता] decreases
- 3. Dry [कोरडे] period increases
- 4. Age at first estrous also increases
- 5. Negative impact on immunity [रोगप्रतिकारशक्ती] and health [आरोग्य]

Strategies to reduce the negative effects of heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण] Fig [अंजीर]. 3.8 : Signs of heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण] in animal

Breeding [प्रजनन] management [व्यवस्थापन]

- 1. It is necessary to adopt a good heat detection [ऊष्मा तपासणी] technique.
- 2. It is always advisable to continue artificial insemination [कृत्रिम गर्भाधारणा] instead of using bulls because in natural breeding [प्रजनन] both bull and cows suffers infertility [वंध्यत्व] due to summer stress.
- 3. Genetic selection of heat tolerant animals and inclusion of heat tolerance [उष्णता सहनशीलता] as a trait in selection programme.

Cooling systems in the farm

- 1. Fans in combination with water sprinkling [पाण्याचा फवारणी] facility provide the best cooling option.
- 2. Excessive sprinkling [पाण्याचा फवारणी] should never be practised as it can result into wet bedding [गादी] making animal prone to mastitis [स्तनदाह] and other diseases.
- 3. The farm should be well ventilated.
- 4. Provision for wallowing for buffallos.
```

question: डाळिंब किंवा मका लागवडीसाठी शासकीय योजना उपलब्ध आहेत का?
answer:
हो, डाळिंब लागवडीसाठी आणि मका पिकासाठी शासकीय योजना उपलब्ध आहेत.

**डाळिंब (फलोत्पादन):**
> **भाऊसाहेब फुंडकर फलोत्पादन लागवड योजना** ही राज्य योजना आहे जी फळपिकांच्या लागवडीसाठी एकूण खर्चावर सहाय्य देते; निवड महाडीबीटी द्वारे लॉटरीने होते व अनुदान आठवीकडे जमा बँक खात्यात थेट जमा होऊन तीन वर्षांत भरावे असे आहे.

**मका (अन्नधान्य पीक):**
> **राष्ट्रीय अन्न सुरक्षा अभियान — गेहू, तांदूळ, ट्र्फॅ, न्यूट्रिशरल्स, मका** ही कृषी पिकांसाठी प्रदर्शनाद्वारे उत्पादन वाढीची योजना आहे; याचे लाभ शेतकरी गट/शेतकरी उत्पादक कंपनी/कोऑपरेटिव्ह सोसायटी यांना मिळतात.

**लागवड/खत व्यवस्थापन:**
> **कृषोन्नती योजना — एकीकृत बागायती विकास अभियान (एम.आय.डी.एच.)** अंतर्गत रोपवाटिका/लागवड सामग्री निर्मितीसाठी (मोठी रोपवाटिका, लहान रोपवाटिका, मान्यता नियम पूर्ण करण्यासाठी सुधारणा, हाय-टेक प्लग टाइप रोपवाटिका) मदत दिली जाते; मोठ्या रोपवाटिकेसाठी खर्च निकष प्रति हेक्टर ₹३० लाख, लहान रोपवाटिकेसाठी प्रति हेक्टर ₹२० लाख इ. असे आहे.

*Scheme Name*:
National food security Mission - Wheat, Rice, TRFA, Nutricerals, Maize

*Main Component*:
Crop demonstration

*Sub Component*:
1. Group Demonstration on Contiguous Area
2. Demonstration on Intercropping System
3. Demonstrations based on Cropping System

*Introduction*:
1. To increase the production and productivity of food grain crops by adopting modern technology developed through research by Agricultural Universities, techniques of resource-based tillage (resource management practices), and high-yielding varieties that provide increased output in a shorter time.
2. To use newly released varieties and adopt new technologies on farmers' fields.
3. To undertake actions to achieve the productivity enhancement targets set block-wise for crops like Paddy (Rice), Pulses, Wheat, Millets (Maize), and Nutri-Cereals (Jowar/Sorghum, Bajra/Pearl Millet, Nachani/Finger Millet, Varai/Barnyard Millet).
4. To improve soil texture, maintain pest/disease control, conserve moisture in the crop, and increase yield through demonstrations based on intercropping and cropping systems.

*Eligibility*:
1. The crop demonstrations should be implemented by Farmer Groups/Farmer Producer Companies (FPCs)/Cooperative Societies working in the agriculture sector, etc.
2. The farmer group must be registered before March 31, 2024.
3. The farmer group must be registered with any government agency (e.g., ATMA, Maharashtra State Rural Livelihood Mission (MSRLM), National Rural Livelihood Mission (NRLM), Mahila Arthik Vikas Mahamandal (MAVIM), NABARD, etc.).
4. The benefit should be provided to only one person from a single family (husband, wife, and children below 18 years).
5. If the group selected for the crop demonstration has more than 25 farmers, the concerned group should select 25 farmers.
6. The selection of Farmer Group/Company/Institution registered on the MahaDBT Portal for crop demonstrations will be done on the principle of First Come, First Served (FCFS) for those who apply first.
7. It is mandatory for the farmers in the group to be registered on Agristack to receive the benefit of the crop demonstration.
8. For the selection of beneficiaries for demonstrations based on the cropping system, only those farmers who are prepared to take crops in both seasons and have the necessary resources available accordingly should be selected.

answer:

question: मी सोयाबीन आणि कापूस दोन्ही पिकतो, कोणत्या योजनेत अर्ज करणे फायदेशीर आहे?
answer:
तुमच्या **कापूस** पिकासाठी राज्य पातळीची कापूस विकास योजना आणि **सोयाबीन** साठी तेलबिया मिशन (ओयलसीड) योजनेत अर्ज करणे तुमच्या दोन्ही पिकांसाठी फायदेशीर ठरेल; त्याचबरोबर प्रत्येक शेतकऱ्याला नियमित निधी मिळावा म्हणून पीएम-किसान आणि नैसर्गिक आपत्ती/कीड-रोगापासून संरक्षण हवे असेल तर पीएमएफबीवाई या केंद्रीय योजना देखील उपयोगाच्या आहेत.

**प्रधानमंत्री किसान सन्मान निधी योजना (पीएम-किसान)** ही केंद्र शासनाची योजना आहे जी दरवर्षी कुटुंबाला **₹६०००** लाभ देते.  
**पात्रता:**
- लागवडीयोग्य जमीनधारक शेतकरी कुटुंब (वगळणी निकष लागू)
- ७/१२ उतारा, आधार संलग्न, ई-केवायसी आवश्यक

**डॉ. बाबासाहेब आंबेडकर कृषी स्वावलंबन योजना (बी.ए.के.एस.वाय.)** ही महाराष्ट्र राज्याची योजना आहे जी अनुसूचित जाती/नवबौद्ध शेतकऱ्यांसाठी सिंचन व कृषी घटक अनुदानावर आधारित लाभ देते.  
**पात्रता:**
- अनुसूचित जाती/नवबौद्ध शेतकरी असणे (जात प्रमाणपत्र अनिवार्य)
- जमीनधारणा: किमान ०.२० हे. ते कमाल ६.०० हे. (नवीन विहिरीसाठी किमान ०.४० हे. आवश्यक)
- एका घटकाचा पूर्ण लाभ घेतल्यावर पुढचे पाच वर्षे त्याच लाभार्थी/कुटुंबाला परवानगी नाही

**राष्ट्रीय अन्न सुरक्षा व पोषण अभियान (एन.एफ.एस.एन.एम.) — व्यापारी पीक कापूस विकास योजना** ही महाराष्ट्र राज्याची योजना आहे जी कापूस उत्पादन वाढीसाठी प्रशिक्षण, प्रदर्शन, एकात्मिक कीड व्यवस्थापन, ऑनलाईन कीड निगराणी इत्यादी घटक देते.  
**लाभ (उदाहरणे):**
- मिरची/उडीद आंतरपीक अग्ररेषा प्रदर्शन: ₹८००० प्रति हेक्टर
- जास्त घनता लागवड प्रयोग: ₹१०००० प्रति हेक्टर
- एकात्मिक पीक व्यवस्थापन अग्ररेषा प्रदर्शन: ₹८००० प्रति हेक्टर
- कापूस बियाणे उत्पादन अग्ररेषा प्रदर्शन: ₹९००० प्रति हेक्टर
- वेजीटेशनलेस किड निगराणी व सल्ला सेवा: ₹८००० प्रति हेक्टर
- शेततळे झाडांची अवशेष काढणी दाखवणी: ₹५००० प्रति हेक्टर  
**पात्रता:**
- बहुतेक घटक गटासाठी (अग्ररेषा प्रदर्शन) लागू; बॅयोकार्ब वैयक्तिक; प्रशिक्षण अधिकाऱ्यांसाठी

**राष्ट्रीय खوراत तेल मिशन — ओयलसीड्स** ही महाराष्ट्र राज्याची योजना आहे जी सोयाबीनसह तेलबिया पिकांसाठी सुधारीत बियाणे व तांत्रिक प्रशिक्षण/प्रदर्शन यासारखे घटक देते.  
**पात्रता:**
- प्रदर्शनासाठी शेतकरी गट
- प्रमाणित बियाणे वितरणासाठी वैयक्तिक शेतकरी (निवडलेल्या व्हॅल्यू चेन क्लस्टरमध्ये)
- गट/संस्था स्तरासाठी साठवण/पोस्ट-हार्वेस्ट घटक

**कृषी यांत्रिकीकरण (राज्य प्रायोजित शेती यांत्रिकीकरण)** ही महाराष्ट्र राज्याची योजना आहे जी ट्रॅक्टर, यंत्रसामग्री व अवजारे खरेदीसाठी आर्थिक सहाय्य देते.  
**लाभ:**
- अनुसूचित जाती, अनुसूचित जमाती, लहान शेतकरी, महिला यांच्यासाठी साधारणपणे ४०% दराने अनुदान (घोषित कमाल मर्यादेपर्यंत)

**प्रधानमंत्री फसल विमा योजना (पीएमएफबीवाई)** ही केंद्र शासनाची योजना आहे जी अधिसूचित पिकांना नैसर्गिक आपत्ती, कीड व रोगामुळे होणारी नुकसान भरपाई देते.  
**पात्रता:**
- अधिसूचित क्षेत्रातील अधिसूचित पीक घेणारे सर्व शेतकरी (कर्जदार व बिगरकर्जदार)

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**?

तुम्हाला सर्वाधिक फायदा कोणत्या घटकासाठी हवा आहे — सिंचन (विहीर/पंप), कापूस प्रशिक्षण/प्रदर्शन, सोयाबीन सुधारीत बियाणे, की यंत्रसामग्री?
