Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp

*Main Component*:
Drip Irrigation

*Sub Component*:
1. Inline Drip Irrigation
2. Online Drip Irrigation

*Introduction*:
The Central Government has issued Operational Guidelines in the year 2024 for implementing the Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana - Per Drop More Crop, a centrally sponsored micro-irrigation scheme. This scheme is being implemented from the year 2022-23 under the name Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana - Per Drop More Crop. The Commissionerate of Agriculture, has issued guidelines for the micro-irrigation scheme. On the lines of this scheme, a micro-irrigation scheme (Drip and Sprinkler Irrigation) will be implemented under the Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Project. Accordingly, the following guidelines are being issued for implementing the approved micro-irrigation component in the villages selected under the project.

*Benefits*:
1.To increase the area under micro-irrigation by using modern technology in the project districts and to promote climate-resilient farming practices.
2. To encourage micro-irrigation methods for the development of agriculture and horticulture crops based on modern technology.
3. To manage fertilizers through the micro-irrigation system.
4. To increase agricultural production, the quality of agricultural produce, and consequently, the total income of farmers.
5. To increase water use efficiency.

*Eligibility*:
1. Farmers who have already received benefits on same land from any other scheme will not be eligible under this scheme.
2. If the farmer has availed the benefits of micro-irrigation components under any government scheme in the last 7 years, such areas will be excluded, and the remaining area can receive benefits within the total limit of 5 hectares.
3. The farmer must have access to water supply and electricity.
4. The benefits of this component under the project will be available to beneficiaries who own up to 5 hectares of land.

*Required Documents*:
1. If the applicant belongs to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe category, a caste certificate should be provided.
2. If the applicant is a joint account holder, a consent letter from the other account holders shall be submitted.
3. If the applicant is a person with disability, a disability certificate should be provided.

*Application Process*:
The NDKSP DBT Portal has been created with the following objectives - 
DBT System for accepting and processing subsidy applications received from farmers. Through this system, farmers can directly login and apply for financial assistance under scheme and disbursement of funds happen directly to the Aadhaar linked account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode. There is no need for farmer to visit a government office to apply for subsidy or receive disbursed funds. Also, farmers can track and monitor their applications in real time which shows transparency in NDKSP operations. This system facilitates NDKSP to perform its approval process in 100% paperless manner which eliminates intermediaries and establishes credibility. 
To avail the benefits of the components under the project, the beneficiary (farmer) must directly login on the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system using their Farmer ID. After login, the beneficiary becomes eligible to receive the project benefits. Additionally, it is mandatory for the beneficiary to link their Aadhaar number with their bank account so that the benefit amount can be directly transferred to their personal bank account.
The following farmer attributes need to be entered in the Portal: 
Farmer Attributes: (Essential): 
State, District, Sub-District/Block, Village, Farmer Name, Type of Identity  Farmer ID for landholder farmer is essential, Gender, Category, land cosent letter for joint landholders. 
Farmer Login and application Module:
Step 1: Farmer Login and Application Process through the "Mahavistaar-AI Application"
a) First, download and install the "Mahavistaar-AI Application" from the "Google Play Store" on your mobile.
b) After entering the application, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, click the "DBT" tab at the bottom right of the Dashboard screen.
d) Upon clicking, click the "NDKSP (PoCRA)" tab.
e) To avail benefits for various items under individual components, click the "Click Here" link at the end of this screen to apply.
f) Following this, your NDKSP (PoCRA) project dashboard screen will be available.
g) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.
Step 2: Farmer Login and application Process through the "Project's DBT Web Portal"
a) Visit to "https://mahapocra.gov.in/mr/applications" NDKSP 2.0 website
b) After entering the webpage of Farmer login, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, dashboard screen will be available.
d) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.

तुमच्या परिसरातील (वाशिम जिल्ह्याचा मालेगाव बाजार) आजच्या माहितीत हरभऱ्याचे भाव उपलब्ध नाहीत, त्यामुळे आज विकणे फायदेशीर आहे की नाही हे अचूक सांगता येत नाही. सध्या या बाजारात खालील पिकांचे भाव दिसत आहेत:

- सोयाबीन: किमान **₹४०००**, कमाल **₹४५००**, सरासरी **₹४४५०** प्रति क्विंटल  
(ही नोंद सुमारे ४ महिन्यांपूर्वीची आहे)

हरभऱ्याचे भाव पाहण्यासाठी तुम्ही कोणत्या एपीएमसी/बाजारात नेऊ शकता ते नाव सांगा—उदा. वाशिम, बोर्डी, किंवा इतर जवळचा बाजार? ?

question: मक्यामध्ये नत्राच्या कमतरतेची चिन्हे काय आहेत?

- मुळांची वाढ आणि पीकाची एकूण वाढ थांबते/मंदावते.

Bird flu is very dangerous and highly contagious [संसर्गजन्य] viral disease [विषाणूजन्य रोग] of poultry [कुक्कुट]. The disease [रोग] affects all age groups.

Remember...

Cause

Transmission

**STANDARD VETERINARY TREATMENT GUIDELINES FOR LIVESTOCK AND POULTRY**
```
Diagnosis [निदान]

Vitamin A deficiency [जीवनसत्त्व अ चा अभाव] should be suspected when any litters are born dead or weak, as also when abnormalities of the eyes [डोळे] are present in newborn piglets. If the litters of young pigs are very susceptible to enteritis and pneumonia, or if paralysis of the hindquarters is often seen in pigs in the piggery, then it is necessary to check if there is enough green feed/fodder [चारा] or vitamin A in the diet.

Enteritis, pneumonia and paralysis are not necessarily caused by vitamin A deficiency [जीवनसत्त्व अ चा अभाव]. A common disease [रोग] causing a similar birth of dead piglets is leptospirosis [लेप्टोस्पायरोसिस]. In this disease [रोग], the infected sow [मादी डुक्कर] does not show any obvious symptom [लक्षण] until she aborts, which may occur two to four weeks before farrowing [डुक्कर जन्म देणे] takes place. If the sow [मादी डुक्कर] farrows at full time, the piglets are born dead or weak. For diagnosis [निदान] of hypovitaminosis A, testing of sow [मादी डुक्कर]'s blood [रक्त] serum [सिरम] is essential.

Treatment [उपचार] and control

When there are obvious symptoms [लक्षणे] of vitamin A deficiency [जीवनसत्त्व अ चा अभाव], a dose [मात्रा] of 10 000 IU of the vitamin A supplement should be given as a drench. Pigs suffering from vitamin A deficiency [जीवनसत्त्व अ चा अभाव] will usually respond very quickly when the vitamin is supplied in adequate amounts, but animals with advanced symptoms [लक्षणे] such as marked muscular incoordination or blindness seldom recover completely.

Control

To prevent the occurrence of vitamin A deficiency [जीवनसत्त्व अ चा अभाव], good quality fresh green feed should be provided daily, or a vitamin A supplement added to the feed. About 60 g of green feed should be provided to each pig [वराह] daily. Whole milk [दूध] has fairly large amounts of vitamin A, but skim milk [स्किम्ड दूध] is a very poor source as are most milk [दूध] products, meat [मांस] meal [जेवण] and grain [धान्य] (except maize [मका] which is very high in carotene). Cod liver oil and fish [मासे] oils contain large amounts of vitamin A and can be used as supplements, but it is easier and cheaper to use one of the commercial synthetic stabilized vitamin A supplements. These can be obtained in powder or liquid emulsion form for mixing with the feed; details about the quantities to be fed are supplied with the various preparations. Many commercial preparations contain vitamin A together with vitamin D.
```

6.3.6 Goose stepping (Pantothenic acid deficiency)

Definition and etiology [रोगकारण]

Pantothenic acid, also known as vitamin B5, is essential for normal physiological functions in pigs. It plays an important role in the synthesis and metabolism of carbohydrates, proteins and fats. Deficiency of this vitamin can lead to a variety of clinical symptoms [लक्षणे], particularly affecting growing pigs and pregnant sows.

Inadequate dietary intake of pantothenic acid, particularly in growing pigs and pregnant sows, lead to the development of deficiency symptoms [लक्षणे]. Lowquality or improperly formulated feeds may lack sufficient levels of essential vitamins [जीवनसत्त्वे] and minerals [खनिजे], including pantothenic acid. Any concurrent gastrointestinal disease [रोग]/problems that affect the absorption of nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] from the gastrointestinal tract can also contribute to deficiencies.

Clinical signs

Clinical signs include loss of appetite [भूक कमी होणे], leading to significant weight loss [वजन कमी होणे] and poor growth [वाढ] rates. Goose-stepping gait is a distinctive, exaggerated high-stepping style of walking [चालणे], primarily affecting the hind limbs, that is commonly observed in pigs with this deficiency. It results from nerve damage and muscle weakness [दुर्बलता], resulting in a lack of muscle coordination leading to an unsteady and staggering walk. Non-infectious bloody diarrhoea [अतिसार] in few cases is also reported. In severe deficiency, death may occur as a result of complete anorexia.

Diagnosis [निदान]

Diagnosis [निदान] of deficiency cannot always be made based only on response to nutritional therapy, particularly if it is a long-term deficiency. A nutritional deficiency needs to be diagnosed based on several factors such as clinical signs, dietary review, presence of diseases and management [व्यवस्थापन] history.

answer:
केळी बागेतील करपा रोग (ब्लाईट) रोखण्यासाठी लागवडीच्या पद्धतीत बदल, आजारी पाने वेळेत काढून नष्ट करणे आणि शिफारस केलेली बुरशीनाशके फवारणी यांचा एकत्रितपणे अवलंब करा.

**लागवड व बाग व्यवस्थापन:**
- ओलसर, पाणथळ मातीत किंवा धरणा/नाव्याच्या कडेला केळीची लागवड टाळा  
- लागवड मे महिन्याच्या शेवटच्या आठवड्यात किंवा जूनच्या पहिल्या पंधरवड्यात करा  
- लागवडीपूर्वी केळ्याचे मूळभाज ०.१% कार्बेन्डाझिम द्रावणात अर्धा तास बुडवा  
- चारही बाजूने वाहून जाण्यासाठी खोरे ठेवून जास्त पाणी बाहेर काढा  

**पाने व लक्षणे:**
- पानांवर सुरुवातीला गुलाबी-भुरकट छोट्या ठिपक्यांची लक्षणे दिसताच ती पाने त्वरित काढून नष्ट करा; पुढे डाग वाढून पिवळसर फेर, भुकटीसारखा भाग दिसतो आणि पाने तुटू/कोमेजायला लागतात

question: पपईमध्ये आच्छादन (Mulching) करण्याचे फायदे काय आहेत?
answer:
पपईमध्ये आच्छादन केल्याने मातीतील ओलावा टिकून राहतो आणि तण नियंत्रणात मदत होते, त्यामुळे पाण्याचा ताण कमी होतो व फळधारणेस अनुकूल वातावरण निर्माण होते.

**आच्छादनाचे मुख्य फायदे:**
- दोन्ही ओळींच्या मधल्या सऱ्यांच्या बाजूंना आच्छादन केल्याने मातीचा ओलावा टिकायला मदत होते
- आंतरपीक (मधली पिके) घेतली तर तण कमी येते; तण आले तरी उपटूनच तेथे सोडू शकता
- आंतरपिकाची मुदत संपल्यावर कोरडी पाने/काड्या जैविक कोरडे आच्छादन म्हणून काम करतात
- हंगामानुसार नवीन आंतरपीक पेरायला मिळाले तर जागृत (लाइव्ह) आच्छादन मिळते
- दस्तऐवजात उल्लेख आहे की झाडांखाली आच्छादन पीक आणि ओलावा संवर्धन यामुळे फळधारणा सुधारते

**कशी करावी:**
- पपईच्या दोन ओळींच्या मधल्या सऱ्यांच्या दोन्ही बाजूंना आच्छादन ठेवा
- हंगामानुसार आंतरपीक निवडून जैविक किंवा जागृत आच्छादन ठेवण्याचा मार्ग दस्तऐवजात दिला आहे

- Along with these, drumstick, pigeon pea [तूर], colocasia/taro [अळू], chili, ginger [आले], turmeric [हळद], cowpea [चवळी], onion [कांदा], marigold [झेंडू], tomato [टोमॅटो], brinjal [वांगे], black gram [उडीद], cluster beans, and cucurbitaceous vegetables can be taken.
- Plant drumstick between two rows and sow [मादी डुक्कर] pigeon pea [तूर] in furrows at 8 feet distance.
- Sow [मादी डुक्कर] drumstick in one line and pigeon pea [तूर] in another line alternately.
- In the second and fourth rows, plant cowpea [चवळी], chili, and marigold [झेंडू].
- In the third row, sow [मादी डुक्कर] cucurbitaceous vegetables.
- In this way intercrops can be planted throughout the field [शेत].

(vii) Mulching [आच्छादन]

- Do mulching [आच्छादन] on both sides of furrows between two rows of papaya [पपई].
- Intercrops help in weed control [तण नियंत्रण]. If weeds [तण] appear, uproot and leave them there itself.
- After the intercrop duration is over, dry [कोरडे] leaves and plants will act as dry [कोरडे] mulching [आच्छादन].
- According to the season, sow [मादी डुक्कर] new intercrops to obtain live mulching [आच्छादन].

Technology for Rice [बासमती तांदूळ] - Maize [मका] - Mung Bean Cultivation on Plastic Mulch [प्लास्टिक आच्छादन]

As an alternative to the transplanting [पुनर्लागवड] method, we can plant rice [बासमती तांदूळ] by directly sowing [पेरणी] seeds (Direct Seeded Rice [भाताची थेट पेरणी]) without transplanting [पुनर्लागवड] seedlings. Therefore, to effectively control weeds [तण], rice [बासमती तांदूळ] crops can be cultivated on plastic mulch [प्लास्टिक आच्छादन], and after harvesting [कापणी] the rice [बासमती तांदूळ] crop [पीक], a second crop [पीक] can be taken in the *Rabi* season and a third crop [पीक] can be taken in the summer season [उन्हाळी हंगाम] on the same plastic mulch [प्लास्टिक आच्छादन], thereby increasing production [उत्पादन]. ## **Papaya [पपई]**

**Soil [माती]:** Well-drained, fertile, medium black, red loamy soil [माती] is suitable. Papaya [पपई] trees grow well in lateritic rocky soil [माती]. The pH of the soil [माती] should be 6.5 to 8.0. Papaya [पपई] trees do not grow well in calcareous and rocky soil [माती]. Since the roots of papaya [पपई] trees go deep to 40 cm, the upper layer [अंडी देणारी कोंबडी] of the soil [माती] should be loose and the subsequent 45 cm layer [अंडी देणारी कोंबडी] should be firm murram, which is conducive to the papaya [पपई] crop [पीक].

**Climate [हवामान]:** The papaya [पपई] tree grows in the tropical zone. Extreme cold and strong winds are harmful to this crop [पीक]. Papaya [पपई] requires an average temperature [तापमान] of 15 to 30 degrees Celsius and an annual rainfall of 1500 mm. For the growth [वाढ] of papaya [पपई], the maximum temperature [तापमान] can tolerate up to 42 degrees Celsius and the minimum temperature [तापमान] up to 12 degrees Celsius.

**Varieties:** Dioecious varieties (with male and female flowers on separate trees): Phule Vijaya, Co-8, Washington, Co-5, Co-6, Pusa Dwarf, Pusa Nanha, Pusa Giant. Hermaphrodite varieties: Kug Honey Dew, Co-7, Pusa Delicious, Sunrise Solo, Arka Prabhat, Arka Surya. Co-2, Pusa Majesty varieties are recommended for papain production [उत्पादन].

**Seedling Production [रोपे निर्मीती]:** Prepare seedlings using fresh seeds. In dioecious varieties, 100 to 125 grams of seeds are enough for one hectare, while in hermaphrodite varieties, 30 to 40 grams of seeds per hectare are sufficient. Seedlings grown in polythene bags grow well. For this, use 18 x 33 cm round-bottom plastic bags of 150 gauge to grow the seedlings. Sow [मादी डुक्कर] 1 to 3 seeds in each bag, cover them with well-decomposed compost [कंपोस्ट], and water them. Seedlings are ready for planting in about 6 to 7 weeks.

No-Till Cultivation Technology for Rabi Crops [रब्बी पिके] in Konkan

No-till cultivation means planting the crop [पीक] by digging the soil [माती] just enough for sowing [पेरणी] without any special cultivation. However, in this method, weed control [तण नियंत्रण], seed sowing [बियाणे पेरणी] and fertilizer application [खत देणे] are essential. Using such methods for crop [पीक] cultivation has the following advantages [फायदे].

- 1. The available moisture in the soil [माती] lasts longer.
- 2. The cost of cultivation [लागवडीचा खर्च] is reduced. This increases net profit [नफा].

- 5. Since moisture is retained in the soil [माती], crops like pulses can be taken on such residual moisture [अवशिष्ट आर्द्रता].
- 6. If crops are to be taken under irrigation [सिंचन], 50 per cent of water is saved.

question: केळीचा घड कापणीसाठी तयार आहे हे कसे ओळखावे?
answer:
केळीचा घड कापणीस तयार झाल्याचे ओळखण्यासाठी फळांचा हिरवा रंग पिवळसर होणे आणि फळे गोल व रुंद दिसू लागणे हे मुख्य लक्षण आहे?

**कापणीची लक्षणे:**
- फळांचा रंग हिरव्यातून पिवळसर होतो  
- फळांचे आकारगट गोल/रुंद (राउंड) होऊन फळ जुळते  

**कापणी करताना काळजी:**
- घड कापताना घडाचा देठ लांब राहील अशी कपाई करा  
- घड कपाईनंतर त्याचा रस फळांवर पडू नये, कारण फळांवर डाग येतात  
- घड कपाई झाल्यानंतर मूळ झाड ताबडतोब कापावे  

**स्रोत: कृषी दर्शनी डॉ. बाळासाहेब सावंत कोकण कृषी विद्यापीठ, दापोली २०२५**  

तुमच्या केळीची जात कोणती आहे (उदा. वासिगा, ग्रांड नाइन)?

question: माझ्या जमिनीजवळ साठवलेल्या धान्यासाठी कीड नियंत्रण सुविधा देणारे केंद्र शोधा.
answer:
तुमच्या बोर्डी (तालुका मालेगाव, जिल्हा वाशिम) जवळ साठवलेल्या धान्यासाठी खालील गोदाम सुविधा उपलब्ध आहेत.

पत्ता: कृषी उत्पन्न बाजार समिती, एमएसडब्ल्यूसी, विरामगृह उघडा, मालेगाव  
संपर्क: गोदाम व्यवस्थापक  
फोन: ०७२५४-२७११०४  
अंतर: ४.२ कि.मी.

**वाशिम गोदाम**  
पत्ता: कृषी उत्पन्न बाजार समिती, एमएसडब्ल्यूसी, रेल्वे स्थानकजवळ, वाशिम  
संपर्क: गोदाम व्यवस्थापक  
फोन: ०७२५२-२३२१५८  
अंतर: २१.१ कि.मी.

**मंग्रुळपीर गोदाम**  
पत्ता: कृषी उत्पन्न बाजार समिती, एमएसडब्ल्यूसी, मार्केट यार्ड, करंजा रोड, मंग्रुळपीर  
संपर्क: गोदाम व्यवस्थापक  
फोन: ०७२५३-२६०७०९  
अंतर: ३२.९ कि.मी.

**रिसोड गोदाम**  
पत्ता: कृषी उत्पन्न बाजार समिती, एमएसडब्ल्यूसी, मार्केट यार्ड, रिसोड  
संपर्क: गोदाम व्यवस्थापक

question: what are the schemes for purchasing a milk milking machine?
answer:
दूध निचरा यंत्र (मिल्किंग मशिन) खरेदीसाठी थेट यंत्र अनुदानाच्या योजना उपलब्ध यादीत दिसत नाहीत; पण शेतकरी यांत्रिकीकरण व आधारभूत सुविधांच्या केंद्र/राज्य योजनांमध्ये काही मदत मिळू शकते.

**प्रधानमंत्री किसान सन्मान निधी योजना (पीएम-किसान):**
- शेतकरी कुटुंबाला वर्षाला **₹६०००** (तीन हप्त्यांत) ही मदत दिली जाते.

**पात्रता:**
- लागवडक्षम जमीनधारकांची आर्थिकदृष्ट्या दुर्बल शेतकरी कुटुंबे.

**अर्ज कसा करावा:**
- पीएम-किसान पोर्टलवर ऑनलाईन अर्ज प्रक्रिया आहे.

**राज्य पुरस्कृत कृषी यांत्रिकीकरण:**
- शेतीची यंत्रे व अवजारे खरेदीसाठी आर्थिक मदत उपलब्ध आहे.
- साधारणपणे अनुसूचित जाती, अनुसूचित जमाती, लघु शेतकरी, महिला यांना ४०% आणि इतर शेतकऱ्यांना ५०% (किंवा शासनाने जाहीर केलेल्या कमाल मर्यादेपर्यंत) अशी अनुदान रक्कम ठरते.

**पात्रता:**
- वैयक्तिक शेतकरी.

**अर्जासाठी कागदपत्रे:**
- घ्यायच्या यंत्राचा कोटेशन
- यंत्राचा चाचणी अहवाल
- ट्रॅक्टर चालित अवजारांसाठी ट्रॅक्टरचे आर.सी.

**अनुभाग यंत्रे आणि अवजारे (यांत्रिकीकरण उपाय योजनेअंतर्गत):**
- ही केंद्र योजना असून राज्य पुरस्कृत यांत्रिकीकरणासारखीच यंत्र/अवजारे खरेदीसाठी आर्थिक मदत देते (वरीलप्रमाणे ४०%/५०% अशी दर संकल्पना नमूद आहे).

**कृषी पायाभूत सुविधा निधी:**
- बाँके कर्जावर व्याज सवलत ३% आणि कर्जासाठी विश्वास担保 कव्हर; कर्ज मर्यादा **₹२.०० कोटी** पर्यंत.
- ही मदत फार्मगेटवरील प्राथमिक/द्वितीयक काढणीनंतरची पायाभूत सुविधा यासाठी कर्ज प्रस्तावांमध्ये लागू होते.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

तुम्हाला हे दूध निचरा यंत्र स्वतःच्या शेतासाठी आहे की सहकारी/दुग्धव्यवसाय गटासाठी, आणि तुमची जमीनधारणा/श्रेणी कोणती आहे?

Benefit for Farm Machinery and Equipments.

*Sub Component*:
Tractors, power tillers, automated machinery, tractor-operated implements, tractor-operated crop protection implements, and post-harvest primary processing implements.

*Introduction*:
The declining number of livestock and the shortage of labor for agricultural work necessitate mechanization in agriculture. Mechanization allows work to be completed within a specified time frame, saves inputs, and saves production costs.
Objective:-
        Resolve labour issues in agriculture.
        Promote Farm Mechanization.
        Enable farmers to take up farm operations in time.
        Promote custom hiring services for farm mechanization.
        Create rural employment.
        Help to Increase agriculture production.

*Benefits*:
1. Financial assistance to farmers for procurement of farm machinery and implements
2. Generally, the subsidy is given at a rate of 40 % for SC, ST & small farmers, Womens & 50% for other farmers percent of the cost or the maximum subsidy limit declared by the Central Government, whichever is lower.

*Eligibility*:
Individual Farmer.

*Required Documents*:
1. Quotation of Implement to be purchase.
2. Test report of the Implement.
3. RC of tractor for tractor driven implements.

*Application Process*:
Applications from Interested farmers are invited on https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/ this portal. For transparency in beneficiary selection, presanction is being given by determining seniority through FCFS method. All the processes from beneficiary selection to grant payment are being implemented online.
After presanction, farmers are being allowed to purchase from the open market as per their choice. At the time of purchase, farmers are required to make payment through cheque/DD/online from their own bank account. The subsidy amount is being transferred to the Aadhaar-linked bank account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) method.

question: भातातील Gall Midge कसा ओळखावा आणि त्याचे नियंत्रण कसे करावे?
answer:
भातातील गाद माशी (गल मीडज) म्हणजेच रिकाम्या, पांढऱ्या रंगाच्या शेंड्या दिसणे—या लक्षणाने ती ओळखा; आणि नियंत्रणासाठी प्रतिकारक वाण, वेळेवर रोपवाटिका तपासणी व शिफारस केलेली जमिनीतून करण्याची पद्धत यावर भर द्या.

**ओळख:**
- भाताच्या रोपांमध्ये अचानक काही शेंडे चमकदार पांढरे/चांदीसारखे दिसू लागतील व त्याचा आतील भाग रिकामा येईल असे दिसेल.
- एकात्मिक कीड व्यवस्थापन मार्गदर्शक प्रमाणे पुनर्लागवडीच्या वेळी किंवा नंतर सुरुवातीच्या अवस्थेत ही पांढरी/चांदीसारखी शेंडा दिसण्याची लक्षणे दिसतात.

**नियंत्रण:**
- प्रतिकारक वाण लावणे: सिंडेवाही २००१, साकोली ८, पी.के.व्ही. गणेश अशा वाणांचा पर्याय दिला आहे.

- शेतातली उपाययोजना: चिखलणीवेळी गरदीचे पाने १.५० टन प्रति हेक्टर शेतात घालणे, आजूबाजूची आडवाटांची/ओळख नसलेली वनस्पती (देओधान) नष्ट करणे, किडीग्रस्त रोपे काढून नष्ट करणे.

2. *Faecal examination*: (a) Detection of segments in the stool - place a segment on the slide and put a drop of water and tease the segment with the help of pins to release the ova or egg capsule from the segment.

By looking at the morphological characteristics of the eggs [अंडी], one can identify some of the tape worms [कृमि]. The characteristic of the oncosphere inside the egg is the presence of three pairs of hooks.

Treatment [उपचार]: Many drugs have been used for the elimination of tapeworms. Some drugs are effective against the entire tape worm and some are against the strobila for which repeated medication is required. Some drugs require the help of a laxative or a purgative to evacuate the paralyzed worms [कृमि] from the intestines.

Most of the drugs are effective against the adult worms [कृमि] present in the intestines and very few are effective against the stages present in the intermediate host. As such, the stages present in the intermediate host have to be removed surgically or else such animals have to be euthanised. The following drugs have been used:

1. Anthelin

2. Bunamidine hydrochloride: It is nothing but N, N- dibutyl 4-hexyloxy

naphthamidine hcl and is available as Scolaban tablets. It is used @ 25-50 mg/kg body weight [शरीराचे वजन] after fasting the animal for 3-4 hours. The tablet should not be crushed.

3. Arecoline hydrobromide: It is administered @ 1 mg/kg body weight [शरीराचे वजन] after starving the animal for 12 hours. It paralyses the worms [कृमि] and increases the peristalsis of the g.i. tract.

**STANDARD VETERINARY TREATMENT GUIDELINES FOR LIVESTOCK AND POULTRY**
```
Treatment [उपचार]

No specific treatment [उपचार]. Supportive care includes treatment [उपचार] of secondary bacterial infections, and use of NSAIDs, antihistamine [अँटीहिस्टामिन], fluid and electrolyte [विद्युतद्रव] therapy.

Prevention [प्रतिबंध] and Control

Controlling bluetongue involves vector control [वहन करणारा किड नियंत्रण],

vaccination [लसीकरण], and management [व्यवस्थापन] practices. Available vaccines include inactivated pentavalent vaccine in India. Implementing quarantine [विलगीकरण] and movement controls during outbreaks to prevent the spread of the virus is important.

Biosecurity Measures [जैव सुरक्षा उपाय]

Effective biosecurity measures [जैव सुरक्षा उपाय] are crucial to prevent the introduction and spread of bluetongue. Quarantine [विलगीकरण] new animals [नवीन पशू] or returning animals for a period to monitor for signs of disease [रोग]. Minimize animal movement during peak midge activity periods. Regular cleaning [साफसफाई] and disinfection of equipment and facilities. Use insect [कीटक]-proof housing [निवास व्यवस्था] and insecticides [कीटकनाशके] to reduce midge populations. Regular monitoring of animals for clinical signs and implementing early diagnostic testing during outbreaks.

Sample Collection [नमुना संकलन] for Diagnosis [निदान]

Collect whole blood [रक्त] samples in anticoagulant [रक्त गोठणे प्रतिबंधक द्रव्य] (heparin [हेपारिन]) tubes for PCR [पीसीआर] and virus isolation [अलग ठेवणे]. Serum [सिरम] samples can be used for serological tests. Collect tissue samples from necropsied animals, including lymph nodes, spleen, lungs, and heart, for virus isolation [अलग ठेवणे] and histopathology [ऊतक रोगशास्त्र]. Nasal or oral swabs can be collected for PCR [पीसीआर] testing. Samples should be collected in sterile VTM/PBS for PCR [पीसीआर] and virus isolation [अलग ठेवणे], whereas samples should be collected in 10 percent formalin for histopathology [ऊतक रोगशास्त्र]. Capture and submit Culicoides midges for virus detection to identify vector involvement in transmission. Samples should be kept cool and transported to the laboratory as soon as possible, ideally within 24- 48 hours, to preserve the integrity of the virus for accurate testing.

Mix Chloropyriphos 20% EC at 10 ml, 10 liters of water and soak the seedling [रोप] roots in it for 12 hours to protect against gall midge [गाद माशी] and stem borer [खोड किउा]. question: सोलापूर भागात कालचे तापमान डाळिंब बागेसाठी योग्य होते का?
answer:
सोलापूर भागात कालचे (१४ मार्च २०२६) तापमान डेटानुसार किमान २०.४१°C आणि कमाल ३७.९६°C होते, त्यामुळे हे तापमान डाळिंब बागेसाठी थेट योग्य की हानिकारक याचा निश्चित अर्थ सांगता येत नाही कारण उपलब्ध दस्तऐवजांत डाळिंबासाठी नेमके आदर्श तापमान पट्टे दिलेले नाहीत; परंतु वाढते उष्णतेने फळांना झडप/उन्हापासून जखमेची शक्यता लक्षात घेऊन संरक्षणात्मक उपाय करणे उपयोगी ठरते?

**हवामान:** सोलापूरमध्ये १४ मार्च २०२६ रोजी पाऊस ० मिमी होता; किमान आर्द्रता २५.९% आणि कमाल आर्द्रता ६०.४% होती; कमाल वारा ५.७ कि.मी./ता. इतका नोंदला गेला आहे?

**डाळिंब सल्ला:**
- प्रखर सूर्यप्रकाशात फळांना झडपांपासून संरक्षण म्हणून झाडांना छाया देण्यासाठी पांढऱ्या रंगाच्या यू.वी. पॉलिमर ६० जी.एस.एम. जाडीचा जाळी वापरण्याची शिफारस आहे?
- अनमोल हवामानात बदल व अस्थिरतेवर त्रास सहन करण्यासाठी पिशवीकरण, झाडांची छाया आणि बाष्पोत्सर्जन प्रतिबंधकांचा वापर याबाबत माहिती देणे उपयोगी असल्याचेही नमूद केले आहे?

**स्रोत: हवामान इतिहास (स्कायमेट)**  
**स्रोत: एम.पी.के.व्ही. कृषी दर्शनी**

**Scientific Meat Production Extension Modules and Techniques for Butchers, meat handlers and consumers**
```
The synthesis of HSPs like HSP70 increases in response to various stressors and can serve as a marker for chronic stress exposure. Their levels may remain elevated for days following a stressful event.

Contextual Factors Influencing Stress Responses

Environmental Stressors: Factors such as overcrowding, extreme temperatures, and social dynamics significantly impact stress levels in animals. For example, pigs subjected to social stress or housed in barren environments show distinct physiological responses compared to those in enriched settings.

Chronic vs. Acute Stress: The physiological responses can differ markedly between acute and chronic stress situations. While acute stress typically results in heightened hormonal responses (like cortisol spikes), chronic stress may lead to blunted responses or adaptations that complicate assessment.

Practical Implications of Physiological Indicators of Stress in Animals

Physiological indicators of stress in animals play a crucial role in assessing animal welfare [प्राणी कल्याण] and informing management [व्यवस्थापन] practices. Understanding these indicators allows for better decisionmaking in animal care, production [उत्पादन], and research environments.

1. Welfare Assessment Comprehensive Evaluation [मूल्यांकन]: Physiological indicators, such as cortisol levels and heart rate, provide objective data that can be combined with behavioral observations to create a more comprehensive assessment of an animal's welfare. This multi-faceted approach helps in identifying both acute and chronic stressors affecting animals . Identification of Stressors: By monitoring physiological responses, caregivers can identify specific stressorsbe they environmental, social, or health [आरोग्य]-relatedthat negatively impact animal welfare [प्राणी कल्याण]. For instance, elevated body temperature [शरीराचा तापमान] and increased respiratory rates can indicate thermal stress [तापमान ताण] in pigs during hot weather [वातावरण] .

2. Management [व्यवस्थापन] Practices Improved Housing [निवास व्यवस्था] Conditions: Understanding stress indicators can lead to modifications in housing [निवास व्यवस्था] and management [व्यवस्थापन] practices. For example, if physiological indicators show high stress levels due to overcrowding, adjustments can be made to reduce animal density . Behavioral Interventions: Recognizing physiological signs of stress allows for timely interventions. For example, if certain animals exhibit increased heart rates or abnormal behaviors during handling, strategies such as gradual desensitization or environmental enrichment can be employed to mitigate stress .

The second phase of the Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp has been initiated by the Government of Maharashtra with financial assistance from the World Bank with the objective of enabling farmers to adapt to the situation arising from climate change [हवामान बदल].
The increased level of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere is an important factor associated with climate change [हवामान बदल]. The plantation of fruit orchards (perennial trees) is very effective in the process of sequestering this carbon dioxide (Carbon Sequestration [कार्बन साठवण]). Along with the economic upliftment of farmers, sequestering the carbon dioxide that causes climate change [हवामान बदल] is an objective of this project.
1. Objectives
1.1. To expand climate-resilient farming practices [हवामान लवचिक शेती पध्दती] through the plantation of long-term income-generating fruit crops.
1.2. To achieve the objective of increasing farmers' income by generating regular and maximum income from horticulture [उद्यानविद्या] plantation.
1.3. To establish orchards of long-term, income-generating fruit crops that survive on less water, providing a supplementary business to rainfed agriculture [कोरडवाहू शेती].
1.4. To reduce soil erosion [जमीनीची धुप] and promote the conservation of green cover.

**Planting:** Raspberry [रास्पबेरी] is planted in hedge-row or hill type. In hedge-row type, the distance between two rows is kept 2.0 to 2.5 meters and the distance between plants is kept negligible to 45 cm. In hill type, the distance between two rows is 3.0 to 3.5 meters and the distance between two plants is kept 60 cm. In hill type, 5-6 vigorous branches are allowed to grow and are tied in the center. This makes interculture and fruit harvesting [कापणी] easier.

Varieties Glen Moy, Glen Clova, Malling Admiral, Malling Jewel, Ziva, Miker, Chiliwick, Tulameen, Komokus, Double Delight. Varieties with less fog effect (Malling Exploit, Malling Promise and Ziva -1)

**Climate [हवामान]:** Raspberry [रास्पबेरी] is a fruit of cold region and grows well in temperate climate [हवामान] also. Fog or extremely dry [कोरडे] climate [हवामान] is not suitable for raspberry [रास्पबेरी]. Some varieties of raspberry [रास्पबेरी] require 3 weeks of chilling below 3.3 degrees Celsius.

**Soil [माती]:** Raspberry [रास्पबेरी] can be planted in sandy to heavy soils. The pH of the soil [माती] should be 5.8 to 6.7. The soil [माती] should be deep, fertile and well drained.

**Fertilizer Management [खत व्यवस्थापन]:** Raspberry [रास्पबेरी] requires 50 kg nitrogen [नत्र] per hectare, 30 kg phosphorus [स्फुरद] per hectare, 100 kg potash per hectare. Nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] required per acre for raspberry [रास्पबेरी] are 20: 12: 40 kg N: P: K, Urea [यूरिया] 44 kg (1 bag), Single Super Phosphate 75 kg (1.50 bag). Determine the amount of fertilizer [खत] by soil testing [माती परीक्षण].

**Water Management [पाण्याचे व्यवस्थापन]:** Drip irrigate raspberry [रास्पबेरी] with 90% of the evaporation water at an interval of three days. Watering 3-4 weeks before fruit harvesting [कापणी] improves the quality of the fruit. Do not water after harvesting [कापणी] as the tree goes into dormancy.

**Pruning [फांद्या छाटणी]:** Raspberry [रास्पबेरी] flowers bloom on the current year's vegetative growth [वाढ]. Therefore, it is important to balance the vegetative growth [वाढ] and flowering branches. Prune [आलूबुखारा] branches that have flowered and fruited in the past year. Prune [आलूबुखारा] old, diseased and broken branches from time to time.

Safflower [करडई] is a low-cost and important oilseed [तेलबिया] crop [पीक] of the Rabi season [रबी हंगाम]. question: मृदा आरोग्य पत्रिका योजनेअंतर्गत मला मोफत माती परीक्षण कोठे करून मिळेल?
answer:
तुमच्या जवळच्या माती परीक्षण प्रयोगशाळा जेथे तुम्ही मृदा आरोग्य पत्रिका योजनेसाठी मातीचा नमुना देऊ शकता, ते खाली दिल्या आहेत; मात्र या प्रयोगशाळा मोफत आहेत का किंवा **₹११०** अशीच रक्कम घेतात हे सध्याच्या उपलब्ध माहितीमध्ये स्पष्ट नाही.

**जवळचे माती परीक्षण केंद्रे:**
**माती परीक्षण प्रयोगशाळा, नांदेड**  
पत्ता: वघालकर पेट्रोल पंपासमोर, हायद्रबाद रोड, धनेगांव, नांदेड  
संपर्क: श्री. पी.पी. पाळेवाड  
फोन: ७७४४८२२००१  
अंतर: ३५ कि.मी.

**माती परीक्षण प्रयोगशाळा, परभणी**  
पत्ता: जानकी निवास, योगक्षेम कोलनी, विषावा फाटा जवळ, जिंतूर रोड, परभणी  
संपर्क: श्री. पी.पी. घुले  
फोन: ९४२२१७७३४९  
अंतर: ५० कि.मी.

**माती परीक्षण प्रयोगशाळा, लातूर**  
पत्ता: डिस्ट्रिक्ट सोईल सर्व्हे आणि सोईल टेस्टिंग लेबोरेटरी, दिवानजी कॉम्प्लेक्स, अंबेजोगाई रोड, लातूर ४१३५१२  
संपर्क: औसेकर आर.आर.  
फोन: ९०२१५५१२१२  
अंतर: ९७ कि.मी.

**मृदा आरोग्य पत्रिका (लागवड):**
काही मार्गदर्शक सूचनांनुसार माती परीक्षणासाठी **₹११० प्रति मृदा आरोग्य पत्रिका** इतका अनुदान/सहाय्य टप्पा म्हणून नमूद आहे, पण तो नेमका कुठे लागू होतो (प्रयोगशाळा/कार्यालय/नियुक्त केंद्र) हे या माहितीत स्पष्ट नाही.

**स्रोत: कृषी सेवा माहिती**  

तुम्हाला नांदेड जिल्ह्यातीलच प्रयोगशाळा हवी आहे की लोहा तालुक्यात जवळची कोणतीही माती परीक्षण सुविधा शोधू? ?

**MPKV Krishi Darshani**
```
Water required for the crop [पीक] (liter/day/tree) = a x b x c x d

a = Evaporation of water from the soil [माती] (mm/day) b = Crop coefficient [पीक गुणांक]

c = Irrigation [सिंचन] coefficient d = Area covered by trees (sq. meters, m X m)

The information of the various components used in the above formula should be extracted as follows.

Evaporation of water from the soil [माती] (a): The water requirement of the crop [पीक] depends on the climate [हवामान] i.e. various components of the climate [हवामान] (e.g. temperature [तापमान], humidity [आर्द्रता], wind [वारा] speed, hours of sunshine per day, etc.). Information on evaporation of water can be obtained from the Meteorological Department's observatory or through an evaporation pan [बाष्पीभवन पॅन]. If farmers install an evaporation pan [बाष्पीभवन पॅन] collectively for the entire area, they can measure the evaporation of water through it. Evaporation from the soil [माती] is 70 to 80 percent of the evaporation from the evaporation pan [बाष्पीभवन पॅन]. For that, the evaporation pan [बाष्पीभवन पॅन] coefficient should be taken as 0.7 to 0.8. For Western Maharashtra, this coefficient should be taken as 0.8. If information on various components of the climate [हवामान] is available from the observatory, then the reference evaporation of water can also be extracted through the 'Phule Jal' computer program developed by this University.

Crop Coefficient [पीक गुणांक] (b): The water requirement varies according to the growth [वाढ] stage of the crops. The requirement is less in the initial stages. As the growth [वाढ] increases, the requirement increases and decreases slightly after full growth [वाढ] and flowering, fruiting. The changing water requirement according to crop [पीक] and crop [पीक] stage can be taken into account with the help of crop coefficient [पीक गुणांक]. The crop coefficient [पीक गुणांक] is usually between 0.2 and 1.15 according to the crop [पीक] and the stage of crop [पीक] growth [वाढ].

question: जमिनीतील सेंद्रिय कर्ब वाढवण्यासाठी सेंद्रिय मार्ग सुचवा.
answer:
जमिनीतील सेंद्रिय कार्बन वाढवण्यासाठी नियमित शेणखत/कंपोस्ट, हिरवळीचे खतपिके आणि पीक अवशेष मातीमध्ये मिसळणे हा सर्वात प्रभावी सेंद्रिय मार्ग आहे.

**सेंद्रिय पदार्थ:**  
- शेणखत, कंपोस्ट, गांडूळखत यांचा वापर करा; सिंचनाच्या क्षेत्रात १० टन प्रति हेक्टर आणि वरखाली (कोरडवाहू) क्षेत्रात ५ टन प्रति हेक्टर सेंद्रिय खताची शिफारस दिली आहे?
- हिरवळीचे खतपिके जसे ढैंचा, गिरिपुष्प (युवा शाखा), सुबाभळ (युवा शाखा) पेरणीनंतर साधारण १ ते १ अर्धा महिन्यांनी किंवा फुलोऱ्यावर मातीमध्ये कुजवून मिसळा?

**पीक अवशेष व्यवस्थापन:**  
- पीक अवशेष जाळू नका; पीकाच्या अवशेषांचे तृतीयांश भाग मातीमध्ये दबवून ठेवा?
- पीक अवशेष कुजवण्यासाठी ट्रायकोडर्मा वापरण्याचा उल्लेख आहे?

**मशागत व आच्छादन:**  
- मशागत कमी ठेवा आणि पाणी-माती संवर्धनाला भर द्या?
- गहू काडणीसारखे आच्छादन जमिनीवर ठेवल्याने सेंद्रिय कार्बन राखण्यास मदत होते?

**स्रोत: एम.पी.केव्ही. कृषी दर्शनी; कृषी व्ही.एन.एम.ए.यू.**

9.3 Carbon Credits [कार्बन क्रेडिट्स] Generation in Natural Farming [नैसर्गिक शेती]

In natural farming [नैसर्गिक शेती], the accumulation of stable carbon in the soil [माती] is driven by the constant addition of biomass [वनस्पती झाडे पीके व शैवाल यापासुन निर्माण होणारा सेंद्रीय पदार्थ] through mulching [आच्छादन] and the enhanced activity of microorganisms [सूक्ष्मजीव]. This system converts agricultural lands into carbon sinks, which mitigates climate change [हवामान बदल] and improves the water-holding capacity [पाणी धारण क्षमता] of the soil [माती]. This enhancement increases resilience to drought [दुष्काळ] and rainfall variability. While precise large-scale quantification is an ongoing area of research, the foundational principles align directly with the objectives of carbon farming [कार्बन शेती]. Natural farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] employs multiple regenerative practices that either remove carbon from the atmosphere or prevent its release:

9.3.1 Increased Organic Matter Addition [सेंद्रिय पदार्थांची भर]

(i) Regular application of farmyard manure [शेणखत] (FYM), compost [कंपोस्ट], crop [पीक] residues, and green manures builds soil organic carbon [मातीतील सेंद्रिय कार्बन].

9.3.3 Mulching [आच्छादन] and Cover Cropping [आच्छादन पीक लागवड]

(i) Maintains continuous soil [माती] cover, prevents erosion, and adds biomass [वनस्पती झाडे पीके व शैवाल यापासुन निर्माण होणारा सेंद्रीय पदार्थ].

9.3.4 Reduced Tillage [जमिनीची मशागत] and Soil [माती] Disturbance

(i) Helps preserve existing carbon stocks by minimizing oxidation.

9.3.5 Elimination of Synthetic Inputs

(i) Avoids nitrous oxide emissions from chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते] and reduces energy footprint.

Conclusion [निष्कर्ष]

Carbon credits [कार्बन क्रेडिट्स] in natural farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] represent a winwin solution: they reward farmers for climatepositive practices, reduce national GHG emissions, and attract new forms of green finance into rural areas. **Integrated Nutrient Management [एकात्मिक पोषण व्यवस्थापन] (INM):**

The method of using organic fertilizers [सेंद्रिय खते], green manures, bacterial fertilizers, and organic [सेंद्रिय] liquids in appropriate proportions as complementary fertilizers along with chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते] is called Integrated Nutrient Management [एकात्मिक पोषण व्यवस्थापन].

In this method, a balance is maintained between chemical, organic [सेंद्रिय], and biological fertilizers [जैविक खत]. Also, by including leguminous crops [शेंगायुक्त पीक] in crop rotation [पीक फेरपालट], soil fertility [मृदा सुपीकता] is maintained. By saving expensive chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते], soil productivity [मृदा उत्पादकता] is continuously improved year after year. In this method, generally half of the total requirement of nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] is supplied through chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते], and the remaining half is supplied through organic fertilizers [सेंद्रिय खते]. It is recommended to take green manure crops [हिरवळीची खतपिके] and bury them in the soil [माती] once every three years. All crop [पीक] residues like sugarcane [ऊस] trash, sorghum [ज्वारी] stalks, wheat [गहू] and paddy stubble [खुंट], sunflower [सुर्यफुल] stalks, and all residues of pulse [डाळ] crops, etc., are buried in the soil [माती] to increase the amount of organic matter [सेंद्रिय पदार्थ]. Along with this, it is necessary to use bacterial fertilizers and vermicompost [गांडूळखत].

**The following points should be considered while selecting chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते]:**

1. For long-term crops, compound fertilizers should be used (Nitrophosphate 15:15:15) (Ammo. Phosphate 28:28:0).
2. To facilitate the availability of phosphorus [स्फुरद], completely soluble fertilizers should be selected. E.g., Single Super Phosphate, Diammonium Phosphate.

question: खताचा योग्य वापर करून उत्पादनात फरक कसा पडतो हे दाखवतात का?
answer:
खताचा योग्य वापर कसा उत्पादन वाढवतो हे दाखवायला शेतकऱ्यांच्या शेतात आघाडीचे प्रयोग (फ्रंटलाईन डेमो) केले जातात, ज्यामध्ये शिफारस केलेली खताची मात्रा देऊन शेतकरी पद्धतीपेक्षा उत्पादनात फरक स्पष्ट दिसतो.

**डमोमध्ये काय दाखवतात:**
- माती तपासणी करून त्यानुसार बियाणे, बीजप्रक्रिया, सूक्ष्म अन्नद्रव्ये आणि सेंद्रिय/जैव घटक यासह शिफारस केलेली रासायनिक खतांची मात्रा दिली जाते  
- एकत्रित प्रयोग म्हणजेच एकाच वेळी बियाणे व इतर तंत्रज्ञानाचा परिणाम दाखवला जातो; वेगवेगळ्या घटकांसाठी वेगळे डमो न करता एकूण परिणाम दाखवला जातो  
- १०% खर्च साईनबोर्ड, पुस्तिका, निरीक्षण व शेतातील दिवस याला, तर ९०% खर्च शेतकऱ्याच्या शेतात इनपुट व तंत्रज्ञान देण्यासाठी वापरला जातो  

**उत्पादनात फरक कसा दिसतो (उदाहरणे):**
- ऊसात डमो प्लॉटमध्ये सरासरी उत्पादन वाढ १६.५६% (शेतकरी पद्धतीपेक्षा)  
- भाजीपाला पिकांमध्ये डमोत सरासरी उत्पादन वाढ २३.१३%  
- फलभाजी पिकांमध्ये डमोत सरासरी उत्पादन वाढ ३०.५३%  
- गहू पिकात डमोत सरासरी उत्पादन वाढ १६.००%  
- मका पिकात डमोत उत्पादन वाढ सुमारे २१%  

**स्रोत: आयसीएअर वार्षिक अहवाल २०२३–२४; एन.एम.ई.ओ.–ओ.एस. ऑपरेशनल मार्गदर्शक सूचना (२०२४–२५ ते २०३०–२०३१)**

तुम्हाला कोणत्या पिकासाठी खताच्या डमो/आघाडी प्रयोगाची माहिती हवी आहे—ज्वारी, मका, सोयाबीन की दुसरे? ?

question: मी नवीन शेतकरी आहे, कोणत्या योजना माझ्यासाठी सर्वप्रथम उपलब्ध आहेत?
answer:
तुमच्यासाठी सर्वप्रथम **प्रधानमंत्री किसान सन्मान निधी योजना** आणि **नमो शेतकरी महासन्मान निधी** या दोन अनुदानांवर लक्ष द्या; कारण त्या तुम्हाला प्रत्येक वर्षी थेट बचतीचा आधार देतात.

**प्रधानमंत्री किसान सन्मान निधी योजना (पीएम-किसान)** ही केंद्र योजना आहे जी प्रति कुटुंब प्रति वर्ष **₹६०००** (तीन समान हप्ते) देते.  
**पात्रता:**
- लागवडीयोग्य जमीनधारणा असलेली आर्थिकदृष्ट्या दुर्बल शेतकरी कुटुंबे  
- सातबारा उतारा, भू-नोंदी, आधार नोंदणी व ई-केवायसी पूर्ण असावे  

**नमो शेतकरी महासन्मान निधी** ही केंद्र योजना आहे जी पीएम-किसानमध्ये पात्र असलेल्यांना वेगळ्या स्वरूपात प्रति वर्ष **₹६०००** (तीन समान हप्ते) देते.  
**पात्रता:**
- पीएम-किसानमध्ये पात्र/अनुदान घेणारे असणे आवश्यक  
- योजनेसाठी स्वतंत्र अर्ज लागत नाही; फक्त पीएम-किसान लाभार्थी असणे पुरेशा  

**डॉ. बाबासाहेब आंबेडकर कृषी स्वावलंबन योजना** ही राज्य योजना आहे जी अनुसूचित जाती/नवबौद्ध शेतकऱ्यांसाठी सिंचनाची सोय देते (उदा. नवीन विहीर, जुनी विहीर दुरुस्ती, शेळीपिकांचे प्लास्टिक लाइनिंग, पंपसेट इ.).  
**मुख्य लाभ (मर्यादा):**
- नवीन सिंचन विहिरीसाठी कमाल **₹४०००००** पर्यंत अनुदान मर्यादा  
- जुनी विहीर दुरुस्तीसाठी कमाल **₹१०००००** पर्यंत अनुदान मर्यादा  
- शेळीपिकाचे प्लास्टिक लाइनिंगसाठी प्रमाणित निकषांनुसार ९०% किंवा **₹२०००००** पैकी जे कमी ते  

**महात्मा गांधी राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार हमी योजना** ही केंद्र योजना आहे जी वार्षिक कामकाजासाठी रोजगार देण्यासोबत बगीचा लागवड (फलोत्पादन रोपे) करून जागा व्यवस्थापन व उत्पन्न वाढीसाठी मदत करते.  
**पात्रता:**
- गट कार्यकारिणीमध्ये निवड व कामकाज कार्ड धारक असणे  
- सातबारा/आठअ उतारा, आधार व आधार जोडलेली बँक खाते  

**राज्य प्रायोजित कृषी यांत्रिकीकरण** ही राज्य योजना आहे जी कस्टम हायरिंग सेंटर (एच.सी.) स्थापनेसाठी पूंजी खर्चाच्या ४०% अनुदान देते.  
**पात्रता:**
- वैयक्तिक शेतकरी, शेतकरी गट, महिला बचत गट, शेतकरी उत्पादक कंपनी, सहकारी संस्था इ.  

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**?

तुम्हाला त्वरित ठिबक/तुषार सिंचन, पंपसेट, कीटकनाशक फवारणी यंत्र किंवा बगीचा लागवड यापैकी नेमकी कोणती गरज आहे??

## 1. Scheme Information

*Id*:
65

*Scheme Code*:
mahadbt-baksy

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
Maha-DBT

*Scheme Name*:
Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar Krushi Swavalamban Yojana (BAKSY)

*Main Component*:
Providing Irrigation Fscilities to the eligible beneficiaries of Scheduled Cast (SC) category

*Sub Component*:
1. New Irrigation Well
2. Old Well Repair
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds
4. Inwell Boring
5. Electricity Connection
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)
7. Solar pump (instead of electrical connection Charges and pump set)
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)
9. Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) AND
     Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements)
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden

*Introduction*:
The Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan (Special Component Scheme(scp)) was being implemented from the year 1982-83 to increase the income of Scheduled Caste / New-Buddhist farmers and improve their standard of living. Since the said scheme has been implemented for a long period of time, the GOVERNMENT OF MAHARASHTRA has decided to implement the Special Component Scheme for Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist farmers since 1982-83 and the recommendations of the Agriculture Commissionerate dated 27/04/2016 on the report dated 19/04/2016 and special component scheme the announced by the Hon'ble Minister (Finance). Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana is not being implemented separately, but the current special component scheme, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana, is being implemented from 2016-17 as per the changed criteria, taking into account the needs of the changed situation and maintaining soil moisture.
Also, the government has approved the amendment in the financial criteria and inclusion of new components under the said scheme as per the government decision dated 01 October, 2024.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    beneficiary Selection criteria are as follows
1.  Scheme is only for Scheduled Caste/ Nav Baudha farmers.
2.  Scheme is implemented in all districts of Maharashtra (Except Mumbai districts).
3. At field level  scheme is under Implementation by department of Agriculture, Zilha Parishad.
4. Funds are released from Social Justice Department to concerned  District Collector and then made available to concern Zilha Parishad.
5. Application ,Selection of beneficiaries upto payment of subsidy all process are done through MAHADBT Portal through online system.                                                                  "

*Benefits*:
Benefit provided on subsidy basis as per the norms of components, through online system. The said scheme shall be implemented in the financial year 2025-26 as follows. In the said scheme, grants shall be admissible for the following components in the year 2025-26 up to the maximum limit of the amount mentioned below.
1. For New Irrigation- Well Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Rs.4,00,000/ - is admissible.
2. For Old Well Repair - Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 1,00,000/- is admissible
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds-Grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the amount calculated as per the prevailing financial parameters of the National Horticulture Mission Guideline and the size of the farm pond or actual cost or Rs. 2,00,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
4.Inwell Boring- Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 40,000/- is admissible
5. Electricity Connection-Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Amount 20,000/- or actual paid amount whichever is less is admissible.
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)(Diesel Engine - New Item) For pump sets up to 10 HP capacity, grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial parameters or actual cost or Rs. 40,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
7. Grant Solar pump (instead of electrical connection and pump set)- Maximum subsidy will be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial criteria or actual expenditure incurred or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)- Under the Food and Nutrition Security Scheme - Food Crops Scheme, subsidy of 100% of the prevailing economic standard or actual cost incurred per meter or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less will be admissible.
9.1 For Micro irrigation system Under Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) 9.1.1) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and9.1.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 47,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy. (Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
9.2 For Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant 9.2.1 ) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and 9.2.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 97,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy.(Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements) (New item)maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden (New Item) maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible .

*Eligibility*:
1. Scheme is only for Scheduled Tribe farmers. Caste  certificate is essential.
2. Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to  6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential)
3.1 It will be mandatory for the beneficiary to be a farmer belonging to the Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist category.
3.2 The farmer must have a caste certificate issued by the competent authority.
3.3 Farmers residing the Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika is necessary to have 7/12 certificate and 8A extract of land tenure in the name of the farmer. ( Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika area (Reference Government Letter No. Sankirna- 2017/Pr.No.142/3A, dated 24 April 2018))
3.4 The beneficiaries must have their own Aadhaar link active bank account .
3.5 The beneficiaries below the poverty line will be given  first priority.
3.6 The beneficiary farmer must have a minimum of 0.40 hectares and a maximum of 6 hectares of agricultural land. If the beneficiary's land is in a remote and fragmented area and two or more beneficiaries with less than 0.40 hectares of land come together and their combined land is at least 0.40 hectares, then if they sign an agreement, they will be eligible for the benefit of the scheme. Similarly, the condition of maximum 6.0 hectares of land will not be applicable to the beneficiaries below the poverty line.
3.7 Once the full benefit of the relevant scheme is taken, the benefit of this scheme will not be payable to the same beneficiary or family for the next five years. The beneficiary who has taken the benefit of the new well component will be eligible for the benefit of the old well repair component after 20 years.
If the benefit has been given under the Special Component Scheme for similar agricultural development schemes and the scheme implemented from the funds made available under the SCA of the Central Government and Article 275 (A) of the Constitution, the benefit provided under this scheme will not be admissible.

*Required Documents*:
1. Caste Certificate of SC category issued by compitant authority
2. current 7/12 report having Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to 6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential) within the period of
3 months 3.GSDA Certificates
4. There is no income limit for this scheme

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on Mahadbt portal as follows
1. Applications from farmers are being invited for the said scheme on the Maha-DBT portal website mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/farmer/login /login and the applications received within the limit of lakhs received by the concerned talukas / blocks will be selected online on a first come, first served basis (fcfs). After selection, all the proceedings up to the payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done online. In this regard, proceedings from acceptance of application to payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done as mentioned in the referenced government decision dated 04/11/2020.
2. The Agricultural Officer (Agriculture), P.S., should conduct a site inspection of the area of the beneficiary selected for the new well and old well repair on a first come, first served basis and check the technical feasibility. After the inspection, if the location of the beneficiary's new well and the proposal for repair of the old well of the beneficiary is technically suitable, the Agricultural Development Officer should approve the budget for this matter and give prior approval to the proposals of the concerned beneficiary within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents. Similarly, the selection of the beneficiaries whose proposals are found to be technically unsuitable during the site inspection should be cancelled.
3. Beneficiaries selected for other matters other than new well and old well repair under the scheme should be given prior approval within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents and they should be given the benefit of the scheme in the current financial year 2025-26 itself.
4. The prior approval of the beneficiaries who do not implement the matters under the scheme within the prescribed period should be cancelled.
5. While selecting individual beneficiary, priority will be given to women and disabled beneficiaries. Out of the total sanctioned funds, 5 percent of the funds should be given priority to be spent on disabled beneficiaries and 30 percent of the funds should be spent on women beneficiaries.
6. As per the demand of the final selected beneficiaries as per the target of the taluka & district, a draft plan of the district should be prepared within 7 days as per Appendix No. 1, component-wise and beneficiary-wise. The responsibility of preparing the draft plan will be the responsibility of the Agricultural Development Officer.

question: Me PDMC yojana la eligible ahe ka?
answer:
**पीएम-आरकेव्ही-पर ड्रॉप मोअर क्रॉप (पी.डी.एम.सी.)** ही केंद्र योजना आहे; तुमच्या प्रोफाइलनुसार तुम्हाला पात्रतेची अट पूर्ण होते का हे खालील मुद्द्यांवर अवलंबून आहे?

**पात्रता:**
- सप्तक व आठ-अ उतारा धारक शेतकरी असणे आवश्यक आहे
- सिंचनाचा स्रोत (विहीर/बोर/कालवा) असणे आवश्यक आहे

**लाभ:**
- ठिबक किंवा तुषार मायक्रो सिंचन संच बसवण्यासाठी अनुदान दिले जाते; लहान व अल्पभूधारकांसाठी ५५% आणि इतर शेतकऱ्यांसाठी ४५% पर्यंत (कमाल ५ हेक्टर क्षेत्रापर्यंत) अशी मदत नमूद आहे
- अनुदान थेट बँक खात्यात महाडीबीटी द्वारे जमा केले जाते

**नोंद:**
- तुमचे गाव पोक्रा नियुक्त नाही, त्यामुळे या योजनेबाबत कोणतीही पोक्रा-विशेष अट लागू होत नाही

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**?

तुमच्याकडे सप्तक/आठ-अ उतारा आणि सिंचनाचा स्रोत उपलब्ध आहे का??

*Introduction*:
Per Drop More Crop (PDMC) is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme implemented by the Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare (DA&FW) to promote micro irrigation. *Benefits*:
Subsidy for Installation of Micro Irrigation Sets (Drip & Sprinkler). Norms of Assistance for Drip & Sprinkler varies according to area & Spacing. question: सोयाबीनसाठी बीजप्रक्रिया कशी करावी?
answer:
सोयाबीनचे बियाणे पेरणीपूर्वी प्रथम बुरशीनाशकाने आणि मग जीवाणू संस्कृतीने (ब्रॅडीरायझोबियम व पी.एस.बी.) प्रक्रिया करून, सावलीत वाळवून पेरणी करावी?

**बीजप्रक्रिया:**
- १ किग्रा बियाण्यासाठी ४ ग्रॅम थायरम किंवा ३ ग्रॅम बेविस्टिन, किंवा २ ग्रॅम बेविस्टिन + ३ ग्रॅम थायरम अशी मात्रा घ्या
- सर्व बियाणे एकसारखी कुटवून या बुरशीनाशकाचा लेप लावा
- नंतर प्रत्येक १० किग्रा बियाण्यावर १०० मि.ली. ब्रॅडीरायझोबियम आणि १०० मि.ली. स्फुरद विरघळविणारे जिवाणू (पी.एस.बी.) हा कल्चर लावा
- बीजप्रक्रिया झालेले बियाणे सावलीत कोरडे करा आणि २४ तासांच्या आत पेरणी करा

**लक्ष द्यायची मुद्दे:**
- बुरशीनाशक ओलावे लागल्याशिवाय थेट पावडर टाकून कुटवा, म्हणजे झाक नीट बसेल
- जीवाणू कल्चर थंड गूळपाणी (१ ली. उष्ण पाण्यात १२५ ग्रॅम गूळ; थंड झाल्यावर २०० ते २५० ग्रॅम कल्चर) मधून तयार केला तर लेप चांगला बसतो
- जीवाणू कल्चरची संपूर्ण माहिती दाबून, कीटकनाशके/बुरशीनाशके/रासायनिक खते वेगळी ठेवा आणि समाप्तीच्या तारखेतूनच वापरा

**स्रोत: कृषी दस्तऐवज (के. वि. एन.एम.ए.यू.; डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ)**

question: उसातील 'केवडा' (लोह कमतरता) कसा सुधारावा?
answer:
उसातील पिवळसर–पांढरट होणारे वरची पाने ही लोहाची कमतरता (केवडा) असल्याचे अस्पष्टपणे दिसत असल्यास खालीलप्रमाणे सुधारणा करा.

**लक्षणे:**
- उसाची वरची पाने प्रथम पिवळी, नंतर पांढरट होतात आणि पीक निस्तेज दिसते (हे लोह कमतरतेमुळे दिसते).

**माती/लागवड:**
- चुनखडी प्रकारच्या जमिनीत ऊस लागवड टाळावी.

**खत व्यवस्थापन:**
- लागवडीपूर्वी शेणखत/कंपोस्टमध्ये मिसळून प्रति हेक्टर १० किग्रा हिरवे विट्रियोल शेततळ्यात देण्याची शिफारस आहे.
- हिरवळीची खतपिके घ्यावीत आणि गंधकयुक्त खते वापरावीत.

**फवारणी (फुटवे अवस्थेत):**
- फुटवे अवस्थेत लोह कमतरतेची लक्षणे दुरुस्त करण्यासाठी ड्रोनद्वारे २.५% द्रावण २५ लि./हे. योजून फवारणीची शिफारस आहे.
- लक्षण पुन्हा आल्यास ३० दिवसांच्या अंतराने एक पानांची फवारणी पुन्हा करायची शिफारस आहे.

**स्रोत: डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ; आयसीएआर वार्षिक अहवाल २०२३–२४?**

question: भुईमुगावरील टिक्का रोगासाठी प्रतिबंधात्मक उपाय काय आहेत?
answer:
भुईमुगावरील टिक्का रोगाचा (पानावरील ठिपके) प्रादुर्भाव कमी करण्यासाठी प्रतिबंधात्मक उपाय म्हणून आधी बियाणे प्रक्रिया आणि सेंद्रिय/जैविक फवारणी करणे उपयोगी पडते.

**बियाणे प्रक्रिया:**
- पेरणीपूर्वी बियाण्यावर थायरम किंवा कॅप्टन २.५ ग्रॅम प्रति १ किग्रा बियाणे अशी प्रक्रिया करा.

**प्रतिबंधात्मक फवारणी (सेंद्रिय/जैविक):**
- गोक्रुपा अमृत २ ली. आणि वृद्ध मटकी दूध ३ ली. हे १५ ली. पंपात मिसळून फवारणी करा; किंवा गोक्रुपा अमृत ३ ली. आणि देशी गायचे कच्चे दूध २०० मि.ली. हे पाण्याने भरून फवारणी करा.
- भुईमुगात बुरशीजन्य रोगांपासून संरक्षणासाठी ट्रायकोडर्मा विरिडे या जैविक कीटकनाशकाचा वापर दस्तऐवजात नमूद आहे.

**लागवडीची पद्धत बदल (टीप):**
- दस्तऐवजात भुईमुगाची पेरणी १५ नोव्हेंबर ते १५ डिसेंबर दरम्यान केल्यास करपा रोग टाळता येतो असेही दिलेले आहे.

**स्रोत: डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ; कृषी दर्शनी (डॉ. बी.एस.के.के.व्ही., दापोली २०२५)**

तुम्हाला ही प्रतिबंधात्मक फवारणी नेमकी कोणत्या अवस्थेत (उदा. पाने पूर्ण उगवल्यावर/हंगामाच्या सुरुवातीस) करायची आहे??

- **Tikka Disease [रोग]:** This disease [रोग] affects groundnut [भुईमुग]. Spots appear on the leaves, which are tan in color. If numerous spots appear, the leaves dry [कोरडे] up and fall off, leading to a decrease in yield [उत्पादन]. This disease [रोग] is also known as Early Leaf Spot [पानांवरील ठिपके] and Late Leaf Spot [पानांवरील ठिपके].
- **Fruit Drop [फळ गळणे]:** This disease [रोग] is mainly caused by the _Phytophthora_ fungus. The fruits of fruit trees like areca nut, sapota [चिक्कू] (chikoo), etc., fall off prematurely. A whitish fungal growth [वाढ] is visible on the stalk end of such fruits. This fungus resides in the soil [माती], enters through the roots of the tree, grows up to the flowers, and when fruits are forming, it grows in the stalk, causing the fruits to fall off. This disease [रोग] thrives in warm and humid weather [वातावरण].

## **Uses of Neem [कडूलिंब]**

Leaves

Neem [कडूलिंब] leaves are bitter and cooling. The juice of the leaves is drunk or the leaves are eaten to reduce the heat in the body. Neem [कडूलिंब] decoction has been found to be effective for diseases like eczema, swelling [सूज], ulcers, fever [ताप], intestinal fungus, etc. The leaves are crushed and bandaged on the wound [जखम] for quick [नखाचा रक्तवाहिनी असलेला भाग] healing of wounds. Leaves are used to preserve grains [धान्ये] for a long time. Apart from this, Neem [कडूलिंब] leaves are used as fodder [चारा] for animals during drought [दुष्काळ] and famine.

The naturally occurring leaf fall of Neem [कडूलिंब] increases organic matter [सेंद्रिय पदार्थ] in the soil [माती]. Some insects in the soil [माती] are destroyed in the pupal stage. It has been found that Neem [कडूलिंब] leaves act as systemic insecticide [आंतरप्रवाही कीटकनाशक] when mixed in the soil [माती]. In this way, crops like sugarcane [ऊस], wheat [गहू], rice [बासमती तांदूळ], baldy, tomato [टोमॅटो], chrysanthemum [शेवंती] etc. are protected from leaf and stem insects for two to two and a half months. A technique to control Tikka and rust [गंज रोग] streaks on groundnut [भुईमुग] in a very simple and domestic and cost-free way has been developed by the National Groundnut [भुईमुग] Research Centre, Junagadh. Leaf powder is used like toothpaste. Burning Neem [कडूलिंब] leaves in the house repels mosquitoes from the house.

question: पिकांच्या लागवडीसाठी शेतकरी मशीनरीसाठी कोणत्या अनुदान योजना उपलब्ध आहेत?
answer:
लागवड व इतर शेती कामांसाठी शेततंत्र (शेतकरी मशीनरी) घेण्यास अनुदान देणाऱ्या खालील योजना उपलब्ध आहेत?

**रक्कम:**
- **₹५,००,०००** पर्यंत (किसान ड्रोनसाठी, कृषी पदवीधारकांना)
- **₹४,००,०००** पर्यंत (किसान ड्रोनसाठी, इतर लाभार्थ्यांना)

**राज्य योजना:**
**राज्य प्रायोजित कृषी यांत्रिकीकरण**  
ही राज्य योजना आहे जी ट्रॅक्टर, पॉवर टिलर, स्वयंचलित यंत्रे, ट्रॅक्टरचलित अवजारे, पीक संरक्षण अवजारे आणि काढणीनंतरची प्राथमिक प्रक्रिया अवजारे यासाठी आर्थिक सहाय्य देते.  

**पात्रता:**
- वैयक्तिक शेतकरी (यांत्रिकीकरण/अवजार खरेदीसाठी)
- वैयक्तिक लाभार्थी, शेतकरी गट, महिला बचतगट, शेतकरी उत्पादक कंपनी, शेतकरी सहकारी संस्था, प्राथमिक कृषी सहकारी पतसंस्था (कस्टम हायरिंग सेंटरसाठी)  

**लाभ:**
- सामान्यपणे अनुसूचित जाती, अनुसूचित जमाती, लघु शेतकरी, महिला यांना ४०% आणि इतर शेतकऱ्यांना ५०% (खर्चाच्या किंवा केंद्र सरकारने जाहीर केलेल्या कमाल मर्यादेपैकी जो कमी असेल त्याप्रमाणे)
- कस्टम हायरिंग सेंटर (फार्म मशीनरी बँक) उभारणीसाठी भांडवली खर्चाचे ४०%
- किसान ड्रोनसाठी: कृषी पदवीधारकांना ५०% किंवा कमाल **₹५,००,०००**; इतर लाभार्थ्यांना ४०% किंवा कमाल **₹४,००,०००**

**केंद्र योजना:**
**उप-मिशन ऑन अ‍ॅग्रिकल्चर मेकनाइझेशन**  
ही केंद्र योजना आहे जी वरील प्रकारच्या शेततंत्र/अवजारांसाठी आर्थिक सहाय्य देते आणि कस्टम हायरिंग सेंटर उभारणीसाठी ४०% (भांडवली खर्चाचे) तसेच किसान ड्रोनसाठी वरीलच कमाल रक्कमेपर्यंत सहाय्य देते.  

**आवश्यक कागदपत्रे:**
- खरेदी करण्याच्या अवजाराचा कोटेशन
- अवजाराचा चाचणी अहवाल
- ट्रॅक्टरचलित अवजार असल्यास ट्रॅक्टरचा आर.सी.
- गट/कंपनी असल्यास नोंदणी प्रमाणपत्र  

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

तुम्हाला ट्रॅक्टरचलित अवजार हवे आहेत की कस्टम हायरिंग सेंटर/किसान ड्रोनसाठी अनुदान पाहायचे आहे??

## 1. Scheme Information

*Id*:
61

*Scheme Code*:
sdda-farm-machinery-and-equipments

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
DDA MECHANIZATION

*Scheme Name*:
State Sponsored Agriculture Mechanization

*Main Component*:
Benefit for Farm Machinery and Equipments.

*Sub Component*:
Tractors, power tillers, automated machinery, tractor-operated implements, tractor-operated crop protection implements, and post-harvest primary processing implements.

*Introduction*:
The declining number of livestock and the shortage of labor for agricultural work necessitate mechanization in agriculture. Mechanization allows work to be completed within a specified time frame, saves inputs, and saves production costs.
Objective:-
        Resolve labour issues in agriculture.
        Promote Farm Mechanization.
        Enable farmers to take up farm operations in time.
        Promote custom hiring services for farm mechanization.
        Create rural employment.
        Help to Increase agriculture production.

*Benefits*:
1. Financial assistance to farmers for procurement of farm machinery and implements
2. Generally, the subsidy is given at a rate of 40 % for SC, ST & small farmers, Womens & 50% for other farmers percent of the cost or the maximum subsidy limit declared by the Central Government, whichever is lower.

*Eligibility*:
Individual Farmer.

*Required Documents*:
1. Quotation of Implement to be purchase.
2. Test report of the Implement.
3. RC of tractor for tractor driven implements.

*Application Process*:
Applications from Interested farmers are invited on https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/ this portal. For transparency in beneficiary selection, presanction is being given by determining seniority through FCFS method. All the processes from beneficiary selection to grant payment are being implemented online.
After presanction, farmers are being allowed to purchase from the open market as per their choice. At the time of purchase, farmers are required to make payment through cheque/DD/online from their own bank account. The subsidy amount is being transferred to the Aadhaar-linked bank account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) method.

*Required Documents*:

At the time of purchase, farmers are required to make payment through cheque/DD/online from their own bank account. The subsidy amount is being transferred to the Aadhaar-linked bank account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) method.

question: द्राक्ष बागेतील केवडा (Downy Mildew) रोग कसा ओळखावा?
answer:
द्राक्ष बागेत डाऊनी मिल्ड्यूचा प्रादुर्भाव असल्यास पानांवर डाग काळपट होणे, आणि पुढे फळांच्या गुणवत्तेमध्ये गंभीर घट येणे ही लक्षणे दिसतात.

**लक्षणे:**
- पानांवर आधी छोटे डाग दिसून ते हळूहळू काळपट होतात  
- डागांची वाढ झाल्यास ते लांबट व थोडे राऊंडचे (दांडले) स्वरूप धारण करतात; पूर्ण वाढलेल्या स्थितीत डागाच्या मधला भाग काळपट थांबतो आणि चोकासारखा/कर्पा सरखा दिसू शकतो  
- डाग जास्त झाल्यास रोगट पाने कुजून फांद्यावरून नीच लटकतात  
- रोगाचा प्रादुर्भाव ठळक झाल्यास साधारण दिशेने फळांच्या दर्जात/गुणवत्तेत खारी अंतर्वर १ किंवा शेंड्यावरील टुकड्या भरून उतरल्याची कमतरता भासू शकते  

**स्रोत: कृषी विद्यापीठ पीक सल्ला (एन. एम. ढाके येस्टक्युल्चर आपअलेट लार्ग क्रॉप्स व्हाईटी मॉन्टेरे इंटरशल पर्शियन मॉलिस्कुड)**  

तुमच्या बागेत हे डाग मुख्यतः नवीन पानांवर आहेत की जुन्या पानांवर अधिक दिसत आहेत? ?

**Soluble Fertilizers:** The nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] supplied to the crop [पीक] from the chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते] applied through the soil [माती] are not fully available to the crop [पीक]. If the moisture in the soil [माती] is too high or too low, the nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] supplied from such fertilizers are not available to the crop [पीक]. In such adverse conditions, the stress of water and nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] on the crops has an adverse effect on crop nutrition [पीक पोषण] and growth [वाढ]. Apart from this, this availability also depends on soil [माती] properties such as soil temperature [मृद तापमान], pH, lime [चुना] content, organic carbon [सेंद्रिय कार्बन], etc. The amount of nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] that the crop [पीक] receives from the total nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] in the fertilizers we apply through the soil [माती] is called the efficiency of the fertilizers or nutrients [पोषक तत्वे]. In changing climatic conditions, especially in rainfed conditions, if there is prolonged heavy rainfall or drought [दुष्काळ], deficiency symptoms [लक्षणे] of nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] start appearing on the crop [पीक] through fertilizers applied from the soil [माती]. The growth [वाढ] of the crop [पीक] stops in a specific way and the yield [उत्पादन] decreases. In such a situation, fertilizers cannot be given from the soil [माती] and even if they are given, there is a possibility that they will not benefit the crop [पीक].

Soluble fertilizers are available in solid as well as liquid form. Solid fertilizers are 100% easily soluble in water and a solution suitable for use is prepared by mixing the required amount in water. If symptoms [लक्षणे] of nutrient deficiency [पोषण कमतरता] appear in the crops according to the growth [वाढ] stage of the crops or if the relevant soluble fertilizers are sprayed as per the recommendation as per the requirement, these fertilizers become available to the crops quickly and work effectively. **MPKV Krishi Darshani**
```
**Intercropping [आंतरपीक]:** In the intercropping system [आंतरपीक पद्धत], good increase in yield [उत्पादन] is obtained by sowing [पेरणी] sunflower [सुर्यफुल] + tur (2:1 or 2:2) and groundnut [भुईमुग] + sunflower [सुर्यफुल] (6:2 or 3:1) in rows.

**Chemical Fertilizers [रासायनिक खते]:** For rainfed crop [पीक], apply 1 ton of farmyard manure [शेणखत] and 20 kg Nitrogen [नत्र], 10 kg Phosphorus [स्फुरद] and 10 kg Potash per acre at the time of sowing [पेरणी] with a two-row seed drill [बियाणे पेरणी यंत्र]. For irrigated crop [पीक], apply 24 kg Nitrogen [नत्र] + 24 kg Phosphorus [स्फुरद] + 24 kg Potash per acre. Out of this, apply 12 kg Nitrogen [नत्र] and all Phosphorus [स्फुरद] and Potash at the time of sowing [पेरणी] and apply the remaining 12 kg Nitrogen [नत्र] within one month after sowing [पेरणी]. For soils deficient in sulphur [गंधक], apply 08 kg sulphur [गंधक] per acre mixed with earthworm compost [गांडूळ खत] at the time of sowing [पेरणी].

**Interculturing:** After sowing [पेरणी], thin the plants to maintain a distance of 30 cm between two plants after 15 to 20 days. Do one hand weeding [निंदन] and two hoeings after sowing [पेरणी]. The first hoeing [डवरणे] should be done 20 days after sowing [पेरणी] and the second hoeing [डवरणे] should be done 35 to 40 days after sowing [पेरणी].

**Water Management [पाण्याचे व्यवस्थापन]:** It is very important to irrigate the sunflower [सुर्यफुल] crop [पीक] during sensitive stages. Sensitive stages of sunflower [सुर्यफुल]:

1. Seedling stage [रोपट्याची अवस्था] 2. Bud formation stage 3. Flowering stage 4. Grain filling [दाणे भरणे] stage. Water stress [पाण्याचा ताण] should not be allowed during these sensitive stages. If there is water stress [पाण्याचा ताण] from the bud formation stage to the grain filling [दाणे भरणे] stage, the grains [धान्ये] remain hollow and the production [उत्पादन] decreases.

**Crop Protection [पीक संरक्षण]:** Viral disease [विषाणूजन्य रोग] is transmitted through sap sucking thrips [फुलकिडे]. To control them, spray Imidacloprid 17.8% S.L. at 1 ml / 10 liters of water. To control hairy caterpillars, collect the egg masses of the larvae and destroy them by putting them in kerosene mixed water.

**Harvesting [कापणी]:** Harvest [कापणी] the sunflower [सुर्यफुल] crop [पीक] after the leaves, stems and back side of the flower turn yellow. Thresh the cobs after drying [वाळवणे] them well.
```

**Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth**
```
**5) Tomato [टोमॅटो]**

**Soil [माती]:** Select medium to heavy soil [माती], but well drained.

**Planting Time:** (1) May-June, (2) September-October, (3) January-February

**Planting Method:** Prepare seedlings on raised beds [उंच केलेले वाफे] or in pro trays and transplant 4-6 week old seedlings.

**Seed Rate [बियाण्याची प्रमाण]:** 500 to 600 grams (improved varieties), 150 grams (hybrid varieties)

**Soil [माती] Preparation:** After doing crosswise plowing of the field [शेत], break the clods and harrow [वखर] it. Spread well-rotten farm yard manure [खत] at the rate of 30-40 cartloads per hectare in the soil [माती] and give a harrowing [वखरणी].

**Improved Varieties:** Bhagyalakshmi, Dhanalakshmi, Rajashree, Phule Raja (hybrid), Pusa Ruby, Roma, S-120, Pusa Alar Dorff, Pusa Gaurav, Arka Sourav, Vasundhara.

**Planting:** Transplant seedlings at 60 X 60 cm or 75 X 60 cm or 90 X 30 cm spacing [अंतर] on ridge and furrow [सरी व वरंबा] beds.

**Fertilizers:** Apply 75 to 100 kg of nitrogen [नत्र] plus 60 kg of phosphorus [स्फुरद] plus 50 kg of potash per hectare. Of this, apply half of the nitrogen [नत्र] plus full phosphorus [स्फुरद] and potash at the time of transplanting [पुनर्लागवड] and the remaining half of the nitrogen [नत्र] 30 days after transplanting [पुनर्लागवड]. For hybrid varieties, the dose [मात्रा] is 300 kg nitrogen [नत्र], 150 kg phosphorus [स्फुरद] and 150 kg potash.

**Irrigation [सिंचन]:** Give water every 10-12 days as per crop [पीक] requirement. In summer, give water every 4-5 days. This period should be reduced or increased according to the soil texture [जमीनीचा पोत].

**Interculture:** Give 2-3 weedings to keep the crop [पीक] clean. Also give 1-2 hoeings to loosen the soil [माती] and give a soil [माती] cap to the trees. Also give bamboo [बांबू] support to the necessary trees. (Use the trellis method according to the type of variety).

**Crop Duration [पीक कालावधी]:** Tomato [टोमॅटो] crop [पीक] comes to flowering 50-60 days after sowing [पेरणी] and is ready for first harvest [कापणी] in 60-80 days. The duration of this crop [पीक] is 160-180 days. This period may vary depending on the variety.
```

**MPKV Krishi Darshani**
```
**Thinning [विरळणी करणे] and Gap Filling [खाडे भरुन काढणे]**

Fill the gaps after 7 to 8 days of cotton [कापूस] planting. For this, the seeds to be used should be soaked in wet gunny sack for 6 to 8 hours so that germination [अंकुरण] takes place quickly. The thinning [विरळणी करणे] work should be completed within three weeks after sowing [पेरणी]. In dibbled cotton [कापूस], thinning [विरळणी करणे] should be done by keeping only one vigorous plant on each bud.

**Interculture**

Interculture is very important for retaining soil [माती] and moisture in the cotton [कापूस] crop [पीक], for keeping the air circulating in the soil [माती] and for getting plenty of oxygen required by the roots and for weed control [तण नियंत्रण]. For this purpose, keep the field [शेत] weed free by doing 3 to 4 hoeing [डवरणे] passes, 2 to 3 times of weeding [तण काढणे] after 3 to 4 weeks of sowing [पेरणी]. Also, for chemical weed control [तण नियंत्रण], Diuron (Hexyuron) this weedicide [तणनाशक] 1 kg active ingredient or Pendimethalin (Stomp) or Fluchloralin (Basalin) 300 to 400 g active ingredient should be mixed in 500 liters of water per acre and sprayed evenly on the soil [माती].

**Water Management [पाण्याचे व्यवस्थापन]**

Since there is water stress [पाण्याचा ताण] in the months of August and September, it is necessary to give protective irrigation [संरक्षक सिंचन] at the important growth [वाढ] stages of the cotton [कापूस] crop [पीक]. For this, if there is water availability in rainfed cotton [कापूस], protective irrigation [संरक्षक सिंचन] should be given at the important growth [वाढ] stages as follows.

1. Square setting stage (35-40 days after sowing [पेरणी])
2. Flowering (60 days after sowing [पेरणी])
3. Boll setting and maturity stage (90 to 100 days after sowing [पेरणी])
4. Indigenous Cotton [कापूस] Variety: Phule Dhanwantari (R.H.A.R.B.-02-1)

**Nursery [रोपवाटिका]**

Generally, 400-500 grams of tomato [टोमॅटो] seeds are sufficient for straight varieties and 125 grams for hybrid varieties per hectare. To prepare a nursery [रोपवाटिका], prepare raised beds [उंच केलेले वाफे] of 3 meters long, 1 meter wide and 15 cm high. Thoroughly loosen the bed and remove stones, clods and debris. Mix one basket of well-rotted farmyard manure [शेणखत] and 100-150 grams of Suphala in each bed and level the bed. Make lines parallel to the width of the bed at intervals of four fingers. The lines should not be too deep. Sow [मादी डुक्कर] the seeds thinly in such lines and cover the seeds with soil [माती] with light [प्रकाश] hands. Water the beds with a sprinkler [तुषार सिंचन] until the seeds germinate. After that, water the beds by flooding. Tomato [टोमॅटो] seedlings are ready for planting in 3 to 5 weeks depending on the season. Gradually reduce watering 4 to 5 days before planting and water the beds well the day before planting.

1. After sowing [पेरणी] the seeds, cover the raised beds [उंच केलेले वाफे] with 60-100 mesh nylon net or white thin cloth like a mosquito net up to 2 meters high. This will control the pests that spread the disease [रोग].
2. To control sap-sucking pests, after germination [अंकुरण], apply Carbofuran [कार्बोफ्युरान] 3% CG 25 to 30 grams per 10 sq. m. between two rows on the raised beds [उंच केलेले वाफे] and water lightly.
3. To control diseases/pests in the nursery [रोपवाटिका], spray Mancozeb 75% WP or Captan 50% WP 20 grams plus Dimethoate 30 EC 10 ml per 10 liters of water alternately 2-3 times at intervals of 10 days after germination [अंकुरण].
4. Seedling [रोप] treatment [उपचार]: Before transplanting [पुनर्लागवड], mix Imidacloprid 17.8% SL 3 ml plus Mancozeb 20 grams per 10 liters of water and dip the roots of the seedlings in this solution for 10-15 minutes.

**पद्धत:**
- कोणतीही साठवण सुविधा नेगोशिएबल वॅरेहाउस रसीद प्रणालीचा वापर करण्यापूर्वी वॅरेहाउसिंग डेव्हलपमेंट अँड रेग्युलेटरी अथॉरिटी (व्ही.डी.आर.ए.) चे दिलेली निकष पूर्ण करावी लागते आणि ती गोदाम नोंदणी/प्रमाणित झाल्यावरच या व्यवस्थेचा लाभ घेता येतो.
- तसेच कोणत्या दस्तऐवजात असे स्पष्ट नाही की कुठली गोदाम नोंदणी/प्रमाणित आहेत किंवा सर्वात आधी कुठल्या शासन अधिकाऱ्याकडे / संस्थेत संपूर्ण सत्यापन करायचे; त्यामुळे तुम्ही खरेदी करतांना गोदाम मॅनेजरकडून ही नोंदणी/प्रमाणपत्राची पुष्टी करूनच साठवण करा.

question: नवीन पद्धतीमुळे उत्पादन वाढते का हे प्रत्यक्ष कसे समजते?
answer:
नवीन पद्धतीमुळे उत्पादन वाढते का हे प्रत्यक्ष समजण्यासाठी तुमच्या शेतजमिनीवर नियोजित चाचणी करून परिणाम मोजणे हा सर्वात खात्रीशीर मार्ग आहे; अशा शेतजमिनीवरील चाचण्यांमध्ये किमान दोन-एकूण दोन वर्षे शेतकऱ्यांच्या शेतात असल्याचे दस्तऐवजांत नमूद आहे.

**असे कसं साधे आणि प्रत्यक्षात समजेल:**
- तुमच्या जमिनीत थोडं वेगळं भागात नवीन पद्धत, आणि बाकी भागात जुनी पद्धत पाळून दोन्ही भागांची लागवड/खत/विधान नेमकी ठेवा.
- पीक घेताना दोन्ही भागातील उत्पादन नक्की मोजा (प्रति एकर किंवा प्रति हेक्टर) व खर्च वेगळा लिहा.
- पहिला हंगाम आणि दुसरा हंगाम असा सलग कालावधी झाल्यास फरक अधिक स्पष्ट येतो; काही चाचण्यांचे माहिती अनुशंसने प्रमाण ५–१०% धान्य उत्पादन वाढ अशी सुद्धा दिली आहे.

**स्थानिक मदत:** अशा तंत्रज्ञान परिक्षणासाठी केव्हीके केंद्रांमार्फत शेतकऱ्यांच्या शेतांत आलींदाचा मूल्यांकन, एकूण उत्पादन, जात/पोषण/कीड रोग व्यवस्थापन यांसारख्या विषयांवर चाचण्या लuate करण्याचा उल्लेख आहे.

**स्रोत: आय.सी.ए.आर. वार्षिक अहवाल २०२३-२४; जैवखते सर्व्हद्यात्मक पीक उत्पादनासाठी (आई.सी.ए.आर.)**?

question: पालघरमध्ये पॉवर वीडर भाड्याने देणारी काही सेवा केंद्रे आहेत का?
answer:

question: टोमॅटोमधील फळ पोखरणाऱ्या अळीचे नियंत्रण कसे करावे?
answer:
टोमॅटोमधील फळ पोखरणाऱ्या अळीवर नियंत्रणासाठी सुरुवातीस शेतातून मायडेड फळे व मोठ्या अळ्या गोळा करून नष्ट करा, आणि त्यानंतर स्रोत-उद्धृत मात्रेनुसार कीटकनाशकाची फवारणी करा?

**पीक:** टोमॅटो  
**कीड:** फळ पोखरणारी अळी  

**आर्थिक उपाय (लगेच):**  
- अळ्यांनी खातले/छिद्र केलेली फळे व मोठ्या अळ्या गोळा करून नष्ट करा  

**फवारणी (मात्रा):**  
- सायन्ट्रानिलिप्रोल १०.२६% ओ.डी. १८ मि./१० ली. पाणी (टोमॅटोतील फळ पोखरणारी अळीसाठी)  
- इंडॉक्साकार्ब १४.५ एस.सी. (टोमॅटोतील फळ पोखरणारी अळीसाठी) — मात्रा या दस्तऐवजात दिलेली नाही, पॅकेटवरील शिफारस प्रमाणे घ्या  
- ॲएमएनबीटी कृषी दर्शनी यादीत खालील कंपनधाने कापही दिले आहेत, मात्र टोमॅटो फळ पोखरणारी अळीमध्ये मात्रा या दस्तऐवजात दिलेली नाही: लेम्बडा सायहॅलोथ्रिन ५% ई.सी., थायोडिकार्ब ७५ डब्ल्यू.पी., सायपरमेथ्रिन २५ ई.सी.?

**स्रोत: डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ; एम.पी.के.व्ही. कृषी दर्शनी; वेंगुर्दा माजी कृषी विद्यापीठ परभणी**  

तुमच्या टोमॅटोला सध्या फळे लागल्याचं आहे का, की आणखी फुलोरा चालू आहे?
