**The larvae cause damage to the crop [पीक] by feeding [खाऊ घालणे] on leaves. Newly hatched larvae feed on the green layer [अंडी देणारी कोंबडी] of the leaves, causing white spots to appear on the leaves. Second and third instar larvae make holes in the leaves and feed on the edges of the leaves. These larvae remain inside the whorl of maize [मका] plants and make holes in the leaves. As a result, uniform holes appear in a line on the emerging leaves. Older leaves become largely chlorotic, leaving only the veins and the main stem of the plant intact. The plant appears tattered. The early whorl stage is less susceptible to infestation, the medium whorl stage is more susceptible, and the late whorl stage is the most susceptible to the larvae. Sometimes, the larvae bore into the ear from the side and feed on the grains [धान्ये].**

6. **Timely harvesting [कापणी] of the crop [पीक] can prevent the subsequent season's crop [पीक] from infestation by the pest [कीड].**
7. **Select varieties resistant to the corn earworm.**

question: सीताफळावरील पिठ्या ढेकूण (Mealybugs) साठी जैविक नियंत्रण सुचवा.
answer:
सीताफळावरील पिठ्या ढेकूण (मेळीबग) या रसशोषक किडीवर प्रभावी जैविक नियंत्रणासाठी आपण फुले बागेसाइड (लेक्‍एनिसिलिअम लेकेनी) हे जैव-कीटकनाशक वापरू शकता, कारण हे सीताफळ व इतर पिकांवरील मेळीबगवर कार्य करत असल्याचे नोंद आहे?

**जैविक नियंत्रण:**
- **फुले बागेसाइड** (लेक्‍एनिसिलिअम लेकेनी) हे जैव-कीटकनाशक धुरळ्या आर्द्रतेमध्ये चांगले कार्य करते; म्हणून पाऊस हंगामात किंवा ७५% पेक्षा जास्त आर्द्रतेत नियंत्रण चांगले होते.  
- हिवाळा/उन्हाळ्यात हवेत कोरडेपणा असेल तर फुले बागेसाइड रात्रभर पाण्यात भिजवा; फवारणीपूर्वी पीकास चांगले पाणी द्या.  
- पुढील फवारणीचा कालावधी १५ दिवसांच्या अंतराने २ ते ३ वेळा करा; साधारण ३ ते ४ आठवड्यांत किडींची संख्या घटते.  
- बुरशीजन्य किडींच्या उपचारांत तांबे ऑक्सिक्लोराईड, तांबे हायड्रॉक्साईड, गंधक, बोर्डो मिश्रण हे संचर्मिश्रणे लेक्‍एनिसिलिअमच्या वाढीला सध्या आहेत; इतर रासायनिक बुरशीनाशके फुले बागेसाइडनंतर किमान एक आठवडा अंतर ठेवा.

question: नारळाच्या झाडावरील शेंडाकुज व्याधीवर काय उपचार करावेत?
answer:
नारळ झाडावर शेंडाकुज म्हणजे कोणत्या संकेराच्या भागात कुज येते त्यानुसार उपचार वेगळे असू शकतात, आणि तुमच्या प्रश्नातील शेंडाकुज हा शब्द शोधताना एकाच अचूक रोगाशी जोडला जातो की नाही ते दस्तऐवजांमध्ये थेट सापडले नाही. पण नारळासाठी उपलब्ध विश्वसनीय दस्तऐवजात कोंब कुजणे (कोंबाचे कुज) या रोगाचे लक्षण दिले आहे—जिथे नवीन उतरलेले पान विलोभित होते, वाकवायला मऊ लागते, पाहणीला ओढल्याने सहज सुटते आणि पानडॉक्सला सडक्या गंध येतो.

**लक्षणे:**
- नवीन उतरलेले पान विलोभित दिसते
- पान वाकवायला मऊ लागते
- घट्ट धरून ओढले तरी सहज आकर्षित होऊन सुटते
- पानडॉक्साच्या भागाला सडक्या गंध येतो

**कीड व रोग नियंत्रण:** उपलब्ध दस्तऐवजात या कोंब कुजण्यासाठी फवारणीची/घटक अभ्यासानुसार औषधांची मात्रा दिलेली नाही; उपलब्ध माहिती ही लक्षण ओळखपर्यंत मर्यादित आहे.

**स्रोत: कृषी दर्शनी डॉ. बाळासाहेब सावंत कोकण कृषी विद्यापीठ, दापोली २०२५**

**Control:**

This disease [रोग] can be controlled by adopting integrated disease management [एकात्मिक रोग व्यवस्थापन] techniques. Disease [रोग] can be controlled by proper cultivation changes, destruction of diseased leaves, and use of appropriate fungicides [बुरशीनाशके].

A. **Cultivation:**

1. Banana [केळी] should not be cultivated in fields on the banks of streams, rivers, drains, and in marshy soil [माती].
2. Banana [केळी] should preferably be planted in the last week of May or in the first fortnight of June.
3. The rhizomes for planting should be cone-shaped, weighing 750 grams to 1 kg, 3 to 4 months old, and should be taken from suckers whose leaves are narrow like a sword blade.
4. Before planting, immerse the rhizomes in a 0.1 percent solution of carbendazim for half an hour.
5. Nitrogenous fertilizers should not be given in higher doses and after six months.
6. Remove suckers from time to time after planting and keep the orchard weed-free.
7. Rotate crops and avoid ratooning as far as possible.
8. Ditches should be made in the garden for draining excess water.

B. **Destruction of Diseased Leaves:**

Remove and destroy the leaves as soon as the initial symptoms [लक्षणे] of the disease [रोग], i.e., fine brownish spots, appear on the leaves.

As the disease [रोग] is infected in childhood, it is necessary to protect them in the first rainy season after planting bananas, so that the incidence of the disease [रोग] will not occur at the time of harvesting [कापणी] bananas.

question: बीड बाजारात सोयाबीन विकायला आत्ताची वेळ योग्य आहे का?
answer:
**बीड** बाजारात सध्या तुमच्या सोयाबीनचे **₹५३४० ते **₹५५२५ प्रति क्विंटल (सरासरी **₹५४३८)** इतके भाव दिसत आहेत.

> नोंद: या भावाची नोंद पाच दिवसांपूर्वीची आहे; दुसरे सोयाबीनचे भाव नऊ दिवसांपूर्वीचे **₹५२०० ते **₹५२००** म्हणजेच **₹५२००** असेही दिसत आहेत.

बाजारात आत्ताच विक्री योग्य आहे का हे ठरवायला मी इथे दोन गोष्टीने मदत करतो—ठिकाणाचा सर्वश्रेष्ठ अंदाज लक्षात घेऊन आणि एक महिन्यातही तुम्हाला सामान्यपणे त्या भावात विक्री करता येते की साठवून मग, पण माझ्याकडे फक्त उपलब्ध बाजारभाव दिसतात, शेतीमाहितीमध्ये आलेल्या नेहमीच्या अटींबाबत मी वैयक्तिक अंदाज/व्यावहारिक भाव बदल अंदाज देऊ शकत नाही.

बीड बाजारात घरात सोयाबीन वाळवून सुक्की अवस्थेत विक्री करा आणि तपासणी/वजन उघड्या प्रक्रियेत करूनच पैसे स्वीकारा—आणि एपीएमसी किमान समर्थन भाव किती लागू आहे हे आजचा लाभकाळ/अधिसूचना पुस्तिकेत केंद्र-प्रकरण नंबर सहित थेट परवानगीवर मर्यादित असल्यामुळे अनुभवी मार्गदर्शन घ्या.

**1) Wilt [मररोग]:** This disease [रोग] is caused by the fungus Fusarium oxysporum (ciceris). As soon as the infestation occurs, the leaves turn yellow and wilt [मररोग]. The shoots become drooped, and the plant dries up in the green state. Use wilt [मररोग]-resistant varieties [प्रतिकारक वाण] such as ICCV 2, ICCV 10, Vijay, Vishal, Jakai 9218, Sakhi 9516, PDKV Kanchan (under irrigation [सिंचन]), etc.

**2) Root Rot [मुळ कुज]:** This disease [रोग] is caused by the fungus Rhizoctonia bataticola, and the leaves of the seedlings turn yellow and the seedlings wilt [मररोग]. When the seedlings are uprooted, the roots appear rotten. The plant comes out easily. Burn and destroy the residues of diseased plants.

**Chickpea [हरभरा] Wilt [मररोग]/Root Rot [मुळ कुज] Management [व्यवस्थापन]:** Treat seeds as follows for wilt [मररोग] and root rot [मुळ कुज] diseases.

question: माझ्या पिकासाठी कोणती शासकीय योजना आहे?
answer:
तुमच्या महाडीबीटी पोर्टलवर सध्या कोणताही योजना अर्ज नोंदलेला दिसत नाही, म्हणून तुम्ही कुरबुरीने कोणती योजना आहे हे मी हा दाखवू शकत नाही. तरीही तुमच्या पिकासाठी योग्य शासकीय योजना ठरवण्यासाठी एक छोटा माहितीची खात्री करून घेतली तर लगेच पात्र योजना सांगतो?

**मुख्य योजना (उदाहरणे):**
- प्रधानमंत्री किसान सम्मान निधि योजना
- प्रधानमंत्री फसल बीमा योजना
- प्रधानमंत्री पीक सिंचन योजनेअंतर्गत पर ड्रॉप मोअर क्रॉप
- नॅशनल मिशन फॉर इंटीग्रेटेड डेव्हलपमेंट ऑफ हॉर्टिकल्चर (एम.आय.डी.एच.) — डाऊनलिंक शेडनेट, पॉलीहाऊस, पेरणी सामग्री इ.
- डॉ. बाबासाहेब आंबेडकर कृषी स्वावलंबन योजना
- गोपीनाथ मुंडे शेतकरी अपघात सुरक्षा संयुक्त अनुदान योजना

**पात्रता:**
- महाराष्ट्रातील शेतकरी असल्याचा तपशील व जमीन/गाव स्थिती
- पीक प्रकार (भाजीपाला/फळवाटिका/कडधान्य/रोपे/भुईमूळ)
- सिंचनाची सोय आणि रोग/हानीचा प्रकार

**अर्ज कसा करावा:**
- स्थानिक कृषी कार्यालय किंवा संबंधित विभागामार्फत अर्ज करता येतो

कोणते पीक आहे (उदा. कांदा, टोमॅटर, सोयाबीन, ऊस, डाळिंब) आणि तुम्हाला खात्यातील मदत हवी आहे की हानीSigar कोपर असुरक्षिततेसारखी मदत हवी आहे??

question: मी कोणकोणत्या योजनांसाठी पात्र आहे?
answer:
सध्या तुमच्या प्रोफाइलनुसार (बोर्डी, मालेगाव, वाशिम; एकूण क्षेत्र ०.५५ हे.; पोक्रा गाव: नाही) कोणत्या योजनांसाठी पात्रता येईल ते सांगताना काही महत्त्वाचे मुद्दे खालीलप्रमाणे आहेत.

**नोट:** पोक्रा-अंतर्गत ठिबक सिंचन/विश्वस्त शेततळे (गटका शेततळे) या घटकांसाठी पात्रता फक्त पोक्रा-नियुक्त गावांसाठी आहे, त्यामुळे तुम्हाला त्या घटक अप्लाय ऑप्शनमध्ये दाखवले जाणार नाहीत?

**पात्र योजनेतून निवड (तपशील सहज उपलब्ध असल्याने):**
**प्रधानमंत्री किसान सम्मान निधि योजना**? ही केंद्र योजना आहे जी **₹६०००** प्रति वर्ष लाभ देते.

**पात्रता:**
- लहान कितीही (संवर्गीकरण लागू नाही), पण स्थिती, जमीनधारणा व ७/१२ नोंद सक्षम असणे आवश्यक.

**मागची कागदपत्रे:**
- शेतकरी नोंदणी (७/१२ आणि संबंधित सिडिंग) व ई-केवायसी.

**नामो शेतकरी महासन्मान निधी**? ही केंद्र योजना आहे जी **₹६०००** प्रति वर्ष अतिरिक्त लाभ देते.

**पात्रता:**
- प्रधानमंत्री किसान सम्मान निधि योजनेत पात्र भूमिधारक (या अधिभोग म्हणजेच लाभ प्राप्त करणाऱ्यांसाठी).

**कीड/पीक संरक्षण उपाय (निर्देशित पीक व ओळख क्षेत्रानुसार):**
**प्रधानमंत्री फसल बीमा योजना**? ही केंद्र योजना आहे जी अधिसूचित (ओळख झालेली) पिकांसाठी नैसर्गिक आपत्ती, कीड व रोगामुळे पीक अपवार पडल्यावर आर्थिक आधार देते.

**पात्रता:**
- अधिसूचित क्षेत्रातील अधिसूचित पिके घेणारे सर्व शेतकरी (किराया farde/share-croppers समावेश).

**कृषी यांत्रिकीकरण (सेवा केंद्र/यंत्र भांडार):**
**राज्य अनुदानित कृषी यांत्रिकीकरण**? ही राज्य योजना आहे जी कस्टम हायरिंग सेंटर/फार्म माशिनरी बँक स्थापनेसाठी **४०%** अनुदान देते.

**पात्रता:**
- वैयक्तिक, शेतकरी गट, महिला स्वयं-सहायता गट, उत्पादक कंपनी, सहकारी संस्था इ.

**यांत्रिकीकरण (यंत्र खरेदी):**

State Sponsored Agriculture Mechanization

*Main Component*:
Benefit for Custom Hiring Centre

*Introduction*:
The declining number of livestock and the shortage of labor for agricultural work necessitate mechanization in agriculture. Mechanization allows work to be completed within a specified time frame, saves inputs, and saves production costs.
Objective:-
        Resolve labour issues in agriculture.
        Promote Farm Mechanization.
        Enable farmers to take up farm operations in time.
        Promote custom hiring services for farm mechanization.
        Create rural employment.
        Help to Increase agriculture production.

2. Subsidy of 50% of the total expenditure for agriculture graduates or maximum rs. 5.00 lakh and Subsidy of 40% of the expenditure for other beneficiaries or upto maximum limit 4.00 lakh, whichever is lower for kisan drones.

*Eligibility*:

*Required Documents*:

2. Test report of the Implement.
3. RC of tractor for tractor driven implements.
4. Registration Certificate for farmer producer company or farmer groups.

*Application Process*:

For transparency in beneficiary selection, presanction is being given by determining seniority through FCFS method. After presanction, farmers are being allowed to purchase from the open market as per their choice. At the time of purchase, farmers are required to make payment through cheque/DD/online from their own bank account. The subsidy amount is being transferred to the Aadhaar-linked bank account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) method.

## 3. Scheme Information

*Id*:
42

*Scheme Code*:
ndksp-drip-irrigation

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp

*Scheme Name*:
Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp

*Main Component*:
Drip Irrigation

*Sub Component*:
1. Inline Drip Irrigation
2. Online Drip Irrigation

*Introduction*:
The Central Government has issued Operational Guidelines in the year 2024 for implementing the Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana - Per Drop More Crop, a centrally sponsored micro-irrigation scheme. This scheme is being implemented from the year 2022-23 under the name Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana - Per Drop More Crop. The Commissionerate of Agriculture, has issued guidelines for the micro-irrigation scheme. On the lines of this scheme, a micro-irrigation scheme (Drip and Sprinkler Irrigation) will be implemented under the Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Project. Accordingly, the following guidelines are being issued for implementing the approved micro-irrigation component in the villages selected under the project.

*Benefits*:
1.To increase the area under micro-irrigation by using modern technology in the project districts and to promote climate-resilient farming practices.
2. To encourage micro-irrigation methods for the development of agriculture and horticulture crops based on modern technology.
3. To manage fertilizers through the micro-irrigation system.
4. To increase agricultural production, the quality of agricultural produce, and consequently, the total income of farmers.
5. To increase water use efficiency.

*Eligibility*:
1. Farmers who have already received benefits on same land from any other scheme will not be eligible under this scheme.
2. If the farmer has availed the benefits of micro-irrigation components under any government scheme in the last 7 years, such areas will be excluded, and the remaining area can receive benefits within the total limit of 5 hectares.
3. The farmer must have access to water supply and electricity.
4. The benefits of this component under the project will be available to beneficiaries who own up to 5 hectares of land.

*Required Documents*:
1. If the applicant belongs to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe category, a caste certificate should be provided.
2. If the applicant is a joint account holder, a consent letter from the other account holders shall be submitted.
3. If the applicant is a person with disability, a disability certificate should be provided.

*Application Process*:
The NDKSP DBT Portal has been created with the following objectives - 
DBT System for accepting and processing subsidy applications received from farmers. Through this system, farmers can directly login and apply for financial assistance under scheme and disbursement of funds happen directly to the Aadhaar linked account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode. There is no need for farmer to visit a government office to apply for subsidy or receive disbursed funds. Also, farmers can track and monitor their applications in real time which shows transparency in NDKSP operations. This system facilitates NDKSP to perform its approval process in 100% paperless manner which eliminates intermediaries and establishes credibility. 
To avail the benefits of the components under the project, the beneficiary (farmer) must directly login on the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system using their Farmer ID. After login, the beneficiary becomes eligible to receive the project benefits. Additionally, it is mandatory for the beneficiary to link their Aadhaar number with their bank account so that the benefit amount can be directly transferred to their personal bank account.
The following farmer attributes need to be entered in the Portal: 
Farmer Attributes: (Essential): 
State, District, Sub-District/Block, Village, Farmer Name, Type of Identity  Farmer ID for landholder farmer is essential, Gender, Category, land cosent letter for joint landholders. 
Farmer Login and application Module:
Step 1: Farmer Login and Application Process through the "Mahavistaar-AI Application"
a) First, download and install the "Mahavistaar-AI Application" from the "Google Play Store" on your mobile.
b) After entering the application, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, click the "DBT" tab at the bottom right of the Dashboard screen.
d) Upon clicking, click the "NDKSP (PoCRA)" tab.
e) To avail benefits for various items under individual components, click the "Click Here" link at the end of this screen to apply.
f) Following this, your NDKSP (PoCRA) project dashboard screen will be available.
g) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.
Step 2: Farmer Login and application Process through the "Project's DBT Web Portal"
a) Visit to "https://mahapocra.gov.in/mr/applications" NDKSP 2.0 website
b) After entering the webpage of Farmer login, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, dashboard screen will be available.
d) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.

*Sub Component*:
Risk covered -  Crop cutting base average yield reduction in comparison to threshhold yield for that insurance unit( Revenue circle)

*Introduction*:
1. The scheme is applicable for notified crops in a notified area (revenue circle). All farmers including share-croppers, tenant farmers growing notified crops in the notified area.
2. The scheme is optional for both loanee as well as non-loanee  farmers.
3. Under this scheme, the indemnity level is  fixed as 70 % for all notified crops.
4. Threshold yield  is determined by taking into account the average average yield  of the  best five years from past 7 years multiplied by  indemnity level
5. The scheme is implemented on beed pattern (80:110) where Insurance companies claim liability is up to 110 %  of the gross premium  or 110% of the burn cost whichever is higher for the given cluster in given season .  The claims above 110 % will be paid by state govt. and in case of profit, Insurance company will keep 20% of the gross premium and return the balance premium amount to state if any .

*Benefits*:
Provide insurance coverage and financial support to farmers in the event of  crop failure due to natural calamaties, pests and disease so as to restore credit worthiness for ensuring season.

*Eligibility*:
1. All the farmers  growing notified crops in the notified area are eligible.
2. The scheme is  optional for Loanee & Non-loanee farmers.

Sum insured per hector: Sum insured per hectare is decided as per scale of finance for that crop

Insurance Companies: The scheme is being implemented through selected  crop insurance companies  through tendering process.

*Required Documents*:
1. Agristack number
2. Aadhar card
3. Bank account details
4. Land details and crop details
5. Digital crop survey ( E pik Pahani)

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on www.pmfby.gov.in portal within the given date

*Introduction*:

Due to the lack of irrigation, crop production decreases, or sometimes crops are destroyed, leading to financial losses for farmers. As a solution, it is necessary to construct farm ponds to store excess water flowing through streams, rivulets, and rivers during the monsoon to create a facility for protective irrigation. Considering the current drought-like situation in the state, the implementation of the individual farm pond component is proposed under the World Bank-aided Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp to make protective irrigation facilities available to farmers.

*Benefits*:

2. To create a facility for protective irrigation. 
3. To increase the area under a second crop and to increase the farmer's income. 
4. To encourage supplementary farming activities like horticulture, vegetable crops, pisciculture, orchards, and animal husbandry through farm ponds. 
5. To contribute to improving the groundwater level by conserving water resources.

*Eligibility*:
1. The farmer should have minimum 0.60 hectares of land in their own name.
2. It is necessary for a suitable location to be available according to technical specifications for the selected size of the pond.
3. The responsibility for obtaining the necessary machinery for completing the pond will rest with the respective beneficiary, and no advance amount will be provided for this purpose.
4. Compensation for damage will not be allowed if any harm occurs to the pond due to natural disasters.
5. Farmers who have received benefits from any other scheme for this component will not receive benefits under this scheme again.
6. It is necessary for a suitable location to be available according to technical specifications for the selected size of the pond.

After login, the beneficiary becomes eligible to receive the project benefits. Additionally, it is mandatory for the beneficiary to link their Aadhaar number with their bank account so that the benefit amount can be directly transferred to their personal bank account.
The following farmer attributes need to be entered in the Portal: 
Farmer Attributes: (Essential): 
State, District, Sub-District/Block, Village, Farmer Name, Type of Identity  Farmer ID for landholder farmer is essential, Gender, Category, land cosent letter for joint landholders. 
Farmer Login and application Module:
Step 1: Farmer Login and Application Process through the "Mahavistaar-AI Application"
a) First, download and install the "Mahavistaar-AI Application" from the "Google Play Store" on your mobile.
b) After entering the application, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, click the "DBT" tab at the bottom right of the Dashboard screen.
d) Upon clicking, click the "NDKSP (PoCRA)" tab.
e) To avail benefits for various items under individual components, click the "Click Here" link at the end of this screen to apply.
f) Following this, your NDKSP (PoCRA) project dashboard screen will be available.
g) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.
Step 2: Farmer Login and application Process through the "Project's DBT Web Portal"
a) Visit to "https://mahapocra.gov.in/mr/applications" NDKSP 2.0 website
b) After entering the webpage of Farmer login, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, dashboard screen will be available.
d) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.

question: मी MIDH पात्र आहे का
answer:
तुमची **डब्ल्यू.एस्.क्यू.** म्हणजेच कृषोन्नती योजना—एकात्मिक फलोत्पादन विकास अभियान (एम.आय.डी.एच.) पात्रता तुमच्या कोणत्या घटकासाठी आहे यावर ठरते, आणि माझ्याकडे मिळालेली योजना माहितीनुसार काही घटक तुमच्या कुरीत जमिनीचा आकार पुरेसा आहे असं दिसतं; पण एम.आय.डी.एच. ही शासकीय योजना जास्त प्रमाणात बागायत/फलोत्पादन, भाजीपाला नर्सरी, फुले व अशा पिकांसाठी लाभ देते, त्यामुळे तुम्ही नेमके कोणते काम करणार आहात हे ठरावे लागेल?

**एम.आय.डी.एच.—फळ/फुल/मसाला लागवड (क्षेत्र विस्तार) घटक:**  
- किमान ०.२० हे. जमीनधारणा आवश्यक आहे  
- संबंधित पीक पूर्णपणे नवीन लागवड असावी (पूर्वी केलेली लागवड गणलेली नाही)  

**एम.आय.डी.एच.—लागवडीचे चांगले वाण तयार करण्यासाठी लागवड साहित्य उत्पादन (नर्सरी) घटक:**  
- बागेतलं/अंबठीचं व्यवसायात किमान ३ वर्षांचा अनुभव असलेले शेतकरी किंवा नवीन सुरू होणारी नर्सरी पात्र  
- स्थानाला स्थायी सिंचनाची सोय आवश्यक  

तुमच्या प्रोफाइलप्रमाणे एकूण जमीनधारणा १.३ हे. आहे, त्यामुळे क्षेत्र विस्ताराचा घटक (किमान ०.२० हे.) बाजूला बघितला तर जमीन टक्क्याने योग्य दिसते; पण नर्सरी घटकासाठी अनुभव व स्थायी सिंचन हे मी इथून खात्रीने ठरवू शकत नाही?

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

तुम्ही एम.आय.डी.एच. अंतर्गत नेमका कोणता घटक घ्यायचा आहे—नर्सरी उभारणी की फळ/फुल/मसालापीकांची नवीन लागवड??

**Transition Period:**

The period from the start of organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती] to the certification of the agricultural produce as organic [सेंद्रिय] is called the transition period. This period can range from 1-3 years. It is mandatory to free the soil [माती] from agricultural chemicals [कृषी रसायने]. During this transition period, the agricultural produce can be sold under the Under Conversion label of the certification agency.

**Temporary Recommendations for Organic Farming [सेंद्रिय शेती]:**

Based on experiments related to nutrient management [अन्नद्रव्य व्यवस्थापन] in organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती], some temporary recommendations are being made. These are applicable for crops like sorghum [ज्वारी], pearl millet [बाजरी], cotton [कापूस], tur, soybean [सोयाबीन], moong, udid, as well as intercropping [आंतरपीक] systems like sorghum [ज्वारी] + tur, pearl millet [बाजरी] + tur, cotton [कापूस] + soybean [सोयाबीन], soybean [सोयाबीन] + tur, etc.

1. **Organic Fertilizers [सेंद्रिय खते]:**

- Neem [कडूलिंब] powder: 1-1.5 tons/ha
- Pond [तलाव] silt [गाळ]: 8-10 tons/ha
- Sugarcane [ऊस] molasses [मोलासेस]: 7-10 tons/ha

1. **Green Manures:**

- Take green manure crops [हिरवळीची खतपिके] of Borer, Dhaincha [ढैंचा], Cowpea [चवळी] in standing crops such as rice [बासमती तांदूळ], wide-row sown or planted cotton [कापूस], tur, etc. At the flowering stage, bury the green manure crop [हिरवळीची खतपिके] between the two rows of the crops with the help of a Balaram plow.
- Chop the leaves and young branches of Gliricidia [गिरिपुष्प] plant finely and spread them over all the crops and mulch them. Use this when the crop [पीक] is 25-30 days old. This green manure [हिवरळीची खत] decomposes in just one week and becomes available to the crop [पीक]. Generally, 6-8 tons of green leaves / branches should be given per hectare.

**Preventive Measures and Seed Treatment [बीज प्रक्रिया]:** Crop rotation [पीक फेरपालट], deep plowing [खोल नांगरणी] in summer, picking and destroying the stubble [खुंट] from the field [शेत], arranging for drainage of excess water from the soil [माती], use of certified seed [प्रमाणित बियाणे] is essential for the control of collar rot [मूळ खोड कुज], leaf spots, blight [करपा] on leaves and pods. For protection in seedling stage [रोपट्याची अवस्था], treat the seeds with Carboxin 37.5% + Thiram 37.5% D S (mixed ingredient) 3 grams per kg of seed [बियाणे].

1. Yellow Mosaic: This disease [रोग] is caused by a virus called Mungbean [मुग] Yellow Mosaic Virus [पिवळा मोझँक विषाणू रोग] and it is spread by Whitefly [पांढरी माशी]. The incidence of this disease [रोग] is increasing as off-season cultivation [हंगामाबाहेरील शेती] of soybean [सोयाबीन] has increased. The disease [रोग] is seen in all stages of growth [वाढ]. Dark yellow spots, blotches appear on the leaves and the leaves turn yellow. This slows down the carbohydrate absorption process and the pods do not fill properly. If the disease [रोग] occurs before flowering, fewer flowers are produced and there is a large reduction in production [उत्पादन]. For control, plant disease [वनस्पती रोग] resistant / disease [रोग] tolerant varieties (JS 20-29, JS 97- 52, JS 20-69, JS 95-60). Uproot and destroy the diseased plants immediately. Install 15-20 yellow sticky traps [सापळे] per hectare in the crop [पीक] from the beginning. Keep the field [शेत] and bund weed-free. Control Whitefly [पांढरी माशी] from time to time.

Harvesting [कापणी]: Harvest [कापणी] soybean [सोयाबीन] after the color of the pods turns yellowish reddish and according to the maturity period of the variety in 100 to 110 days. If the crop [पीक] is harvested late, the pods start bursting.

Production [उत्पादन]: The production [उत्पादन] of soybean [सोयाबीन] crop [पीक] is 20 to 25 quintals per hectare.

**Sunflower [सुर्यफुल]**

**Soil [माती]:** Select medium to heavy soil [माती] with good drainage for sunflower [सुर्यफुल] cultivation. This crop [पीक] does not grow well in alkaline and waterlogged soils.

**Pre-Cultivation:** Plow the soil [माती] deeply and then give two to three cross-wise harrowings. Before the last harrowing [वखरणी], apply 10 to 12 tonnes of well-decomposed farmyard manure [शेणखत] per hectare to the soil [माती].

**Time of Sowing [पेरणी]:** Kharif - First fortnight of July, Rabi - First fortnight of October to first fortnight of November, and Summer - First fortnight of February.
